izzyondroid:au.id.micolous.farebot.name: Metrodroid
izzyondroid:au.id.micolous.farebot.summary: Metrodroid can read information from some public transport NFC smartcards
izzyondroid:au.id.micolous.farebot.description:
Metrodroid can read information from some public transport NFC smartcards. It was formerly known as Farebot M.
 This is a fork of Eric Butler’s Farebot project, with support for additional cards and bug fixes. A list of supported cards can be found here .
 You require a NFC-compatible phone in order to read cards.
 You need a NXP NFC chipset in your phone in order to read MIFARE Classic cards. Some phones have NFC chips from other manufacturers, which do not read Mifare Classic cards (eg: Nexus 4, Nexus 5, Samsung Galaxy S4). Check the About screen in the app in order to determine if your phone supports MIFARE Classic.
 Some agencies have encrypted cards. You will need to acquire encryption keys in order to read them. These are generally unique to each card. Sorry, I can’t help you with this.
 Some other agencies’ cards using Cubic Nextfare on Mifare Classic may also work.

izzyondroid:com.bald.uriah.baldphone.name: BaldPhone
izzyondroid:com.bald.uriah.baldphone.summary: Replace your phone's interface with a big, simple and friendly one
izzyondroid:com.bald.uriah.baldphone.description:
BaldPhone is a platform which replaces the phone’s interface to a bigger, simpler and friendlier one.
 It is built for elderly people, people with motoric problems and people who need a visual aid.
 It’s free and doesn’t contain ads. it is made out of a desire to help the community and is purely a goodwill product.
 Main Features: 
 Home Launcher

 Video Tutorials
 Reminders For Pills
 Contacts and Phone Applications
 Voice Assistant
 Alarms
 Photos and Videos Viewer
 Notification Management
 SOS Button

 Plenty of screenshots can be found here .

izzyondroid:com.henrikherzig.playintegri.name: Simple Play Integrity Checker
izzyondroid:com.henrikherzig.playintegri.summary: demonstrates the usage of the Play Integrity and SafetyNet Attestation API
izzyondroid:com.henrikherzig.playintegri.description:
SPIC (short for Simple Play Integrity Checker) is a simple Android App that demonstrates the usage of the PlayIntegrity API as well as the deprecated SafetyNet Attestation API.
 The received integrity verdict from the APIs can be check locally on the device or send to a remote server so they can be validated there. The remote server implementation has to be self hosted for now.
 The app is OpenSource and the source code of the android app as well as the server implementation can be found on Github (see /herzhenr/SPIC-android and /herzhenr/SPIC-server ).

izzyondroid:com.paddlesandbugs.dahdidahd.name: Dahdidahdit — The Morse Trainer
izzyondroid:com.paddlesandbugs.dahdidahd.summary: An Actual Morse Code Trainer — Not Just A Morse Code Generator
izzyondroid:com.paddlesandbugs.dahdidahd.description:
Introduction Ham radio ops who like QRP will sooner or later want to learn Morse code so they can communicate using CW. This app teaches amateur radio enthusiasts how Morse code works and helps them build their speed.
 Custom-Tailored Lessons You set your current level of proficiency and what you aim for (e.g. all letters with 20 words per minute). Dahdidahdit guides you from where you are to where you want to be — It teaches you new letters when you are ready and increases your speed when you seem bored.
 Requirements The only things you need (other than a phone and the app) are a sheet of paper and a pen.
 Usage When you start the session, Dahdidahdit plays Morse code letters so you can determine which speed you are comfortable with. You jot down the letters you recognized. When the session ends, Dahdidahdit shows you what it sent and you compare notes. Then you tap the button that shows the number of mistakes.
 Automated Curriculum When you complete enough practice sessions with only a few mistakes, Dahdidahdit starts the next lesson, by introducing a new letter or by increasing the speed.
 Additional Features
 Learning Q-codes
 Sending practice using either an on-screen or an actual paddle connected by USB
 Morse QSOs via internet with Morserino or Dahdidahdit users
 Game: Morse Tennis

izzyondroid:com.ravenfeld.panoramax.baba.name: Baba
izzyondroid:com.ravenfeld.panoramax.baba.summary: Discover Baba: The app that revolutionizes contributing to Panoramax
izzyondroid:com.ravenfeld.panoramax.baba.description:
Discover Baba: The App That Revolutionizes Contribution to the Panoramax Project!
 Specifically designed for contributors to the Panoramax project, Baba simplifies and enhances the collection and submission of geotagged photos.
 Why choose Baba? 
 Convenience: Capture your photos quickly, even in sequence mode.
 Flexibility: Manually adjust the location of a photo before or after capturing it to bypass GPS inaccuracies.
 Editing: Delete or rename sequences before submission, with the option to send them at your own pace.
 With Baba, optimizing your impact on collaborative mapping has never been easier! Actively participate in the development of Panoramax.
 Download Baba today and help shape the world of tomorrow.
 For new ideas and improvements, contribute to the project at https://gitlab.com/ravenfeld/baba.

izzyondroid:net.kevinboone.androidmedias.name: Android Music Server
izzyondroid:net.kevinboone.androidmedias.summary: a web interface to music playback on Android devices
izzyondroid:net.kevinboone.androidmedias.description:
Kevin's Music Server for Android provides a web browser interface to control playback of audio files stored on most modern (4.x-11.0) Android devices. This allows the Android device to be used as a music server, in multi-room audio applications, among other things. I normally keep my Android phone docked, with a permanent USB connection to an audio DAC. This arrangement produces good quality audio playback, but I don't always have the pone within reach. It's awkward to fiddle with the little screen when it's docked, anyway. Providing a web interface – albeit a crude one – allows me to control playback from a web browser.
 Audio tracks can be selected using the browser from a list of albums, or directly from the filesystem (but see notes below). You can restrict the album listing to particular genres or particular artists rather than displaying all albums on the same page. Album cover art images can be displayed.
 Features: 
 Simple web interface – works on most desktop web browsers and many mobile browsers
 Integrates with the Android media catalogue – browse by album, artist, genre, composer, or track
 Supports file/folder browsing
 Media catalogue text search
 Equalizer
 Cover art (both baked-in and album-folder images)
 Playback control by headset or remote control

phone's GPU for up to a few seconds. The results are placed in the folder

fdroid:com.cointrend.name: CoinTrend: Private Crypto Tracker
fdroid:com.cointrend.summary: Lightweight, fast and private cryptocurrencies monitor
fdroid:com.cointrend.description:
Lightweight, fast and private cryptocurrencies monitor. No ads, no subscriptions, just coins.
 Features 
• Market: real-time updates of the Trending Coins (the most searched coins in the last 24h) and the Top Coins (the top 250 cryptocurrencies by market cap).
• Favourites: track your favourite coins at a glance by adding them to the favourite list and sorting them as you wish.
• Search: search over 10.000 coins by name or symbol.
• Settings: choose the tracking configuration you need.
 10.000+ real-time cryptocurrencies 
CoinTrend is powered by the public CoinGecko API (https://www.coingecko.com/en/api) to track over 10.000 cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Ethereum Classic (ETC), Binance Coin (BNB), Crypto.com Cronos (CRO), Cardano (ADA), Solana (SOL), Monero (XRM) and many more!
 Clear and detailed market data 
Price, Percentage Gain, Trend Chart, MarketCap, Trading Volume 24h, Highest Price 24h, Lowest Price 24h, Available Supply, Total Supply, All-Time High Price (ATH), All-Time Low Price (ATL).
 Lightweight 
CoinTrend stores coins' data locally and updates them automatically only when needed, thus minimising mobile data usage and battery consumption. You can still manually trigger a data update whenever you need it by simply swiping down on each screen!
 100% free and open-source 
Don't trust, verify! CoinTrend is 100% free and it does not include any ads nor trackers. Its code is publicly available at https://github.com/CoinTrend. Check it out yourself and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any suggestions!
 Designed for Android 
The User Interface has been designed following the latest Google's Material Design guidelines and using only native Android components and animations.

fdroid:com.danilolutz.cubetimer.name: CubeTimer
fdroid:com.danilolutz.cubetimer.summary: Offline 3×3 speedcubing timer with TNoodle scrambles
fdroid:com.danilolutz.cubetimer.description:
CubeTimer is a focused offline timer for 3×3 speedcubing.
It generates random-state scrambles with a local port of TNoodle-lib, the WCA scramble program. The cube map updates to match every scramble, so you can inspect the state before starting.
Features:
- Tap-to-start and tap-to-stop timer.
- Random-state 3×3 scrambles generated offline.
- Cube map synchronized with the displayed scramble.
- Local history of up to 200 solves.
- Best, worst, mean, ao5, ao12, best ao5, and best ao12 statistics.
- Delete a solve with undo, or clear the history with confirmation.
- Solve detail card and PNG sharing.
- Light and dark themes.
CubeTimer has no account, ads, analytics, or Internet permission. Solves remain on the device. A shareable PNG is created only when you request sharing through Android's share sheet.

fdroid:com.duetto.name: Duetto
fdroid:com.duetto.summary: A tiny Discord for two, on your own server: a permanent voice and video channel.
fdroid:com.duetto.description:
Duetto is a tiny "Discord" made to measure for two people only. It is not an app for calling: it is a permanent channel. Open the app and you are in; if the other person is there too you connect by yourselves, and otherwise you stay reachable and are told the moment they arrive.
Audio and video travel end-to-end encrypted straight between the two phones. The server - yours, or one somebody let you in to - is only there to let you find each other, and cannot read anything. No account, no phone number, no service of anybody's.
- One tap and you are in the channel, and you stay: the app survives the night, the pocket, the change of network.
- Video when you want it, with the quality chosen for both phones.
- The other person can call you back with a sound that gets through even with the ringer down.
- Pairing with an eight-digit code or a QR code held up to the other phone; invitations for whoever is to open connections of their own on your server.
- Silent during a phone call, back when it ends.
- Free software, GPL-3, and a server you run yourself: a small Node.js process and coturn.
You need Android 7 or later, and a server: the README says how to put one up in a quarter of an hour.

fdroid:com.github.girator.rebooter.name: Rebooter
fdroid:com.github.girator.rebooter.summary: Reboot device on schedule or variety of conditions
fdroid:com.github.girator.rebooter.description:
Regularly restarting device can solve some android system or app issues.
This app mainly intended to help protect against few specific threats,
because rebooting puts device into BFU (before first unlock) mode.
Advanced users would be able to run any executable/script instead of reboot.
Features
* Reboot when screen was not unlocked for set period of time.
* Reboot over fixed period or at scheduled time and days of week.
* Reboot when host USB connection detected.
* Customisable command line to fit different setups.
* Customisable sound and speach warnings upon reboot.
Permissions
* root (mandatory)
* set alarms & reminders (optional)
* run in background (optional)
* notifications (optional)
For app to function just enable background service.
Changing any settings stops service, start it again manually.
Service checks schedule only occasionally (1 hour by default),
so it should not consume any noticeable resources.
For exact timing please grant "set alarms & reminders" permission.
This app does not access network in any capacity.
This app does not collect, send or recieve any data.
This app able to use root permissions only executing user-defined command.
All default commands are variations "/system/bin/su -c reboot" type.

fdroid:com.matedroid.name: MateDroid
fdroid:com.matedroid.summary: View Tesla vehicle data from your self-hosted Teslamate instance
fdroid:com.matedroid.description:
Take control of your Tesla data with MateDroid, the companion app for Teslamate that puts your driving and charging history in your pocket.
 Your Data, Your Server, Your Privacy 
MateDroid connects exclusively to your self-hosted Teslamate instance. No cloud services, no accounts, no tracking. Your Tesla data never touches our servers because there are none. This is how privacy should work.
 Beautiful at a Glance 
See your Tesla's real-time status on a stunning dashboard featuring a 3D model that matches your car's actual color and wheels. The entire app theme adapts to your vehicle's color, creating a personalized experience in both light and dark modes.
 Everything You Want to Know 
• Live Dashboard - Battery, range, charging status, climate, tire pressures, and more
• Drive History - Every trip mapped with efficiency stats, elevation profiles, and weather conditions along the way
• Charging Sessions - Track where you charge, how much energy you add, costs, and charging curves
• Battery Health - Monitor degradation over time with clear visualizations
• Stats for Nerds - Tap the car for deep statistics: records, extremes, AC vs DC charging ratios, and hidden gems
 Offline Ready 
MateDroid syncs your data locally so you can browse your drives and charges even without an internet connection. Perfect for checking your trip history while on the road.
 Try It First, No Setup Needed 
No Teslamate server yet? Tap "Try the demo" on the first screen and explore the whole app with a year of realistic sample data — drives, charges, a live charging session, statistics and battery health. No account, no credentials, nothing to install. Connect your own server whenever you are ready.
 Requirements 
This app requires a working Teslamate + TeslamateApi setup:
• Teslamate: github.com/adriankumpf/teslamate
• TeslamateApi: github.com/tobiasehlert/teslamateapi
If you're already running Teslamate, you're just one API deployment away from using MateDroid.
 Free and Open Source 
MateDroid is 100% free with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no premium tiers. The complete source code is available on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license. Contributions welcome!
github.com/vide/matedroid

fdroid:com.rtneg.kyuubimask.name: KyuubiMask - Privacy First
fdroid:com.rtneg.kyuubimask.summary: Privacy-focused notification masking for screen sharing and presentations
fdroid:com.rtneg.kyuubimask.description:
KyuubiMask is designed to keep your notification content away from prying eyes. It replaces notification text as quickly as possible, making it much harder for others to read what you received—even if they're looking right at your screen. Notification content is never displayed or saved by this app.
KyuubiMask is a privacy-first notification masking tool that protects your sensitive information during screen sharing, presentations, or when your screen is visible to others.
🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
• No internet permission - works completely offline
• No data collection or storage
• No tracking, analytics, or ads
• Notification content is never logged or saved
• Open source with Apache 2.0 license
✨ FEATURES
• Masks notifications from any app you choose with generic text
• Tapping a masked notification opens the original app directly, without revealing any content
• Built-in presets for Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, and LINE
• Per-app toggle to choose which apps to mask
• Quick Settings tile for one-tap masking toggle
• Simple on/off toggle to enable or disable the service
• Works in the background
• Minimal permissions required
• Lightweight and efficient
📱 SUPPORTED APPS
KyuubiMask works with any installed app — select additional targets via the "Add custom apps…" button in Settings. Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, and LINE are available as built-in presets.
🎯 PERFECT FOR
• Screen sharing during video calls
• Live presentations and demos
• Recording tutorials or videos
• Working in public spaces
• Protecting your privacy
💡 HOW IT WORKS
When enabled, KyuubiMask replaces notification content from supported apps with generic text like "New notification", hiding sensitive information while still allowing you to see that you received a notification.
📖 WANT TO CHECK A NOTIFICATION LATER?
This app never saves notification content. If you want to review what you received, on supported devices (Android 11+), you can use Android's built-in Notification History if available and enabled (Settings → Notifications → Notification History).
🦊 OPEN SOURCE
All code is available on GitHub. No hidden functionality, complete transparency.

fdroid:dev.theolm.wwc.name: ChatLaunch for WhatsApp
fdroid:dev.theolm.wwc.summary: Start WhatsApp chats without adding numbers to contacts.
fdroid:dev.theolm.wwc.description:
The application is a user-friendly Android app designed to streamline communication on WhatsApp. It allows users to initiate chats directly without the necessity of adding phone numbers to their contact list, offering significant convenience for individuals who engage in one-time or infrequent communications. This feature is especially useful for professionals and businesses that need to connect quickly with clients without cluttering their personal contact list.
Additionally, the app boasts an exclusive launcher that enhances user experience by providing easy access and navigation. This tailored launcher is optimized for speed and efficiency, allowing users to open new chat sessions with just a few taps.
Another standout feature of the app is its integration with Android's quick actions. This integration permits users to execute common tasks directly from their device's home screen or through shortcuts, dramatically reducing the time and steps needed to start a chat.

fdroid:fr.jnda.android.ipcalc.name: IPCalc Android
fdroid:fr.jnda.android.ipcalc.summary: IP tool: subnet calculations, network, broadcast, binary conversion, and geoloca
fdroid:fr.jnda.android.ipcalc.description:

A comprehensive tool for IP management!

fdroid:mobi.meddle.wehe.name: Wehe
fdroid:mobi.meddle.wehe.summary: This is an app to help you identify traffic differentiation in your network!
fdroid:mobi.meddle.wehe.description:
Wehe is an app that runs tests against your network and analyzes the results to let you know if your network provider is restricting or prioritizing traffic for certain applications and certain ports.
By performing free tests with Wehe on your mobile device, you are participating in an IRB-approved research project at Northeastern University (led by Dr. David Choffnes) and you are helping to identify potential violations of net neutrality. Note that no conclusion can be drawn from an individual result of the type "Differentiation detected" to characterize a breach of Regulation (EU) 2015/2120 on Open Internet.
As net neutrality regulations vary according to location, Wehe collects coarse-grained geolocation data (with a precision of 0.1 degrees latitude/longitude) if users explicitly opt in to providing it. Wehe never collects fine-grained geolocation information. Wehe also collects IP addresses, which are stored as truncated data so they cannot be tied to individuals. As such, all the collected data are deidentified to guarantee the protection of personal data. The deidentified data are published as open data to let third parties reproduce the conclusions of the tests carried out. Finally, Wehe uses servers located around the world, including ones hosted by Measurement Lab (M-Lab). M-Lab collects additional measurement data from clients, but does so in a way that is consistent with Wehe’s protections against collecting personal data. Note that the set of servers and hosts may change over time, but our privacy policy and data protection practices remain the same.
No personal data are either transferred, or exchanged, or rented. In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) n°2016/679, please note that you have the right to oppose, access, rectify, delete, limit or transfer your personal data.
For more details about the app, the research behind it, and analysis of data collected about net neutrality violations, please visit: https://wehe.meddle.mobi .

fdroid:su.mya.mocklock.name: Mock Location that actually works
fdroid:su.mya.mocklock.summary: A reliable mock location provider that actually works to replay GPX tracks.
fdroid:su.mya.mocklock.description:
GPX Mock Location allows you to simulate GPS movement on your Android device by replaying tracks and waypoints from standard GPX files.
The app parses coordinates and timestamps directly from your GPX files, calculating delays between points to replicate real-world movement speeds. Playback runs continuously in a foreground service, allowing location simulation to proceed while using other applications or with the screen turned off.
 Features: 
• Replay GPX routes containing track points (<trkpt>) or waypoints (<wpt>).
• Accurate playback intervals derived from ISO 8601 timestamps.
• Open GPX files via the built-in file picker or directly from external file managers.
• Reliable foreground service with persistent status notification.
• Clean, modern interface built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 dynamic theming.
• Completely offline and privacy-friendly: no tracking, no ads, and no network requests required.
 Setup Instructions: 
To allow the app to inject mock locations:
1. Enable Developer Options on your device (Settings > About phone > tap "Build number" 7 times).
2. Go to Settings > System > Developer options.
3. Tap "Select mock location app" and choose "GPX Mock Location".
4. Open the app, grant the required location permissions, select a GPX file, and press "Start".

fdroid:uk.megalith.lidar.name: Megalith LiDAR
fdroid:uk.megalith.lidar.summary: UK 1 m LiDAR & aerial cropmark monument atlas with OsmAnd GPS exports
fdroid:uk.megalith.lidar.description:
Megalith LiDAR is an open-source field survey atlas of unrecorded Prehistoric, Iron Age, and Roman earthwork candidates across England, detected from 1 m Environment Agency bare-earth LiDAR and 16 m aerial cropmarks.
 Every candidate is cross-checked against 1888–1913 Ordnance Survey Six-Inch maps, Historic England's National Heritage List for England (NHLE), OpenStreetMap archaeology and modern confounders, and Megalithic.co.uk.
 Key Features: 
 Offline Bundled Survey Dataset: Browse Prehistoric barrows, henges, Roman villas/camps/aggers, Iron Age hillforts, settlement enclosures, and rediscovered Scheduled Monuments across English counties with no account or tracking.
 Interactive Multi-Layer Map & 7-Panel Site Inspector: Switch between 1 m LiDAR DTM Bare-Earth Hillshade, 1 m LiDAR RVT Multi-Hillshade, 1 m LiDAR DSM Canopy, 1888–1913 OS Six-Inch maps, Roman Empire Atlas (DARE), BGS 1:50k Bedrock Geology, and aerial imagery, with geo-draped 256 m × 256 m slope, 16 m local relief, canopy, AI probability, and aerial cropmark overlays.
 One-Tap OsmAnd & Field GPS Integration: Export the custom OsmAnd plugin (.osf) with modular GPX track layers, Roman and ancient ridgeway routes, and custom 1 m LiDAR / 1888 OS map sources, or export filtered GPX waypoints directly to OsmAnd, Organic Maps, Garmin, or QGIS.
 Near Me GPS & Field Survey Log: Sort candidates by distance from your live GPS position and record ground-truthing verdicts, Historic Environment Record (HER) references, and field observations locally with JSON import/export.
 Licensed under GNU AGPL v3.0. Contains Environment Agency Open LiDAR data (OGL v3.0), Historic England NHLE data (OGL v3.0), and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

fdroid:wiki.asaf.wikisayit.name: Wiki-Say-It!
fdroid:wiki.asaf.wikisayit.summary: Record word pronunciations and contribute them to Wikimedia Commons and Wikidata
fdroid:wiki.asaf.wikisayit.description:
Wiki-Say-It! lets you record pronunciations of words, names, and phrases in your language and contribute them to Wikimedia Commons , linking each recording from the matching Wikidata item or lexeme form. It brings the flow of the browser-based Lingua Libre to your phone.
 How it works 
 Sign in with your Wikimedia account (OAuth — the app never sees your password) and set up a speaker profile with the languages you speak, your proficiency, and your dialect.
 Build a list of things to record: paste your own words (matched to Wikidata items or lexemes), run a Wikidata SPARQL query, or pull the pages of a Wikipedia category and its subcategories.
 The app skips entries that already have a pronunciation recording, so you only record what's missing.
 Record the list one entry at a time. Auto mode detects when you start and stop speaking and trims silence and background noise automatically.
 Review every take, re-record the ones you don't like, and skip the ones you'd rather not contribute.
 Contribute: recordings are encoded as Ogg Vorbis, uploaded to Commons under CC0, and added to Wikidata as "pronunciation audio" (P443) statements.
 Also 
 Multiple speaker profiles on one device
 Recording statistics by month and year
 Right-to-left interface support; translations welcome via translatewiki.net
 Wiki-Say-It! is free and open-source software (Apache-2.0), written by a volunteer. It has no ads, no analytics, and no tracking; the only network connections it makes are to Wikimedia sites.

flathub:eu.binjr.binjr.name: binjr
flathub:eu.binjr.binjr.description:
binjr is a time series browser; it renders time series produced by other applications as dynamically
 editable graphical representations and provides advanced features to navigate the data smoothly
 and efficiently (drag & drop, zoom, history, detachable tabs, advanced time-range picker).
 It can be use to visualize data from many different sources at once, mixed as part of a single
 representation or on separate but synchronized views, which is especially useful to correlate events
 of different kinds and from multiple sources but sharing a common timeline.
 It aims to be the missing link between the collection of disparate tools (text editors, graphing
 & CLI utilities) traditionally used by developers and researcher to analyse data locally and
 full-blown analytics platforms that centralize logs and telemetry for entire organizations.

Goverlay helps Linux gamers get the most out of their systems by providing an intuitive graphical interface to configure performance monitoring overlays, visual enhancements, DLSS/FSR upscaling, and frame generation in just a few clicks.

flathub:io.github.dubstar_04.design.name: Design
flathub:io.github.dubstar_04.design.description:
Design is a 2D computer aided design (CAD) application built for GNOME.
 Guided by the GNOME philosophy, it aims to deliver a powerful yet simple user experience.
 DXF support ensures seamless interoperability with other CAD tools.
 Features:
 Drawing Tools: Line, polyline, circle, arc, text, and hatch creation.
 Entity Editing: Move, rotate, trim, and extend objects with precision.
 Layer Management: Organize and control visibility of drawing elements.
 Dimensions: Create dimensions with support for dimension styles.
 DXF Support: Use the industry standard DXF format for interoperability.
 Touch Support: Use touch enabled devices to view zoom and pan drawings.

flathub:net.shadps4.shadPS4.name: shadPS4
flathub:net.shadps4.shadPS4.description:
shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator for Windows, Linux and macOS written in C++.
 For ease of use, this Flatpak distribution of shadPS4 bundles the latest stable release
 of the emulator with the official shadPS4 Qt Launcher as a GUI front-end. The launcher in
 the Flatpak distribution is pre-set to use the bundled emulator and cannot download or run
 other versions. If you want the ability to select different versions of shadPS4, please
 download the AppImage release from the shadPS4 website instead.
 The emulator is still early in development, so don't expect a flawless experience. Nonetheless, the emulator
 can already run a number of commercial games.

flathub:net.sourceforge.pdfchain.name: PDF Chain
flathub:net.sourceforge.pdfchain.summary: Graphical interface for the PDF Toolkit (PDFtk)
flathub:net.sourceforge.pdfchain.description:
If PDF is electronic paper, then PDFtk is an electronic staple-remover,
 hole-punch, binder, secret-decoder-ring, and X-Ray-glasses. PDFtk is a
 simple tool for doing everyday things with PDF documents, and PDF Chain
 is a nice frontend application to it.
 Features:
 Merge PDF Documents or Collate PDF Page Scans
 Split PDF Pages into a New Document
 Rotate PDF Documents or Pages
 Decrypt Input as Necessary (Password Required)
 Fill PDF Forms with X/FDF Data and/or Flatten Forms
 Generate FDF Data Stencils from PDF Forms
 Apply a Background Watermark or a Foreground Stamp
 Report PDF Metrics, Bookmarks and Metadata
 Add/Update PDF Metrics, Bookmarks or Metadata
 Attach Files to PDF Pages or the PDF Document
 Unpack PDF Attachments
 Burst a PDF Document into Single Pages
 Uncompress and Re-Compress Page Streams
 Repair Corrupted PDF (where possible)
 ---------- DISCLAIMER ---------- 
 Latest version of this software is very old and so it may contain bugs,
 so to be on the safe side make sure to NOT open any untrusted pdf files
 with it. For this same reason we have limited this application to only
 save files to standard locations: "Downloads", "Documents".
 You can also save to external devices (like USB pendrive).

flathub:org.swi_prolog.swipl.name: SWI-Prolog
flathub:org.swi_prolog.swipl.description:
SWI-Prolog is an open source (BSD-2) implementation of the Prolog language with many extensions.
 It is implemented in C (version 11) and Prolog and is available for many platforms (Linux, practically
 any POSIX like system, MacOS, Windows). All CPUs supported by Debian Linux are supported. A prototype
 running in your browser based on WASM (Web Assembly) is available. (SWI-)Prolog is a versatile
 language. It is being used for business rule validation, natural language processing, software
 verification, software refactoring, network configuration, security, robotics, reasoning in legal
 and medical domains, graph processing, machine learning (ILP, PLP), linked data (RDF), mathematical
 proofs, and much more.

flathub:xyz.hyperplay.HyperPlay.name: HyperPlay
flathub:xyz.hyperplay.HyperPlay.description:
HyperPlay is a Game store and launcher with more than a hundred of games available to play for free while it also supports games from the Epic and GOG store.
 HyperPlay is also the biggest platform for Web3 games and includes native support for MetaMask and WalletConnect so you can use your coins and store your assets or NFTs on the game without the need of leaving it no matter if it is native or browser based games.
 In this aspect, HyperPlay doesn't access your wallet or assets, it just provides the interface through an Overlay to interact with the games and the blockchain on basically any network.
 Play most of your Windows games using Proton or Wine. HyperPlay setups the compatibility layer automatically on first setup but you can also install more versions from the Wine Manager in the app Settings. DXVK, VKD3D, and Winetricks support is also included.
 Seamless wallet integration with MetaMask, WalletConnect, and more
 Play Web3 native or browser games and make transactions without leaving the game
 Have access to your MetaMask Portfolio from the app interface
 Access Epic and GOG games as well
 Play thousands of Windows games and apps using Proton or Wine

firefox-addons:2808829.name: Reddit NSFW Unblocker
firefox-addons:2808829.summary: Unblock and remove these pesky popups and blurs to freely view NSFW content! No login required. Made for the new Reddit (Beta) UI.
firefox-addons:2808829.description:
Unblock and remove these pesky popups and blurs to freely view NSFW content! No login required. Made for the new Reddit (Beta) UI.
With Reddit's new (Beta) UI, browsing through NSFW content requires you to login.
To circumvent this, you can either use old.reddit.com or manually remove and manipulate the page (DOM).
Both ways have their pros and cons, but require some manual intervention.
This extension simply manipulates the DOM for you! It removes popups and blur filters, re-enables scrolling and more to make NSFW content visible.
Supports reddit.com/r/ and reddit.com/user/ links, as well as the official Reddit onion ( reddittorjg6rue252oqsxryoxengawnmo46qy4kyii5wtqnwfj4ooad.onion ).
Create an issue on GitHub if you want more.
The extension (0.4.0+) also removes the "Unreviewed Content" popup that appears on smaller screen sizes (e.g. on mobile). See example pictures or linked source code for more detail.
~~The extension (0.11.0+) also removes a age-verification popup when logged into Reddit.~~
 Note : this unfortunately does not work, as a confirmation by the user is required - Reddit does not (pre)load any content before this happens. Only after the confirmation is given, the page reloads and the content is made available.
 Solution : use the extension only when NOT logged in.
Source code & examples: https://github.com/sixP-NaraKa/reddit-nsfw-unblocker 
The Firefox version is made with manifest v2.
In case it does not work, check the permissions for the extension!
If the extension was helpful, a GitHub star and/or a positive review would be greatly appreciated, thanks!

firefox-addons:794073.name: Undo Close Tab
firefox-addons:794073.summary: Allows you to restore the tab you just closed with a single click—plus it can offer a list of recently closed tabs within a convenient context menu.
firefox-addons:794073.description:
Undo Close Tab allows you to restore the most recently closed tab with a single button click and gives you access to the list of recently closed tabs in a context menu.
 Top features :
 Restore your most recently closed tab with a single click of a toolbar button
 Quick access to up to 25 recently closed tabs in the context menu (right click on toolbar button)
 Optional access to the recently closed tab list in the page or tab context menu
 Integrates nicely with Firefox preset icons and also adapts to nearly every Firefox theme.
 Please note :
 There is a known bug in Firefox which may cause Undo Close Tab to not work at all. To revive the addon, you have to reset your browser session 
 If there are more than 6 items in the "last closed tab history", then a submenu "More items" is created. This is to workaround a technical limitation of the WebExtension API .
 The default setting in Firefox is to only store information for a maximum of 10 closed tabs. If you want to reach the maximum of 25 tabs, which again is a limitation of the WebExtensions API , then you have to increase the value of the browser.sessionstore.max_tabs_undo preference via about:config.
For an overview of changes, here is the extension commit history .

Play heads up with family and friends in an amazing charades and guessing game!
How to play charades in Charades App - Party Game?
Choose a deck from over 100 decks available to play or create your own deck and play as you wish! Place device on forehead e ask your friends to help you guess what is on your device! They can dance, sing, mimes or give you clues... Play whatever you want! Just tilting your phone up (correct) or down (pass) to continue. Easy, right? You just need to guess the word or phrase and guess what your are!
Charades App - Party Game includes decks as
- Guess Movies, TV Series, Cartoons, Animes and TV Shows.
- Guess Songs of today, Cartoons opening themes and more!
- Guess Characters from movies, games, books and cartoons!
- Guess music of your favorite artist!
- DotA 2, League of Legends, The Walking Dead, Game of Thrones, Glee, Supernatural, RBD, High School Musical and more!
- Specific charades to guess: "The Winter is Coming!" (What am I? Ned Stark?)
- Dozens of other things! Play Charades App - Party Game now in English, Spanish, Português and so much more!

Your next party, reunion or family game night will be more fun playing heads up! You will never go bored again when you are hanging out with friends. For all ages!
You can play for free or subscribe to Premium with a weekly, monthly or yearly plan.

With real-time data and personalized insights, you can take control of your health anytime, anywhere. Whether it's managing weight, improving fitness results, or reducing stress, Pulse Analysis makes it simple and efficient. Download now to start your health journey!
Main features:
Real-time heart rate monitoring, recording blood pressure at all times
BMI calculation and analysis
Body hydration tracking
Guided breathing exercises to help you relax
Payment & Subscription Terms 
Subscription Options 
Choose from the following subscription plans for unlimited access to all features: 
- Weekly Subscription 
- Yearly Subscription 
Cancellation & Management 
Cancellation Timing: You may cancel your subscription at any time, but cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period (or trial period) to avoid being charged for the next cycle. 
How to Manage/ Cancel: Subscriptions are managed directly through your Apple account. To turn off auto-renewal or cancel: 
 1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone. 
 2. Tap your name (Apple ID) at the top of the screen. 
 3. Select "Subscriptions" from the menu. 
Required Policies 
Privacy Policy: https://auqr.rayiuk.com/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Service: https://auqr.rayiuk.com/termsOfService.html

bluejetty:00122313:ios.description:
A Fortune telling technique developed a century ago that uses astrology zodiac symbols for Love, Marriage, Relationships, Wealth, Health, The Future & General Advice. With it's usage of the mystical & ancient symbols of astrology this App will appeal to fans and followers of Tarot, Astrology, Numerology, Horoscopes, Pagan religions, Wicca, Divination, modern Witchcraft and those seeking Spiritual insights & life guidance.
A total of 96 Questions with over 1,500 possible answers.
For example; 
"Does the one I am thinking about, think of me? " 
"How will the world use me?"
"What does the man whom I love, really think of me? " 
"What has become of the thing which I have lost?"
"Can I win the love that I desire? " 
"What does the immediate future hold for me? " 
"What have I to expect during the next twelve months? " 
"I wish! Will my wish be fulfilled ? " 
"What do people think of me? " 
Based on the White Magic book published in 1919 by Mrs John Le Breton.
First published 100 years ago, the book has remained in print due to it's profound insights, spiritual life guidance and intuitive wisdom.
Now in digital form it has finally found its true medium.
Very little is known about the author today even though the book has remained in print for almost a century. 
What is clear, from Mrs John Le Breton's legacy, is that she was well educated in metaphysics and left behind a volume of work that is a testimony to the mystery of divination and intuitive powers.
NEW FEATURE!!! - Feeling creative and have a personal or original question, with possible answers, of your own?
Now you can create your own questions and answers to use along with those from the Book of White Magic.

bluejetty:00140383:ios.name: CanPR
bluejetty:00140383:ios.summary: CanPR is a step-by-step guide for Immigration to Canada through Express Entry and other Canada PR, Work Permit, Student, Visitor, Refugee, Asylum, and other Visa processes. The app offers Canadian immigration advice obtained through years o
bluejetty:00140383:ios.description:
CanPR is a step-by-step guide for Immigration to Canada through Express Entry and other Canada PR, Work Permit, Student, Visitor, Refugee, Asylum, and other Visa processes. The app offers Canadian immigration advice obtained through years of personal experience and enhances an applicant's journey to Canada through handy tools, helpful tips, and invaluable recommendations.
CanPR is the most comprehensive guide on immigrating to Canada, especially through the Express Entry PR (Permanent Residence) process. The app provides detailed information—from selecting Canada as a destination, building a profile, tips on improving your Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) scores, to obtaining various visas and guidance on landing as an immigrant (or student or work permit holder) and settling down successfully.
The Digital Canadian Immigration Assistant helps applicants to immigrate to cities such as Toronto (Ontario), Montreal (Quebec), Calgary (Alberta), Edmonton (Alberta), Saskatoon (Saskatchewan), Ottawa (Ontario), Guelph (Ontario), Winnipeg (Ontario/Manitoba), Vancouver (British Columbia), Hamilton (Ontario), and many other Canadian cities through various Provincial Nomination Programs (PNP), including the Atlantic Immigration Program (AIPP).
CanPR also connects you via WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms to discuss topics related to legal Canada immigration processes, Express Entry, Canada VISA, Canada PR landing, IELTS or CELPIP study groups, Canadian job search, financial advice on settling in Canada, Provincial Nomination Programs, education, work permits, refugee/asylum processes, and more.
The app alerts users through push notifications about the latest CRS score draws and features a live news feed from Canada's official Twitter accounts, ensuring you stay up-to-date with the latest immigration news. Additionally, CanPR provides useful links and opportunities to connect with professionals and peers during your Canadian immigration journey.
==== Disclaimer ====
This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or in any way associated with any government agency. The immigration information provided in this app is intended solely for general informational purposes and should not be considered official government advice. The content is compiled from publicly available sources, including official government websites such as the Government of Canada's Immigration and Citizenship website (https://www.canada.ca/en/services/immigration-citizenship.html). However, this app is not an official source of government immigration information, and you should verify details directly with official sources before making any decisions.

bluejetty:00173949:ios.description:
Ready to manage an entire coffee shop chain and harvest your own natural goods in the orchard?
Yes? So Idle Coffee Shop Tycoon is your game! Take the challenge and be in charge of all the details to serve your demanding customers the best coffee in town. Get new ingredients, upgrade your coffee machines, build bakery ovens to cook amazing desserts, or buy smoothie makers. 
Learn from your own experience and become a great coffee shop manager. Expand your premises, discover new recipes, bake food, and offer the community a complete, fancy service!
GROW AND MANAGE YOUR OWN GARDEN:
Show your management abilities by planting, collecting, and using all the local goods in your business! Control the whole production process for the essential ingredients in your coffee and food recipes. Unlock new recipes to increase your seed and coffee beans stock, and trace the most suitable strategy to grow your business!
EXPAND YOUR PRODUCT RANGE: 
Work hard to unlock new recipes for coffee (Cappuccino, Espresso, Mocha, Latte, Iced coffee, Frappe, etc.), but also snacks and food (Cupcakes, Cookies, Cinnamon rolls, Toasts, Sandwiches, etc.). Contact external suppliers and control all the stock to keep your visitors happy and well-served! 
DEAL WITH ONLINE RATINGS:
Keep high standards of service to avoid bad ratings! Impress the VIP customers so they will use their influence to give support to your business. Serve the community professionally, and adapt your business strategy to the feedback you receive. Every detail counts, starting with the quality of the products and ending with the decoration. 
MANAGE YOUR STAFF:
Create the best work environment in all your departments. To have a competent coffee shop chain with franchises around the world, you need the best working teams in all areas. Take the great challenge and make it work!
Main Features: 
- Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
- Innovative mechanics: orchard harvest
- More detailed management system 
- Dozens of objects to be unlocked and upgraded
- Lots of characters and interactions
- Funny 3d graphics and great animations 
- Management of a successful business
- A small living world in miniature

In "Build Brigade: Mighty Machines", you’ll take on the role of a construction tycoon manager, controlling a bulldozer, crane, excavator or
bluejetty:00130419:android.description:
Are you ready to get your hands dirty, drill and collect debris and become a construction tycoon? 
In "Build Brigade: Mighty Machines", you’ll take on the role of a construction tycoon manager, controlling a bulldozer, crane, excavator or a large drill, and the entire site. Your main objective is to dig in and drill and collect rocks with your heavy machine, process resources, construct and building destruction, and improve all components of the site to make it the best construction site in town. But there are more things to do in these construction games!
As you progress through the game with your construction simulator, you’ll face various challenges that will test your skills as a construction manager in one of the coolest building games right now. It won't be difficult as bridge constructor, oil well drilling or build a house! Why? Because you will enjoy the satisfying dig in and drill and collect elements in this build master game so much that you won't put your phone down!
To enhance your abilities and increase efficiency, Build Brigade: Mighty Machines offers a range of power-ups and upgrades for your mining operations in the construction games. You can invest in fuel upgrades to improve your heavy machine fuel efficiency, mechanic upgrades to boost their performance, and truck and excavator upgrades to increase their capacity for carrying materials, dig in and drill and collect resources.
You’ll need to manage resources, mining operations, balance budgets, and make strategic decisions to keep the site running smoothly. Also, upgrade your heavy machines like bulldozer, crane & excavator regularly so you can progress well in your favorite building games.
With a wide variety of machines and tools at your disposal, you’ll be able to customize your site and make it a masterpiece of construction.
So what are you waiting for builder master 3d? 
Gear up and get ready to dig, drill, and construct your way to greatness in Build Brigade: Mighty Machines. Unleash your inner builder master 3d, maximize your earnings, and become the ultimate construction tycoon in this addictive construction simulator game.

bluejetty:00070576:ios.description:
Photo Doctor is specifically designed for you and lets you easily manage your iPhone / iPad at any time, including the following major features:
- Battery and System Analysis
- Network traffic monitoring
- Network Device Scanner (Anti-Freeloader Detection)
- Network Speed Test
- QR code and barcode scanner
- NFC Tools
- Bluetooth Device Finder: locate multiple Bluetooth devices (earbuds, speakers) and save them for future use
- All-in-one Cleaner Guru
- Privacy Vault
- 100+ Widgets
- Photo Toolkit: GIF maker, Live Photo GIF maker, Photo GPS editor, Photo compression, Photo EXIF viewer
- Charging Animation
- Offline Games: Minesweeper, Snake, Sudoku on iPhone/iPad; Minesweeper, Snake, and Ping Pong on Apple Watch
- Support for Apple Watch
Stay informed about your iPhone and iPad with useful tips and solutions for any issues you encounter, and keep your device running at its best!
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Detailed features:
• Battery and System Analysis
- Hardware Information: Accurately retrieve phone and tablet specifications to help determine whether the hardware is original or has been replaced.
- Battery Health: Monitor key metrics such as battery capacity and cycle count. Keep a history of test results and visualize changes over time to track battery health.
- Battery Life Analysis: Break down battery life across multiple dimensions and analyze power consumption in detail.
• Network traffic monitoring
- Set your data plan: track total data allowance and daily usage
- Data usage alert reminders
- Daily traffic usage
- Monthly traffic overview
- Data unit display supports megabytes (MB) and gigabytes (GB)
• Network Device Scanner (Anti-Freeloader Detection)
- Scan your current network and display all connected devices, so you can instantly see if any strangers are piggybacking on your Wi-Fi. Highly recommended—download and try it for free! (^_^)
- Supports device tagging and lets you blacklist unwanted devices directly.
• Cleaner Guru
- One-tap automatic smart cleaning for duplicate photos, GIFs, Live Photos, videos, and screenshots.
- Duplicate photo detection scans your gallery using advanced image comparison algorithms. It not only finds exact duplicates but, more importantly, identifies similar photos to help you manage your library and free up storage space. Give it a try! (^_^)
- Detects and removes duplicate videos.
- Detects duplicate contact information, including repeated names, phone numbers, and email addresses.
- Cleans up calendar spam by removing junk invitations and advertisements.
• Widgets
- Dashboard for device status and network info
- 100+ clock styles
- Launchpad: WeChat, Weibo, Facebook, Twitter; one-tap FaceTime, messages, or email; map pins and websites
- Show custom photos
- Disk space
• Privacy Vault
- Protect photos, videos, voice memos, contacts, notes, files, and passwords
- Pattern lock, PIN, Touch ID, Face ID
- Cloud backup for private contacts and notes
- Disguise the app icon
- Flip device face-down to switch apps instantly
• Apple Watch: iPhone battery, current data use, daily usage this month
• Other features
- Disk storage monitoring
- Safari Browser AdBlock
- Decibel meter
- GPS altimeter and barometer (altitude, pressure, coordinates, compass)
- Live memory monitor
- Screen tests
- Countdown days: track important dates, repeat yearly, monthly, or daily
- iPhone flashlight with SOS, iPad night light, touch magnifier
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually, depending on the plan you choose.

bluejetty:00070715:ios.description:

bluejetty:00039139:ios.description:
«Ароматный Мир» — весь мир изысканных вкусов в вашем смартфоне
За установку приложения начисляем 1 150 бонусов на счёт «Винной карты».
Винная карта, каталог напитков, магазины на карте и другие полезные функции — теперь всё под рукой. Сегодня «Ароматный Мир» — это более 1 000 магазинов формата food & wine в Москве, Санкт-Петербурге и других городах России.
В ассортименте — натуральные продукты: итальянская паста, сыры, мясные деликатесы, консервированные морепродукты, кондитерские изделия и многое другое от ведущих отечественных и зарубежных производителей.
С приложением «Ароматный Мир» вы сможете:
- Участвовать в бонусной программе — копите и тратьте баллы в одно касание.
- Изучать актуальный каталог — смотрите цены, ищите и бронируйте товары в винотеках вашего города.
- Быть в курсе акций — узнавайте первыми о скидках, дегустациях и мастер-классах от сомелье.
- Находить ближайший магазин — смотрите адреса и стройте маршрут в один клик.
Важно: приложение не является онлайн-магазином и не поддерживает продажу или доставку алкоголя. Оно создано для удобного доступа к каталогам, бронированию и акциям.
Только для пользователей старше 18 лет.

Envios.com is the Fast and Easy way to Send Money to your family and friends from the Unites States to Mexico, Central and South America, and the Philippines.

- Send Money to your family and friends.
- Get real time status from your money transfer.
- Get promotions for your money transfers.
- Earn money referring the App to your friends and family
- Make payments for your bills.
- Make Top Ups.
EASY TO INSTALL AND USE
It takes just few minutes to install the App. Download the App, complete the registration form and start sending money. If you are already a registered user of the Envios.com website, you can use the same account and start sending money from the App. 
FAST AND SECURE
Your transaction with Envios.com is 100% Guarantee and Secured or your money is back! Envios.com keeps your information secure and confidential, monitoring transactions and offers dispute resolution if you have a problem with a transaction.
TRANSPARENT FEES AND EXCHANGES RATES
Always know in real time the exchange rate and the amount receive your beneficiaries. Envios.com accepts debit and credit cards as method of payment offering you the most competitive fees.
Questions, notifications, and requests for refunds or further information can be sent to Kwik Dollar LLC dba Envios.com, as follows: info@Envios.com or 1-888-993-4639; or by mail at Kwik Dollar LLC dba Envios.com, Attn: Customer Service, 5851 San Felipe St. Suite 400, TX 77057.

bluejetty:00193585:android.name: Family Nest: Farm Adventure
bluejetty:00193585:android.summary: Family Nest: Family Relics is one of the most popular farm games. Harvest your town and family village! Experience the greatest family adventure in this farming simulator! Quests, tournaments, unions with other farmers – all these you will
bluejetty:00193585:android.description:
Family Nest: Family Relics is one of the most popular farm games. Harvest your town and family village! Experience the greatest family adventure in this farming simulator! Quests, tournaments, unions with other farmers – all these you will find in our klondike adventure games. 
Become the richest farmer and compete with other farmers! 
🚙 Start your amazing farm adventure and immerse yourself in a world of unexpected events and fascinating stories told by charismatic characters. 
👑 Collect all the heirlooms on your family village. Exchange them for exclusive items. 
🏭 Build farm, harvest land, open new factories and recipes – they will help you reach the tycoon wealth. 
📋 Fulfill orders on the trading post or from sea merchants - and get generous rewards. 
🔍 Explore new family island to get more resources for your workshop and production. 
NEW!
🐾 Meet pets and farm animals!
They are loyal companions in all your farming adventures! Your pet will help you clear the way to your cherished goal without wasting your energy. A charming terrier, a graceful cat, a loyal sheepdog... or maybe someone else? Travel and build your dream farm together with your four-legged friend!
NEW!
Dress to impress!
👗 Now you can become a fashion designer and pick out a wardrobe for your character. Wear an outfit according to your mood or change dresses like gloves!
 ‘Here is my farm!’ – so you say and right you are! 
🍎 Grow plants, harvest land, breed farm animals, and decorate your amazing fairy town. In local factories, craft unique goods for your expeditions, orders, and profitable deals with local merchants! 
🏗️ In these construction games, you are the greatest architect! Build houses and bridges, and decorate your villa with the seashore. 
🏆 Compete with other farmers and climb up the tycoon podium. 
Play, enjoy, and have fun
🎮 Play exciting mini-games while awaiting harvest. Time will simply fly. 
🌞 Enjoy beautiful landscapes. In our family adventure village, they are always vivid. Even when the weather outside your windows is nasty. 
🎉 Enjoy the variety of events this farm land has to offer. Find yourself in an underground cave or on a flying island, receive grand rewards, and experience bright emotions.
🖼️ Enjoy excellent 3D graphics and simple intuitive controls. 
💬 Chat with players from all over the world and find true friends. 
🎁 Get daily gifts and bonuses. Get gifts for helping your neighbors. And become even richer! 
🏅 Compete in union ostriches and dolphins tournaments. Get the highest scores and move to the next league, where competition is tougher, and rewards are higher. 
🎨 Our gardening games are not only about farming! Create your dream estate and choose the buildings colors you like. Enjoy the endless freedom of your design solutions. 
Start your family adventure right now! Grow into a farm tycoon and declare proudly ‘My farm is the richest one!’ Explore the basics of farm economics while playing family farm games!

bluejetty:00023073:ios.summary: MySejahtera is a comprehensive mobile application developed by the Ministry of Health Malaysia, serving as an integral tool in the nation's battle against the COVID-19 pandemic. Beyond its role in COVID-19 management, MySejahtera is evolvin
bluejetty:00023073:ios.description:
MySejahtera is a comprehensive mobile application developed by the Ministry of Health Malaysia, serving as an integral tool in the nation's battle against the COVID-19 pandemic. Beyond its role in COVID-19 management, MySejahtera is evolving to actively support Malaysia's broader digital health transformation, embracing innovative self-care solutions, digitized healthcare services, and opportunities to enhance healthcare efficiency and accuracy. MySejahtera will also serve as an interphase with other governmental agency application for ease of user experience.
Key Features:
Vaccination Program: As a crucial component of Malaysia's vaccination drive, MySejahtera allows users to schedule vaccination appointments, receive digital vaccination certificates, and report any adverse effects after vaccination. It streamlines the vaccination process, ensuring the efficient distribution of vaccines.
Healthcare Services: MySejahtera extends its capabilities to empower users with easy access to healthcare services. It provides information on nearby healthcare facilities, allows users to make appointments with healthcare providers, and offers a platform for digital health records. This ensures a seamless and efficient healthcare experience.
Health Information and Updates: MySejahtera provides the latest health information, guidelines, and updates, allowing users to stay informed about the evolving health situations and public health recommendations. The app also advocates for a volunteer program to engage citizens in contributing to public health initiatives and raising health awareness in the community.

Pin Puzzle: Pull Pins Out has a s
bluejetty:00130862:ios.description:
Find yourself the king of puzzle games? Looking for a game that combines relaxation, decompression, brainstorming, visual enjoyment and achievement? Congratulations! You've found Pin Puzzle: Pull Pins Out!
Pin Puzzle: Pull Pins Out has a simple but addictive gameplay that requires a certain amount of skills and experience which can at the same time test your IQ. The game starts out simple enough with just a few pins need to pull, but as you level up and gain experience, you'll need to think more. Be careful! If you are not strategic enough, with a "boom", you lose the game and shall restart it.
In addition to the simple level passing mechanics, Pin Puzzle: Pull Pins Out also offers you a personalized gaming experience. Players will unlock various styles of balls, pins, tracks, trucks, as well as beautiful game backgrounds, dazzling game animation effects and so on. Each player is allowed to design your own personalized game page. 
Game Features:
- Gameplay: Smartly arrange the move order of pins. Then, the ball will fall along the track under the feature of gravity and finally be collected in the truck. Truck with full balls can make a successful drive. Or else, the game will be over. So think before you pull!
- There are both colored balls and gray balls in the game. It should be noted that the gray balls should be colored before falling into the truck. Gray balls can be successfully dyed when they touch colored balls. Take colored balls in your journey instead of gray ones.
- Attention! There will be bombs scattered on the track. Bomb explosions will destroy tracks or trucks, which may cause you to lose balls and finally cannot finish the journey successfully.
You can keep challenging yourself, we will not set limits for you, cuz we've prepared surely enough levels for you to challenge!
Join Pin Puzzle: Pull Pins Out now, spend time with players all over the world and enrich your leisure time!

bluejetty:00120235:ios.description:
Prepare your kid for success during the whole school year with our complete learning course for AGES 2 to 10.
5,000+ activities: GAMES, VIDEOS, WORKSHEETS & QUIZZES
COPPA and FERPA compliant, 100% safe with parental control and no ads.
---------Recommended by The Guardian---------
Over 25,000,000 kids around the world learn with Kids Academy apps!
Talented and Gifted learning academy was created to help identify and nurture the talents of every child from the earliest stage! Hone writing and reading skills, develop a mindset for math, sharpen visual perception and hand-eye coordination - all through engaging gameplay! 
PLENTY OF LEARNING ACTIVITIES
Over 5,000+ educational games, videos, and printables developed by experts in early education:
* Math, writing, phonics, and reading games 
* SORT, MATCH, and CLASSIFY games
* Animated flashcards and mazes
* Augmented reality-based worksheets and off-screen activities
* Topic-related educational videos
* Quizzes to reinforce what you've just learned
COMPLETE EARLY LEARNING COURSE (AGES 2-10)
The app provides a step-by-step learning pathway that lets toddlers develop early skills by moving from elementary concepts to more complex attributes. Kids will start with learning to trace letters and numbers and will gradually move to tasks that require deeper visual, fine motor, and problem-solving skills.
OFF-SCREEN ACTIVITIES
Learn on and beyond the screen! From math to writing, your kids will complete worksheets and get assessed within a few seconds. Use your finger or Apple Pencil (for iPad Pro only) to complete the tasks. Practice off-screen activities in two modes:
* ON SCREEN MODE: complete the worksheet on the screen and get it checked and scored right on the device.
* BACK CAMERA MODE: get printable from your device, complete it and let the device scan it and deliver the results right on the screen.
DESIGNED WITH EXPERTS IN EARLY CHILD EDUCATION
At the core of this early learning app lies the vast expertise of acclaimed child psychologists and educators. Based on rock-solid approaches to preschool education, such as Montessori and Singapore Math, all the activities help to crank up kids’ innate thirst for knowledge and let them experience learning as an exciting process of discovery.
CHESS COURSE TO PUMP UP BRAIN POWER
Chess promotes skills that can be applied to a vast variety of real-world situations and also pumps the brainpower to succeed at school. Video lessons, games, quizzes, and interactive worksheets will help acquire and solidify new skills.
DETAILED LEARNING PROGRESS REPORT
Develop healhty learning routine, understand your child's strengths and weaknesses or just appreciate the hard work with detailed reports.
FEATURES
* A rich, exploratory environment filled with surprises
* Effective motivation and rewards system
* Fancy animated characters and objects from the child’s world
* Easy-to-follow professionally voiced hints
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
* While the app is free to download some of the content is only available as part of subscription-based membership.
* There are several subscription options: Monthly ($19.99/month), Quarterly ($39.99/quarter), and Yearly ($97.99/year).
* All subscriptions include a free trial period of 7 days. This allows you to test the app and cancel it before you are charged if you don't like it.
* All payments are charged to your iTunes account. Subscription starts and renews automatically after the trial period ends unless canceled at least 24 hours before the next billing period.
* You can manage and cancel your subscription at any time via your iTunes account.
* You can read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.kidsacademy.mobi/privacy/
* You can read our Terms of Use here: https://www.kidsacademy.mobi/terms/
* If you have any questions regarding your subscription, don’t hesitate to contact us at info@kidsacademy.mobi

bluejetty:00070554:ios.description:
SLOW DOWN AND SPEED UP ANY SONG
Maybe you’re trying to learn a tricky guitar riff or figure out a new dance routine. Or maybe you want to change the speed of your favourite tracks to lock into the rhythm of your fitness workout. Grooves lets you continuously adjust the speed of any song in the Apple Music catalog, in your iPhone Music Library or Files app to a speed that’s right for you.
PICK ANY SONG
• Change the tempo of any song on Apple Music, in your Music app or Files app without affecting pitch or fidelity
• Access the entire Apple Music catalog of over 100 million songs!
• Play tracks from the Files app, including on Cloud Drive, Dropbox and other cloud services
• Quick access to your recently played songs
ADJUST THE TEMPO
• A simple slider for adjusting tempo
• Select any tempo from -50% to +100%, in 1% increments
• Easily revert to the original tempo with just one tap
• Grooves will remember your chosen tempo until you want to adjust it again
CREATE SETLISTS
• Create unlimited Setlists
• Continuous play from one song to the next
• Set and remember different tempos for different songs
• Combine songs from Apple Music, your Music app and Files app all in the same Setlist
• Create Setlists from existing albums and playlists in your Music app or on Apple Music
REPEAT JUST ONE SECTION
• Select a section of a song and then loop it to make practise easy
• Add sections of a song to a Setlist multiple times and then play them back at different tempos
APPLE WATCH
• Easily control playback, tempo and volume from your wrist
AIRPLAY
• AirPlay support for output to wireless speakers or Apple TV
AND MORE..
• Change the key (transpose up or down) of locally stored DRM-free songs imported into the app or from your Music app. (Missing the pitch controls from the last version? Re-enable them in the Settings app > Grooves. Then swipe left on the album artwork when playing a song)
IMPORTANT NOTE!
* Songs from streaming services other than Apple Music are not supported *

bluejetty:00077498:ios.name: Queue - Find Movies & Shows
bluejetty:00077498:ios.summary:
Queue is the easiest and most fun way to track your movies and shows, discover new things to watch, see where anything is available to stream, and share what you're watching with your friends.
Whether you're watching alone, with a friend,
bluejetty:00077498:ios.description:
Queue is the easiest and most fun way to track your movies and shows, discover new things to watch, see where anything is available to stream, and share what you're watching with your friends.
Whether you're watching alone, with a friend, or planning movie night with someone special, let us be your ultimate companion to what you're watching. Queue is your guide to TV and movies on streaming and in theaters. Whether you're on the couch for some TV Time or to go on a movie marathon, Queue is the ultimate companion for whatever you're watching next.
*See where anything is available to stream, no matter where you are in the world. Queue supports 100+ countries and 200+ streaming services, including YouTube
*Connect your streaming services and automatically pull in your full watch history and everything you're currently watching
*Watch trailers - explore a stream of trailers through the Explore tab to see what's new In Theaters, Coming Soon, Now Streaming, and more
*If you've been tracking on your phone what you want to watch, Copy and Paste your list from Notes, spreadsheet, anything, and in seconds it'll appear on your Queue. Upgrade your watchlist!
*Add the Friends Widget to your home screen to see what your friends are watching. Works best when you both sync your streaming services!
*View all your upcoming premieres and episodes airings on one beautiful calendar view
*Create custom lists to show off your favorites or help keep your organized. You can even invite friends or partners to collaborate on your lists together!
*Swipe with a friend to help you agree on something to watch, or swipe alone build up your Queue
*Don't know what to watch? Save time and use the Spinner to help you decide 
*Never miss a movie or series again with notifications to remind you when titles premiere and new seasons air
*Track your series - we have all the air dates for seasons and episodes to help you stay up to date 
*Unlock fun badges through different challenges in the app
Keep in mind we aren't a streaming service - you still need to have access to streaming services in order to watch the movies and shows you discover on Queue. But if you have streaming services like Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and more, you'll love how Queue keeps your organized for your movies and shows. Whether you watch on a phone, television, computer, or tablet, Queue is the best companion for watching. Become the most knowledgeable movie and show person in your friend group without leaving the sofa. Discover something new, add it to your Queue, see where it's available to stream, then just watch on your favorite device.
We’d love to hear from you! We try to respond to all support emails as quickly as possible. Send your questions, feedback, or just say hi at info@queue.co. 
What’s in your Queue?

Welcome to TEENY TINY TOWN, where you can indulge your inner city planner and craft your very own bustling city! Merge, build, and watch your town flourish before your eyes. Teeny Tiny Town offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying merging experience.
In this captivating puzzle game, your objective is to combine three or more items on the board to construct new structures. Start with humble trees and transform them into majestic houses, and then merge those houses to create even grander residences! Unleash your creativity and witness your town grow exponentially.
As your city thrives, collect gold from your houses to unlock and acquire new items, expanding your options for development. Strategically manage your resources to maximize your town's potential.
Challenge your puzzle-solving skills across multiple levels, each presenting unique obstacles and opportunities. Discover new strategies, overcome hurdles, and master the art of efficient urban planning.
Key Features:
- Easy-to-play & relaxing gameplay
- Engaging levels with diverse challenges to keep you captivated.
- Square and hexagon maps
- Expand your city by merging items and unlock a vast array of structures.
- Compete on global leaderboards
- Achievements
- Relaxing music and ambient sounds
The game supports the following languages: French, Hindi, German, Spanish, Russian, Swedish, Italian, Japanese, Thai, Korean, Portuguese.
Unleash your inner architect and experience the joy of building your own TEENY TINY TOWN! How expansive can you make it before the board reaches its limits?

bluejetty:00019174:ios.description:
A football social app dedicated to let you challenge your friends on a scores’ prediction game. Create a private league or join an official league for the chance of winning incredible prizes
*How do you win points?
After predicting the score:
3 points – got the exact score
1 point – guess a draw or the winning team (except the exact score)
0 points – all other cases
Features overview:
*PLAY AGAINST FRIENDS - PRIVATE LEAGUES
By creating a private league you’re able to get all your friends together around the competitions you decide to play. With an independent leaderboard, a private chat you just need to set the rules… and game on.
*OFFICIAL LEAGUES
Join the official leagues of our partnered brands and clubs and, if your guesses are spot on, get a chance to win multiple prizes.
*GROUP CHAT
Any football addict dream made true. Besides checking the game livescore, the group chat allows you to do as much mind games and trash talk as you see fit. Don’t forget that in a football pitch the rule is “Scores before Bros”.
*WEEKLY CHALLENGE
Participate on Kiss My Score’s weekly challenges. In these exclusive competitions your guesses can be rewarded with prizes.
*LIVESCORE AND STATS
Follow all EuroCup 2020 games livescore, check the starting eleven, and follow the game stats. In the meantime, you can compare your prediction with your friends’ ones and share your opinion of the game in the chat. Everything in real time.
*UPDATED STANDINGS 
Track in app the updated standing of your national team in the European Championship 2020 or of your favorite team in its domestic competition.
More than 21 competitions included: 
European Championship 2020, Premier League, Champions League, Serie A, La Liga... etc
- Do you want to be part of the European cup 2020’ party without leaving your home comfort? 
- If the subject is football, do you think you are the best of your neighborhood and that your friends are clueless? 
- Do you like to make football guesses, to feel the rush of guessing the livescore correctly, while not enjoying taking the risk of losing money? 
If you answered yes to all the questions above, then Kiss My Score – European Championship, is a mandatory app in your mobile device! Download the app now and become a brofessional guesser!

bluejetty:00171544:ios.description:
Smart Guide – Where All Journeys Begin
You Explore, We’ll Guide
SmartGuide is your personal tour guide to the world. Turn your phone into a personal audio tour guide to accompany you on your travel adventures.
Whether you are looking for a self-guided tour, audio traveler guide, city offline maps or you just want to know all the best sightseeing spots, fun activities, and authentic experiences for your travel destination, SmartGuide is the perfect choice for your travel guide needs.
ONE DIGITAL GUIDE APP FOR THE WHOLE WORLD
This personal guide app offers travel guides for over 1000 popular destinations around the world. Wherever your journey may take you, SmartGuide tours will meet you there!
You explore. We’ll guide.
SAFE CONTACT-LESS TOUR GUIDE
Crowded tour groups from all around the world are a prime breeding ground for respiratory viruses and similar bugs. This is not a souvenir you want to bring from your trip. Our virtual tour guide recommends different places to each tourist based on their individual interests and guides you safely outside of the crowds. Stay safe with a self-guided tour.
AUDIO GUIDE
The personal travel planner app is your audio guide to the world that lets you conveniently listen to a travel guide with interesting narratives from local guides that play automatically when you reach an interesting sight. Just let your phone talk to you and enjoy the scenery!
FREE SELF-GUIDED TOURS
SmartGuide won’t let you get lost and you won't miss any must-see sights. City-guide app uses GPS navigation to guide you around the city at your convenience at your own pace, for free. Gone are the days when you had to follow the crowd. Now you can use SmartGuide and travel whenever you want, however you want.
Sightseeing guide for the modern tripwolf on the hunt for undiscovered wonders of nature!
FIND HIDDEN GEMS AND ESCAPE TOURIST TRAPS
With extra local secrets, our guides provide you with inside information about the best spots off the beaten path. Escape the traps when you visit a city and immerse yourself in the culture trip. Get around like a local and discover the actual culture and heritage of any locality!
EVERYTHING IS OFFLINE.
Download your city guide and get the offline maps and guide with our premium option so you have the freedom to roam and discover the world like the tripwolf that you are, without worrying one bit about finding an internet connection. Your travel guide will be available offline in the form of verbal instructions from natives and if you are someone that prefers reading over listening, the transcripts of the audio guides are also available.
Get the most out of your world travel experience by exploring with SmartGuide: Your Personal Travel Audio Guide!
