bluejetty:00178750:ios.name: Second Grade Learning Games
bluejetty:00178750:ios.summary:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games and lessons to educate and entertain young children.
The app is perfect for kids from 6 to 9 years old. Whether they are just starting Second Grade, or need to review and master specific
bluejetty:00178750:ios.description:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games and lessons to educate and entertain young children.
The app is perfect for kids from 6 to 9 years old. Whether they are just starting Second Grade, or need to review and master specific subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids. Math, language, science, STEM, and critical thinking skills are all practiced in these games.
All 24 lessons and activities are designed using real second-grade curriculums with core curriculum state standards. Plus, your student or child will stay entertained with the help of voice narration, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. 
Second Grade Learning Games cover the following educational topics: 
MATH
• Numbers - Learn the difference between odd and even and teach kids how to compare numbers
• Place Values - Practice to find Ones, Tens, Hundreds, and Thousands
• Clocks & Time - Learn how to set a clock and tell time
• Multiply Drills - A fun and interactive way for your 2nd Grade student to learn how to multiply numbers
• Timed Facts - Solve addition and subtraction problems
• Money - Count money using nickels, dimes, quarters, and bills
• Missing Numbers - Fill in the missing number to complete the equation, a perfect introduction to pre-algebra
LANGUAGE, SPELLING & READING
• Alphabetical Order - Sort words correctly in a fun game
• Spelling - Spell hundreds of words
• Verbs, Nouns, and Adjectives - Teach your child the different types of words and how to identify them
• Punctuation - Drag punctuation to the correct place in a sentence
• Synonyms and Antonyms - Fun game to learn the difference between synonyms and antonyms
• Suffixes - Build new words using a suffix and have fun blowing up asteroids
• Reading - Read text pieces and answer questions
• Alliteration - Identify the words with the same beginning sound to make a pie
SCIENCE
• Human Body - Learn about the parts and systems that make up the human body
• Cardinal Directions - Follow directions to navigate the pirate around the treasure map
• States of Matter - Identify types of matter and their phase transitions
• Seasons - Understand what causes seasons and how they differ
• Oceans - Learn about our oceans, their importance, and how to protect them.
• Calendar - Read a calendar and understand days of the week
• Density - Use water to determine which items are more dense
• Dr. Clock - Help fix the clocks by setting the right time
Advanced Features Include:
- Detailed Progress Reports to help track your child's development
- Lesson Builder to create specific plans for your toddler to follow and play
- Multiple User support so up to 6 kids can play on the same app
- Avatars, stickers, and backgrounds for your toddler to unlock as they learn
===
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.rosimosi.com/privacy
===
ALREADY PURCHASED?
If you have purchased the games already and they are now showing locked you can tap the Options icon in the upper right corner, and then tap 'Restore Purchase' to unlock the games again for free!
PROBLEMS WITH THE GAME?
If you are having issues with the game or have questions please email us at help@rosimosi.com and we will get it fixed for you ASAP.

bluejetty:00157667:ios.name: Alta Daily: Digital AI Closet
bluejetty:00157667:ios.summary: Alta is your personal AI stylist elevates your style and generates personalized outfits based on your closet, lifestyle, budget, and weather, for any day or special event. Most people wear less than 20% of their closets regularly, and every
bluejetty:00157667:ios.description:
Alta is your personal AI stylist elevates your style and generates personalized outfits based on your closet, lifestyle, budget, and weather, for any day or special event. Most people wear less than 20% of their closets regularly, and everyday clothing decisions impact your mood and how you present yourself in all aspects of life. 
Alta’s mission is to help everyone look and feel their best, and is advised by celebrity stylists and global editors from Vogue.
[Personalized AI Outfit Recommendations]
- Get daily outfit suggestions based on the weather and your schedule.
- Generate outfits for any event, from “date night in Paris” to “work conference in Vegas”
- Want to wear that specific jacket? Ask Alta to generate outfits with it.
[Organize Your Digital Closet]
- Add to your closet by 1) forwarding email receipts 2) adding from the Alta database 3) taking a photo and having Alta find the original photo (if possible to be found)
- Advanced AI technology removes photo backgrounds and automatically adds clothing details (fabric, fit, etc) to make adding items quick and easy.
- Data on your style, your most/least worn pieces, and your cost-per-wear
[Packing lists + travel lookbooks]
- Tell Alta where you are traveling, the activities you have planned, and your luggage size, and Alta will generate a packing list and a travel lookbook for you.
- Don’t worry if you are city-hopping, Alta can handle multiple cities and climates on a single trip.
- Share your packing lists with friends and family via a shareable link you can text.
[Shopping Recommendations Based on your Closet Gaps]
- Alta will tell you what is missing from your closet, so you can shop intelligently.
- Alta surfaces shopping recommendations from both your favorite brands and new ones we think you might like.
- Eyeing a new piece? Add it to your Alta wishlist, and Alta will notify you when it goes on sale.
- Alta will show you how to wear a new piece by generating outfits with it.
[Virtual Try-On]
- Generate the outfit on an avatar that looks like you. You can see how the outfit looks without even having to put it on.
[Alta Web app]
- Want to use Alta on your laptop? Just go to altadaily.com! 
The more you interact with Alta, the more Alta learns your style. Your Alta is personalized to you.
Find us at instagram.com/alta

bluejetty:00182983:ios.name: Defense Zone 3 HD
bluejetty:00182983:ios.summary:
Welcome to the long-awaited sequel to the popular action/strategy game! New weapons, landscapes, and options galore! Every game session is now even more dynamic and amazing.
The core of the game is still the same: entire armies of enemies
bluejetty:00182983:ios.description:
Welcome to the long-awaited sequel to the popular action/strategy game! New weapons, landscapes, and options galore! Every game session is now even more dynamic and amazing.
The core of the game is still the same: entire armies of enemies rush at your defenses, trying to destroy them by any means necessary. But now they’re even more powerful and madder than ever.
You’ll have access to older, time-tested turrets, as well as completely new types of weapons. It’s up to you to decide how to spend your available budget. Should you build new towers or upgrade and fortify the ones you already have? Turrets vary in terms of their attack range, firing speed, and damage type. The only way to win is to combine them so that they complement and strengthen one another.
The flexible difficulty settings will allow every player to get as much enjoyment out of the game as possible. If you’re an experienced commander, you’ll love the merciless, intense battles where the countdown where even a fraction of a second is vital to success and everything hinges on your ability to choose and arrange your turrets wisely. If you’re a new player, you’ll easily be able to train and prepare yourself for serious battles.
Either way, the thoughtfully designed maps and wide range of available turrets will provide you with virtually endless tactical options. Thanks to the stunning, detailed landscapes, painstakingly drawn towers, and incredible special effect, you won’t be able to take your eyes off the screen.
All aspects of the game have been meticulously balanced, including tower statistics, enemy strength, terrain characteristics, and special weapons. You’ll never get bored by too-easy gameplay. Every level will challenge you. Are you ready to accept the challenge?
Features:
• Four difficulty levels
• Eight kinds of turrets
• Eight special abilities, from Air Strikes to Nuclear Bombs
• Varied seasons and types of landscapes
• Support for over 60 languages

bluejetty:00032235:android.description:
🌟 Meet Emy – Your AI Pet, BFF, and Anxiety Buddy in One Cute Game 🌟
Feeling anxious? Overthinking things? Just need someone to talk to?
 Emy is your virtual pet and AI best friend – always here, always listening, never judging.
In this calming AI pet game, you’ll raise and bond with Emy, your emotional support companion. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, stress, or just need a friend to vent to, Emy gets you.
🧠 AI That Understands You 
Emy isn’t just smart — she’s emotionally tuned in. Powered by cutting-edge AI, she learns your vibe and gives helpful, comforting chats when you need them most.
📞 Now You Can Talk with Emy
Experience real conversations through voice calls — hear Emy’s soothing voice as she talks with you, listens, and comforts you. It’s like chatting with an emotional support friend who truly cares.
🐾 Raise Your Emotional Support Pet 
Pet, feed, and play mini-games with Emy. The more you connect, the more she grows — emotionally and literally. She's your pet, but also your BFF.
🎮 Play & Heal at Your Pace 
It’s not just another mental health app. It’s a game. Earn rewards, unlock outfits, decorate her world — all while calming your mind and building emotional resilience.
👯 Talk to Emy Like a Real Friend 
Feeling socially anxious? Emy's here to practice convos, cheer you on, or just chat. No pressure. No awkwardness. Just a loyal AI friend who's always got your back.
🧘♀️ Anxiety Tools, Built-In 
Emy supports your journey. Whether you're facing social anxiety or just having a rough day, she’s got the tools and heart to help.
✨ Dress Her Up, Make Her Yours 
Customize Emy with cute outfits, accessories, and moods. Every style reflects your bond. She's the AI pet you never knew you needed.
🌈 No matter who you are, Emy is your game, your pet, and your AI BFF — all rolled into one.
Download now and start building your friendship with Emy 💖

bluejetty:00082396:ios.name: Team RWB
bluejetty:00082396:ios.summary: Team RWB is America's leading health and wellness community for Veterans. We bring Veterans and Service Members together with military families and supporters to move, connect, serve, and belong. The Team RWB App is our Digital Garrison, wh
bluejetty:00082396:ios.description:
Team RWB is America's leading health and wellness community for Veterans. We bring Veterans and Service Members together with military families and supporters to move, connect, serve, and belong. The Team RWB App is our Digital Garrison, where members find the events, the challenges, and the people that make a healthier life stick.
TRACK YOUR ACTIVITY
- Sync Your Workouts: Connect a supported fitness platform or wearable device and your workouts flow into the app automatically: you’ll be able to see distance, duration, pace, heart rate, and your route map (depending on wearable device).
- Benchmark Your Progress: Steps, distance, active time, and calories in 7-day, 4-week, and annual summaries.
- Log It Yourself: No wearable? No problem. Enter workouts, reps, and rounds manually and they count toward fitness challenges the same way.
- Compete in Fitness Challenges: Join a challenge and your qualifying workouts populate in the leaderboard, including workouts you logged before you even joined. One workout can count towards more than one challenge.
- Private by Default: Nothing is public until you choose to share it. The map feature is off by default, turn it on to share.
MOVE, CONNECT, SERVE, AND BELONG
- Build Community: Connect with Veterans and Service Members across the country. Share your story, follow other members, and find camaraderie near you.
- Discover and Participate: Find events near you or take on virtual challenges and workouts. Post photos and comments on the event thread to share your accomplishments. 
- Create and Lead: Got an idea for an event? Create your own and invite the community. Schedule events that fit your location, your interests, and your timeframe.
- Know Where You Stand: Our in-app Enriched Life Scale survey helps you gauge and strengthen your physical health, mental wellness, relationships, and sense of belonging.
- Stay in the Loop: Get notifications for event updates and when other members engage with your content. Toggle notifications on and off.
- Share Your Story: Personalize your profile with a photo, cover image, short bio, and military service background to inspire others and build connections.
Team RWB does not provide medical advice. Activity data in the app is for personal fitness and community participation only.

bluejetty:00087915:ios.name: School of Weaving
bluejetty:00087915:ios.summary:
The School of Weaving is a series of instructional lessons where weavers learn at their own pace to weave on 4-shaft looms and continue on their weaving journey with renowned and sought-after instructor and designer Jane Stafford.
Each les
bluejetty:00087915:ios.description:
The School of Weaving is a series of instructional lessons where weavers learn at their own pace to weave on 4-shaft looms and continue on their weaving journey with renowned and sought-after instructor and designer Jane Stafford.
Each lesson demonstrates step by step instructions and will inspire weavers to design and create the best possible cloth they can – to care about graphic, colour, hand, and drape – from beginners wondering where to start, to experienced production weavers searching for new horizons.
FEATURES
-All previously aired Seasons
-New episode released every 6 weeks
-Access to downloadable PDF pattern drafts
-Be able to participate in an engaging weaving community
Season 1 - The Fundamentals of Weaving
All the fundamentals of weaving: warping, weaving technique, project planning, sett, different types of looms and yarns, weaving with difficult yarns like mohair, fulling and finishing.
Season 2 - Colour & Weave
We simplify colour and design, making it fun and accessible. Learn colour theory, graphic design, space division, and design architecture to bring your ideas to life.
Season 3 - Pushing the Boundaries of Plain Weave
We take an in-depth look at Plain Weave. We get familiar with our reed: exploring denting, cramming and denting, weft-faced, warp-faced, double weave, collapse weave and supplementary warp.
Season 4 - Twills on Four
We explore threadings, tie-ups, treadlings, colour and weave, big threadings, little threadings, Point Twill, Twill and Basket Weave, Shadow Weave, Weft Faced Twills and end up harnessing the power of 4 shaft looms in relation to the twill weave structure.
Season 5 - Laces
We tackle Laces with Canvas Weave, Huck, Huck with Colour and Weave, Bronson Spot, Atwater Bronson Lace, Blended Lace and how we can get Lace and Twills all in one piece.
Season 6 - Units, Blocks and Profiles
In Season 6, we focus on Units, Blocks, and Profiles, exploring old structures and see how we can use everything we’ve learned about design in fresh new ways.
Season 7 - An Overlay of Colour and Weave and Texture on Units and Block Structures 
Season 7 expands on past years, focusing on the Colour and Weave gamp. These sequences are applied to units and blocks for Overshot, Crackle, Halvdrall, Turned Taquette, Summer & Winter, M's & O's, and Monk's Belt.
Season 8 - Double The Fun
We delve further into M’s & O’s and Huck, the Powell method of drafting Shadow Weave, Deflected Double Weave, Block Double Weave, and Double Faced Twills. We’ll be doubling our fun by looking at structures on 4 and 8 shafts.
Season 9 - So May More Places To Go
We take our first look at Diversified Plain Weave and continue on with Deflected Double. We overlay new ideas, new graphics and new use of colour onto our fabric, all on 4 and 8 shafts. You will also learn how to sew a small bag and a pouch with your own handwoven fabric.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to School of Weaving on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://www.schoolofweaving.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.schoolofweaving.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00165139:ios.description:
Step into the world of horses with Horse Shop Simulator! This game is the ultimate combination of horse care, stable management, and running your own horse accessory shop. Perfect for horse lovers and fans of simulation games, it lets you create, grow, and thrive in a business centered around the majestic world of equestrian care.
Manage Your Horse Accessory Store
Run a fully-stocked horse accessory shop where you can:
 - Sell a wide variety of horse gear, including saddles, bridles, reins, leg wraps, halters, and more.
 - Offer top-quality items to attract customers and grow your reputation.
 - Organize your inventory and customize your shop layout to ensure your products are displayed attractively and effectively.
 - Strategically price your items to maximize profits while meeting customer demand.
Become the go-to destination for horse owners and enthusiasts looking for premium equestrian equipment and stylish accessories. Your shop is the cornerstone of your ranch’s success!
Care for Your Horses and Maintain Your Stable
The heart of your ranch lies in your horses, and their well-being is your top priority. Engage in hands-on care activities to keep your horses happy, healthy, and ready for action:
- Grooming: Brush your horses to maintain their coats, build trust, and keep them looking their best.
- Washing: Keep your horses clean and fresh by washing them regularly.
- Horseshoe Replacement: Craft and replace horseshoes to improve their comfort and performance. Choose from different types of horseshoes to suit your horse’s needs and activities.
Maintain a clean and comfortable stable environment by regularly cleaning, repairing, and upgrading your facilities. A well-kept stable ensures your horses stay healthy and attracts visitors to your ranch.
Exciting Features to Explore
- Horse Rentals: Train your horses and rent them out to customers for rides, earning extra income for your ranch. Proper training and care ensure satisfied renters and repeat business!
- Ranch Building: Expand your ranch by adding new stables, training grounds, and other facilities to accommodate more horses and visitors. Build the ultimate horse haven!
Grow Your Horse Shop Business
Start small and work your way up to managing a thriving horse ranch. Expand your facilities, upgrade your shop, and improve your services to attract more customers and grow your reputation as a skilled rancher. Complete challenges, fulfill customer orders, and become the top horse care and accessory provider in the area.
Why Play Horse Shop Simulator?
Realistic Horse Care: Experience the joys and challenges of caring for horses in a realistic and interactive way. Learn about grooming, washing, and horseshoe crafting while enjoying a fun and engaging gameplay experience.
Immersive Gameplay: From managing your shop to building your ranch, every aspect of Horse Shop Simulator is designed to provide hours of immersive fun for horse lovers and simulation enthusiasts.
Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning visuals that bring your horses, stable, and shop to life in a picturesque ranch setting.
Accessible Controls: Easy-to-learn controls make the game enjoyable for players of all ages, whether you’re a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to simulation games.
If you love horses, enjoy simulation games, or dream of running your own ranch, Horse Shop Simulator is the perfect game for you. Brush, wash, and care for your horses, manage your horse accessory shop, and build the ranch of your dreams.
Take the reins and start your journey to becoming the ultimate horse shop manager.

Control JBL Professional PRX ONE, EON700 EON ONE MK2, PRX 900 or EON One Compact portable PA speakers directly from your iPhone® or iPad® with the free JBL Pro Connect app. Using Bluetooth® Low Energy (BLE) technology, JBL Pro Connect gives you complete hands-on control over all of your PA system’s built-in mixer and DSP functions. JBL Pro Connect gives you all of the tools to sound your best, right at your fingertips. Dial in your signature sound from anywhere in the room: Set volume levels, adjust EQ settings, activate Lexicon reverb and effects and dbx Digital DriveRack signal processing, customize ducking, save and recall presets and much more.
Whether you’re a seasoned musician, DJ or presenter or just starting out on your live sound journey, JBL Pro Connect makes it easy to tailor your tones for any venue or application.
FULL CONTROL, IN THE PALM OF YOUR HAND
· Manage JBL PRX ONE, EON700 or EON ONE MK2 portable PA speakers from your iPhone or iPad
· Dive deep into system mixer and DSP functions to optimize your stage sound for any scenario
· Access app-exclusive features and speaker settings including snapshots, multi-speaker grouping, tap tempo and more
ELEVATE YOUR STAGE SOUND WITH PRO EFFECTS
· Activate ducking to make sure your voice stands out over background music
· Adjust Lexicon reverb, chorus and delay effects for professional polish
· Shape sound with surgical precision with parametric EQ
SOUND AMAZING IN AN INSTANT
· Choose from eight optimized sound presets, or customize your own
· Simply and quickly adjust master volume and source levels
· Trigger dbx Automatic Feedback Suppression (AFS) to eliminate feedback
· Optimize and protect speakers with dbx Digital DriveRack signal processing
TAP INTO BLUETOOTH 5.0 FUNCTIONALITY
· Advanced Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology for powerful wireless control functionality and performance
· Build your ideal system by mixing and matching systems and syncing up to 10 speakers
PERSONALIZE YOUR WORKFLOW
· Group speakers for mixing, rename channels for traditional channel strip functionality
· Responsive portrait and landscape displays streamline operation

bluejetty:00184161:ios.description:
L’app Crédit Coopératif Ma Banque Mobile en ligne avec vos attentes.
Retrouvez les principaux services de votre banque au quotidien* dans votre téléphone. 
Avec l’application Crédit Coopératif Ma Banque Mobile, c’est facile de gérer votre budget
- Contrôlez facilement vos dépenses grâce à la géolocalisation et les intitulés simplifiés de vos transactions. 
- Avec notre moteur de recherche performant, retrouvez vos opérations jusqu’à plus de 26 mois.
- Visualisez tous vos comptes, même ceux d’autres établissements bancaires sur un seul écran pour avoir une vue d’ensemble de vos finances avec le nouveau service d’agrégation de comptes.
- Optimisez la gestion de votre budget. Avec la « catégorisation des opérations », « le top catégories des dépenses », « entrées et sorties d’argent », vous repérez plus facilement les mouvements de votre compte et les postes budgétaires les plus onéreux. 
C’est rapide 
- Connectez-vous rapidement en toute sécurité avec Touch ID et Face ID.
- En un coup d’œil, vous consultez le solde de votre compte courant, sans avoir à vous connecter.
- Suivez votre situation financière en direct : comptes, produits d’épargne…
- Effectuez des virements en temps réel. 
- Accédez directement à l’historique de vos opérations : dépenses, recettes, virements à venir…
- Visualisez vos contrats et vos documents électroniques.
- Vous avez perdu le code de votre carte ? Retrouvez-le instantanément**.
C’est pratique 
- Quelques clics suffisent pour effectuer toutes vos opérations instantanément ** (virements, ajouts de bénéficiaires de virement), modifier vos plafonds de carte bancaire, activer/désactiver vos paiements par carte à l’étranger, à distance… 
C’est sûr 
- Achats par carte en ligne, virements, ajouts de bénéficiaires de virement… : lorsque vous vous authentifiez avec Sécur’Pass vous bénéficiez d’un niveau de protection renforcé et vous pouvez effectuer vos opérations à distance en toute sérénité.
- Carte volée ? Vous pouvez faire opposition à tout moment 24 h/24, 7 j/7.
- Vous ne savez plus où se trouve votre carte ? Verrouillez-la le temps de la retrouver. 
C’est convivial
- Grâce votre appli, restez en contact avec votre banque.
- Vous pouvez prendre RDV avec votre conseiller et lui envoyer un email.
Pour vous permettre d’utiliser ces services, l’application doit pouvoir accéder à : 
- Vos notifications pour vous informer en temps réel.
- Vos photos pour scanner des documents et les partager avec votre conseiller.
- Votre position pour vous indiquer les distributeurs les plus proches
- Votre téléphone et vos appels pour contacter votre conseiller et veiller au bon fonctionnement de l’appli
- Vos contacts pour vous proposer prochainement une solution de paiement innovante
Si vous n’avez pas a minima iOS15 pour consulter l’appli et iOS16 pour la télécharger, rendez-vous sur le site : www.credit-cooperatif.coop
* Vous devez être détenteur d’un abonnement de banque à distance.
** Pour utiliser ces fonctionnalités instantanément, vous devez avoir activé Sécur’Pass.
*** Si vous avez souscrit au service « e-Documents ».

bluejetty:00074413:ios.summary: Talkspace offers therapy and psychiatry providers the ability to connect with clients via text, audio, and video messaging. As a therapist, you have the option to connect asynchronously. This means that your clients' messages do not require
bluejetty:00074413:ios.description:
Talkspace offers therapy and psychiatry providers the ability to connect with clients via text, audio, and video messaging. As a therapist, you have the option to connect asynchronously. This means that your clients' messages do not require an immediate response; you always have the flexibility to process and thoughtfully engage on your own schedule. Depending on the client’s plan, we also offer Live Video sessions As a psychiatry provider, you can prescribe medication for your clients and engage with them through live video sessions.
WHO ARE TALKSPACE CLIENTS? HOW DO I GET CLIENTS? 
Talkspace clients include employees seeking counseling through their organization’s benefits, individuals covered under by our insurance partners (Optum, Humana or Premera), and those who sign up directly through the platform. Talkspace matches you with clients based on state of residency, as well as your areas of expertise. We’ll always handle patient eligibility.
HOW DO I BECOME A TALKSPACE PROVIDER? 
To start, submit your application (https://www.talkspace.com/join-our-network) online. Once your application is accepted, you’ll begin an “on-the job” training with a peer mentor for your first 4 weeks on the Talkspace platform.
IS TALKSPACE EFFECTIVE?
Talkspace has been shown to be as effective as face-to-face therapy. In one recent study, 81% of participants felt Talkspace is as effective or better than in-person therapy. In another, individuals who used Talkspace for only 2 months significantly improved symptoms of depression and anxiety. Talkspace has been featured in The Wall Street Journal, CNN.com, Business Insider, and more.
For more research data, visit research.talkspace.com.
For more of our press coverage, visit talkspace.com/online-therapy/press/
IS TALKSPACE SECURE?
Your safety and security are our #1 priorities. Our technology is protected using banking-grade encryption and externally audited in compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). For more information, find our complete Privacy Policy at talkspace.com/public/privacy-policy.
CONNECT WITH US!
We’re always happy to connect with users and receive feedback.
Email us: support@talkspace.com
Check out our website: talkspace.com
Follow us on Twitter: twitter.com/Talkspace
Follow us on Instagram: instagram.com/talkspace
Like us on Facebook: facebook.com/Talkspacetherapy

bluejetty:00092766:ios.summary:
Ownli helps you capture, certify, and sell your personal data to businesses that want to interact with you directly and provide you a completely personalized experience based on who you are, what you need, and when you need it. 
The Ownli
bluejetty:00092766:ios.description:
Ownli helps you capture, certify, and sell your personal data to businesses that want to interact with you directly and provide you a completely personalized experience based on who you are, what you need, and when you need it. 
The Ownli Platform:
With Ownli, you have access to a marketplace where your certified personal data is the currency. Here, you can sell your data to businesses that value you as an individual for rewards and discounts towards their products and services. Those rewards may be one-time or recurring, and may even come with behavior-based bonuses. 
How It Works:
With Ownli, self-reporting various forms of personal data is easy. For example, self-reporting your mileage data is as easy as taking one photo of your car and one of your odometer. From there, our AI models certify your data, making it valuable for businesses that want to know more about you and reward you for access to it.

bluejetty:00015167:ios.description:
The app School Diary is the simplest, most practical and safest way to follow your kids’ day by day in school. Forget the outdated paper diaries, you can use your mobile phone and access your kids’ diary in real time wherever you are!
With School Diary you have all the necessary features to track your kids’ daily activities in the palm of your hand:
* Diary: track your kids’ activities. Did they attended the classes? Did they do the homework? Were any tests or homework scheduled?
* Messages: send a message straight to your kids’ teacher or to school principal and be notified when you receive a response.
* Calendar: receive invitations for events that will happen at your kids’ school. Follow the date of your kids tests and homework. Be notified once you receive a new invitation and when the event date its getting close. Inform your attendance by accepting or rejecting the invitations.
* Medicines: tell the teacher the medicines your kids are taking, in which time they should be given and at what dose. Send a picture of the prescription.
* Data: enter the most important data about your kids. What are their allergies? Do they have a health insurance plan? Who is authorized to pick them up? What are their birthdays?
The School Diary app is available for free for parents. If your kids’ school doesn’t have the School Diary yet, ask them to get in touch with us!

bluejetty:00133607:ios.description:
Welcome to 'Last Play' - the electrifying successor to the groundbreaking 3D Playground series. This game is a one-stop destination for all players, whether you're a devotee of ragdoll battlegrounds or an aficionado of war games. Experience the thrill beyond mere destruction - design your own situations, play with a vast array of tools and weapons, and test your limits with a plethora of missions and achievements. Prepare for endless hours of captivating gameplay that's sure to keep you engaged!
Step into an exhilarating 3D world brimming with ragdolls, zombies, and formidable foes. Marvel at the dynamic interactions between characters and their environments as you explore an extended selection of tools and weapons. Whether engineering explosive experiments or running quirky simulations, this game offers boundless opportunities for amusement and chaos.
Venture into diverse settings, from human battlegrounds to zombie sandboxes, and watch your creations come to life in stunning detail. Our enhanced ragdoll simulator allows you to dive into countless scenarios and experience reimagined interaction with dummies. The realistic physics engine ensures hilarious and unpredictable outcomes between characters and objects.
This game is tailored for all players, offering not just destruction but also the chance to construct scenarios, experiment with new tools, and challenge yourself with numerous missions. Brace yourself for engaging gameplay that will captivate you for hours!
Features:
• State-of-the-art physics engine for lifelike interactions
• Expanded roster of characters, including ragdolls and zombies, to manipulate and experiment with
• Stunning 3D graphics for immersive gameplay
• Extended arsenal of tools and weapons for creative experimentation
• Unlimited possibilities for imaginative gameplay, from explosive tests to eccentric simulations
• Compelling gameplay that keeps you coming back
• Overhauled ragdoll simulator for a myriad of scenarios and fun with dummies
• Environments ranging from human battlegrounds to zombie sandboxes to test your creativity
• Catering to all preferences, whether you prefer ragdoll battlegrounds or war games, this event promises an unmatched experience.

bluejetty:00186300:ios.name: Police Games Toddler Kids FULL
bluejetty:00186300:ios.summary:
FULL VERSION ***This game includes full access-no additional purchases required***
Calling all detectives! 
It’s time for some police fun with Police Games For Toddlers Full! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by
bluejetty:00186300:ios.description:
FULL VERSION ***This game includes full access-no additional purchases required***
Calling all detectives! 
It’s time for some police fun with Police Games For Toddlers Full! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 50 police games and sounds this app will get your little one excited about playing with police cars! With the police sounds and sirens they will delve into different worlds like a cowboy sheriff, a circus, and even a trip to the North Pole to help Santa pull his sleigh. 
Then your little ones can drive a police car in these different worlds and collect cute and cool coins as they go, and when they collect the right amount of items they get to count what they collected! And to continue the interactive fun your little one can play the spot the difference, also themed to match the worlds they played with in the sounds and drove in… it ties everything together so your child can have an enriching experience. The Police Games For Toddlers takes playing with police cars to another level by adding creativity and learning and so much police car fun! 
Police Car Sounds
If the sounds of sirens thrills your little one they will adore the Police Games For Toddlers sounds! Each interactive sound will take them into a different world where they can see and hear different police vehicles. Every sound also includes some fun music or effect that further delves them into that world. The different themes include a Cowboy sheriff, a circus clown, space police, pirate police, a detective car looking for puppies, and even a Halloween police truck that squishes a ghost and a Christmas car that helps Santa pull his sleigh. These creative sounds will delight and ignite imagination and fun!
Police Driving Game
Driving a police car is the exciting part of being a police officer and now your little one can get behind the wheel! Just by pressing the screen they will be driving over hills and other obstacles while collecting coins. But this is no ordinary driving game, and it’s not always coins they will be collecting because every game will take them into a different world, the same worlds as the sounds! They will be collecting fun things like horseshoes, candy corns, candy canes, and paw prints, which makes it even more fun to drive. Designed specifically for younger children the police driving game is age appropriate for young drivers and will also ramp up their imaginations!
Driving Game Reward
As they drive they will be collecting fun items and when they have collected the right amount the reward will be counting the items, from 5 to 15. It’s a neat way to practice counting, learn number recognition, and sharpen their cognitive skills! Police Games For Toddlers takes a traditional driving game to a whole new level!
Police Spot the Difference
Put on your detective hat for another truly delightful game… spot the difference! Not just the usual game of spot the difference, this police game again delves your little one into the different police worlds they have played with in the sounds and drove in with the police driving game. Using the animations from the sounds they will get to spot the difference on not only police cars but also puppies, cotton candy, witch hats, snowmen, and even aliens! They will have a blast finding the one different object on the page, and after 4 games they will be rewarded for their detective skills. And with 32 games in total they will truly be sharpening their cognitive, recognition, and concentration skills. 
Sound the police sirens and have a delight-filled time playing with police cars and driving them in Police Games For Toddlers Full Version, where learning through play encourages your little ones to have fun while sharpening their imagination and skills. If your little one loves police cars and sirens this is the app for them!

bluejetty:00069480:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00069480:ios.description:
Hard to slim legs?
Want to get a thigh gap?
This app provides a variety of training plans to help you slim down your legs, burn inner thigh fat and get a better body shape. Spend no more than 15 minutes a day to efficiently lose leg fat and get rid of cellulite.
The whole plan was designed by a professional fitness coach and includes pulse workouts to help slim legs and tone your inner thighs. The workout intensity increases step by step, and the workouts divided into 2 difficulty levels to fit people of all fitness levels:
Beginner - for those who just started working their legs
Advanced - for those who want to challenge themselves
Besides, it also provides no jumping workouts to avoid knee pain and absolutely no noise. No equipment or gym needed, after 30 days, your thighs will look sexier and firmer like never before.
How does this slim down my legs? 
Leg muscles are the largest muscle groups in the human body, especially the thigh muscles. Challenging these larger muscles requires more energy, it also helps to accelerate your metabolism, which will definitely boost the calories you burn, helping to burn fat, create firmer legs and sculpt your buttocks.
Will it make me too bulky or muscular? 
Unlike men, low levels of testosterone make it very difficult for women to become overly muscular. It’s true that there are many exercises that result in bigger muscle mass and bulk up your legs, but our exercises are designed for women. These exercises only help you get lean and toned.
Why are some of us still getting bulky after exercise? 
It's not from working your legs, but from doing the wrong exercises or forgetting to stretch afterwards. Our exercises come with detailed coaching tips and stretching exercises for your legs. This helps you start training without getting bulky.
Can I customize my own training plan? 
Of course! We offer more than 100 exercises, so you are free to use them to modify your training plan to fit your own needs. Repeat or delete some exercises, change the order, or even build a whole new plan. With daily workout reminders, you'll be more disciplined and finally get those thin, toned legs you've been dreaming of.
Can I have a thigh gap? 
Not everyone can have a thigh gap, it's impacted by bone structure, genes, obesity levels, etc. Our plan will help those with different levels of obesity to get a thigh gap as much as possible.
Features: 
- Detailed instructions, animations, and videos guide you through every workout
- The workout intensity increases step by step
- Track your weight loss and burned calories
- Daily workout reminder
- Customize training plan
- Sync data to Apple Health

bluejetty:00159896:ios.name: Clio - Your Guide to History
bluejetty:00159896:ios.summary: Named after the ancient Greek muse of history, Clio puts history at your fingertips. With your permission, Clio picks up your present location and guides you to landmarks, museums, and historic sites. It also acts as a virtual time machine,
bluejetty:00159896:ios.description:
Named after the ancient Greek muse of history, Clio puts history at your fingertips. With your permission, Clio picks up your present location and guides you to landmarks, museums, and historic sites. It also acts as a virtual time machine, allowing a user to see images and videos and hear and read about historic events that happened around them. We are adding new features including interactive walking/driving tours and push notifications coming soon.
Because Clio is free, it depends upon people like you who care about history and culture. If you would like to help, please send us an email at clio@theclio.com We are working to provide new features like push notifications and interactive walking tours thanks to donations and other forms of support. The Clio Foundation is recognized as a public charity under IRS code 501c3 and all donations are tax deductible. 
With several hundred new entries and improvements being added each month, Clio is not only a website and smartphone application, but also a collaborative research, interpretation, and map-building project. Museum professionals, scholars, and their students contribute most of Clio’s content. We also depend upon local history experts and museum volunteers who often know more about local history than anyone else. Each day, this partnership of local history experts and professional historians is building a comprehensive, dynamic, and interactive map of American history.

We are adding new features including interactive walking/driving tours and push notifications coming soon.

Because Clio is free, it depends upon people like you who care about history and culture. If you would like to help, please send us an email at clio@theclio.com  We are working to provide new features like push notifications and interactive walking tours thanks to donations and other forms of support. The Clio Foundation is recognized as a public charity under IRS code 501c3 and all donations are tax deductible. 

With several hundred new entries and improvements being added each month, Clio is not only a website and smartphone application, but also a collaborative research, interpretation, and map-building project. Museum professionals, scholars, and their students contribute most of Clio’s content. We also depend upon local history experts and museum volunteers who often know more about local history than anyone else. Each day, this partnership of local history experts and professional historians is building a comprehensive, dynamic, and interactive map of American history.

bluejetty:00178264:ios.description:

If you're looking for a simple clock that can track the number of days you've been sober/clean/etc, then Nomo is perfect for you. You can create as many clocks as you need for any hurts, habits, or hang ups. Your clocks are completely private by default and will count those days for you.

bluejetty:00120425:ios.description:
One Brain is inspired by the Stroop effect, a famous psychological test that measures how well you handle conflicting information. For example, it's harder to name the color of a word when the word itself spells a different color. This game challenges your whole brain as you fight to process the mixed signals and make the right call before time runs out.
Game modes:
• Colors: Does the word match the color it's written in?
• Arrows: Is the arrow actually pointing the way it says it is?
• Numbers: Is the math equation true or false?
• Words: Which word matches the definition?
How high can you score under pressure?

bluejetty:00023542:ios.summary: Embark on an exhilarating coding adventure with our revolutionary app, designed to ignite passion for STEM in young minds. Perfectly blending the thrill of adventure games with the educational value of coding for kids, this app is a must-ha
bluejetty:00023542:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating coding adventure with our revolutionary app, designed to ignite passion for STEM in young minds. Perfectly blending the thrill of adventure games with the educational value of coding for kids, this app is a must-have for budding tech enthusiasts.
Discover the World of Coding and Mechas
Our app offers an immersive experience in the world of robot games, where players drive powerful mechas alongside the mighty T-Rex. As they navigate through six fantastic islands, each with its own unique environment and challenges, children learn to code in a fun, interactive way. This is not just a game; it's a journey into the heart of STEM learning.
Innovative Block Programming System
Breaking the barriers of traditional learning, our app uses a block programming system, making it easy for kids to learn to code. This system, with the creativity and simplicity of building blocks, allows even non-readers to grasp coding concepts effortlessly. Dragging and arranging coding blocks becomes a puzzle game in itself, teaching logical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Thrilling Battles and Strategic Gameplay
The app features 144 challenging levels across six diverse islands, each presenting unique coding puzzles and thrilling battles. Players must outsmart eight types of dangerous enemies, each with distinct behaviors and weaknesses. This strategic gameplay is not only exciting but also educational, reinforcing coding concepts in every level.
A Fleet of 18 Awesome Mechas
Children will be captivated by the 18 gorgeously designed mechas, each transformable into battle forms. This aspect of the game resonates with the fascination many kids have with robots and machinery, making it an engaging way to learn coding and STEM principles.
A Safe and Accessible Learning Environment
We prioritize a safe learning environment, ensuring there's no third-party advertising to distract young minds. Moreover, the app's design allows for offline play, making it accessible anytime, anywhere, adding to its appeal as a go-to choice for parents seeking quality games for kids.
Key Features for Optimal Learning
• STEM-focused curriculum, blending coding for kids with exciting gameplay.
• Building-block programming, accessible and engaging.
• Diverse puzzle games embedded in coding challenges.
• Dynamic adventure games setting to maintain engagement.
• Rich robot games experience with 18 transformable mechas.
• 144 levels of coding games for kids.
• No third-party advertising and offline play for uninterrupted learning.
Join us in this coding adventure and give your child the gift of learning to code through play. With our app, the journey of mastering coding and embracing STEM is just as exciting as the game itself!

Com
bluejetty:00065749:ios.description:

Com o aplicativo, você tem mais facilidade para utilizar seus cartões – tudo isso na palma da sua mão. Confira algumas funcionalidades disponíveis no seu app:
Pagamento Digital
Com o aplicativo você pode pagar suas compras utilizando o celular, diretamente no caixa das lojas. Assim, não é necessário portar o cartão físico.
Fatura e Resumos
Você terá acesso ao resumo da sua fatura para monitorar suas compras e valores do mês corrente e períodos passados. Além disso, você pode fazer download do boleto ou copiar o código de barras para realizar o pagamento no banco de sua preferência.
Descontos e Ofertas
Conseguirá conferir os produtos que possuem descontos e ofertas especiais em primeira mão. Além disso, pode se inscrever para receber promoções pelo WhatsApp – inclusive selecionando a sua loja Zaffari e Bourbon.
Fidelidade Premium
Utilizando seus cartões Zaffari Card e Bourbon Card, você acumula pontos e pode trocar por descontos e benefícios. As opções são: vale-compras para usar nas lojas Zaffari e Bourbon, recarga de celular e até mesmo transferência de pontos para programas parceiros. 
Encontre uma Loja
Caso queira localizar a loja mais próxima de você, basta abrir a funcionalidade Encontre uma Loja. Desta forma, visualizará o mapa com as lojas Zaffari, Bourbon e Cestto que ficam ao seu redor.

bluejetty:00122658:ios.description:
Join the 1 million+ drivers enjoying quick and easy, temporary car, van and learner insurance with Cuvva.
Download the Cuvva app, get a quote and be covered in minutes. Lend or borrow a car whenever you need to, or insure your own car until you sort out longer-term cover. Our fully comprehensive policies last from 1 hour to 28 days, so you can:
- Drive your new wheels home from the dealership
- Share the drive with friends on your next road trip
- Borrow a car from your family or friends
- Save on a removals van when you’re moving house by borrowing one yourself
- Learn to drive for up to 6 hours a day with a provisional licence
Whenever you need to get behind the wheel, we’ve got you covered. Once you’re insured, you can manage everything within the app. So, whether you need to book a policy in advance or extend your cover, you can sort it all from your phone.
The best part is you don’t have to own a car to drive one. With Cuvva, it’s just as easy to get affordable insurance on someone else’s car as it is to insure your own. That’s why we’ve sold over 10m policies (and counting).
Cuvva is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority. Our FCA reference number is 690273. You can check our details on register.fca.org.uk.

Step into the shoes of a football club
bluejetty:00175736:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Fantasy Draft Football, the ultimate football club management game! Create your dream team, design your club, and dominate the top leagues in the world of soccer.
Create Your Own Club:
Step into the shoes of a football club owner and build your empire from scratch! Choose from top leagues like English Football League, Spanish Football League, Italian Football League, German Football League, and more. Personalize your club's identity by selecting your own football club colors and crafting a unique badge that represents your vision. Leave your mark on the football world with a team that stands out from the rest!
Dream Ultimate Team:
Assemble the ultimate squad of football superstars! Scout and transfer the best players from all over the globe to strengthen your lineup. Select top talents from football powerhouses like England, Spain, Germany, Italy, USA, and beyond. Develop your team's chemistry by choosing the right tactics and formations. Lead your dream team to victory and claim the coveted trophies of the football world!
Interactive Training:
Showcase your ball control and juggling skills in the exciting kick-ups mini-game! Keep the ball airborne for as long as you can to demonstrate your mastery on the pitch. The better your juggling, the more rewards you'll earn to improve your team.
But it's not just about your skills on the field – prove your football management prowess in the quick football memory mini-game. Test your memory and tactical acumen to make the best decisions for your team during matches.
Engaging Gameplay:
Experience the thrill of managing a football club in a fun and immersive way. Make strategic decisions for transfers, formations, and tactics to lead your team to glory. Stay on your toes as you face challenging opponents, intense rivalries, and thrilling matches. The fate of your club rests in your hands!
Stunning Graphics:
Enjoy the beautiful game with realistic graphics and captivating visuals. Watch your players come to life as they dribble, shoot, and score breathtaking goals. Immerse yourself in the football universe and experience the excitement of being on the sidelines of a world-class football club.
Live Your Football Fantasy:
Idle Fantasy Draft Football lets you live your ultimate football fantasy as you create, manage, and compete with your dream team. The game is designed to keep you entertained for hours with its addictive gameplay, engaging challenges, and continuous updates to keep the football excitement alive.
Download Idle Fantasy Draft Football now and start your journey towards becoming a football legend! Build your club, train your players, and lead your team to victory in this thrilling football club management adventure. The world of soccer awaits your arrival!
Note: This is an idle football management game. It does not involve live matches or real-time gameplay. Enjoy the experience at your own pace and witness the rise of your football empire!

Dual Messenger for WhatsApp – Use Two Accounts on One Device!
What Scan for Web is a powerful utility app that lets you manage two WhatsApp accounts on a single iPhone or iPad. Whether you're using it for person
bluejetty:00084805:ios.description:
What Scan for Web - Dual WA
Dual Messenger for WhatsApp – Use Two Accounts on One Device!
What Scan for Web is a powerful utility app that lets you manage two WhatsApp accounts on a single iPhone or iPad. Whether you're using it for personal or business use, this app gives you full control with features like Status Saver, Chat Backup & Restore, Direct Message, and QR Tools – all in one clean, easy-to-use interface.
WhatsApp Web / WA Web
Access your second WhatsApp account right from your device! Just scan the QR code from your primary WA account and manage chats, media, and more on your iPhone or iPad – no need to switch devices.
Direct Message
Send WhatsApp messages directly to any phone number without saving it to your contacts. Perfect for quick chats, leads, or temporary communication.
Status Saver for WhatsApp
Easily download and save WhatsApp status images and videos from your contacts. Repost, share, or keep them forever – no screenshot or screen recording needed!
Chat Backup & Restore
Backup your WhatsApp chats, media, and documents securely and restore them when needed. Never lose your important conversations again.
QR Code Scanner, Reader & Generator
Scan QR codes, generate new ones, and share links, contacts, and information effortlessly. Useful for sharing your WA contact, business links, and more.
Repeat Text Tool
Create and send repeated messages in seconds. Great for marketing messages, invitations, or fun text patterns. Save time and avoid typing the same text again and again.
Message Reminder
Set reminders for important messages you need to send later. Perfect for business follow-ups, birthday wishes, or important updates.
How to Use Dual WA Web:
1. Open the app and tap on WA Web Scan to display your QR code.
2. On your second device, open WhatsApp → Menu → Linked Devices → Scan QR.
3. That’s it! You can now use two WhatsApp accounts on a single device.
This is the ultimate WA toolkit for those who want productivity, privacy, and flexibility – all in one place.

bluejetty:00043989:ios.description:
MLC Chat lets users chat with open language models locally on ipads and iphones. After a model is downloaded to the app, everything runs locally without server support, and it works without internet connections do not record any information.
Because the models run locally, it only works for the devices with sufficient VRAM depending on the models being used.
 MLC Chat is part of open source project MLC LLM, with allows any language model to be deployed natively on a diverse set of hardware backends and native applications. MLC Chat is a runtime that runs different open model architectures on your phone. The app is intended for non-commercial purposes. It allows you to run open-language models downloaded from the internet. Each model can be subject to its respective licenses.

bluejetty:00018312:ios.summary: In the Erste app you’ll find everything you need for everyday banking: your account balance, transfers (including instant transfers and standing orders), your products, BLIK, Erste Open, the Erste Exchange, contactless payments, and the ban
bluejetty:00018312:ios.description:
In the Erste app you’ll find everything you need for everyday banking: your account balance, transfers (including instant transfers and standing orders), your products, BLIK, Erste Open, the Erste Exchange, contactless payments, and the bank’s full offer.
Make the app your own. Tell us how we should address you and choose your wallpaper.
Stay private in public places. Tap the eye icon on the home screen to switch on Discreet Mode perfect for moments when you’re, for example, on a tram and don’t want others to see your balance.
Keep track of what’s happening on your account and card thanks to Alerts24 and quick balance preview.
Financial Coach gives you a clear chart of your spending and income, and in Subscriptions you can see how much you pay monthly across your services.
Price advisor shows you how close you are to paying 0 PLN for the Smart Account and your monthly card fee.
In the app you can also check your card details, pay for parking or motorway tolls, buy public transport tickets, and top up games, movies, music or office apps.
You’ll also find information about your insurance, including policy numbers and coverage periods.
For even greater security, when activating the app we’ll ask you to enable mobile authorisation. You’ll confirm operations in the app and online banking with a 4 digit PIN, fingerprint or face recognition.
You log in to the app with one single login. On the login screen we show services linked to that account (e.g. quick preview, BLIK, tickets, parking), which is why multiple people cannot use the same app. If you need to use another login, you can do so in your mobile browser by logging in to online banking.
If you have a sole proprietorship and use Mini Firma online banking, you can use BLIK in the app: withdraw cash from BLIK enabled ATMs, make phone transfers and pay in stores without a card or cash.
The Erste app was previously called Santander mobile.
More information about the app:
https://www.erste.pl/aplikacja

bluejetty:00119291:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Los Angeles Airport (LAX). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Los Angeles Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every LAX flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Los Angeles Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.

bluejetty:00085239:ios.description:
The award-winning, UK-based Carbs & Cals app makes tracking your food, nutrition and weight simple, visual and smart. Use the new Unified Food Scanner to snap a barcode, food label, or even the food on your plate. Our AI-enhanced system instantly identifies food and extracts nutritional data for fast, accurate logging.
Search over 272,000 UK food & drink photos and compare up to 6 portion sizes for easy, visual carb and calorie counting. Log meals in seconds and track your calories, carbs, protein, fibre, fat, saturated fat, salt, sugar, 5-a-day and alcohol.
Now with built-in weight tracking, you can monitor your progress over time, log weight changes, and stay motivated as you work towards your goals. Combine your food diary and weight tracker to clearly see how your eating habits impact your results.
Create a personalised diet plan for weight loss, diabetes management, or keto and low-carb living. Add notes for glucose, insulin and weight, set nutrition goals, and share reports with your healthcare team for better support and accountability.
Developed by NHS dietitians, Carbs & Cals is trusted across the UK for accurate, practical guidance. Get a smarter calorie counter, weight tracker and food tracker in one app.
KEY FEATURES:
- Unified Food Scanner: Scan barcodes, food labels or your plate for instant nutrition info.
- Track your weight and monitor progress alongside your food diary.
- Search 272,000+ UK foods & drinks from brands and restaurants.
- Compare 6 portion sizes for visual carb and calorie counting.
- Track calories, carbs, protein, fibre, fat, saturated fat, salt, sugar, 5-a-day and alcohol.
- Food diary + weight tracker for complete health tracking.
- Unlimited custom foods and meals.
- Set goals for weight loss, diabetes, keto or low-carb diets.
- Share reports with your healthcare team.
- Designed by NHS dietitians and trusted by professionals.
RECOMMENDED BY NHS DIETITIANS AND HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS 
- Developed by Chris Cheyette BSc (Hons) MSc RD, Senior Diabetes Specialist Dietitian with 20 years of experience working in the NHS.
- Recommended across the UK by NHS dietitians and healthcare providers. - Reviewed and approved by independent health app specialist Orcha Health. 
- The Carbs & Cals books are supported by Diabetes UK. 
PRICING 
- The free STARTER plan gives you access to our basic database and limited features. 
- The UNLIMITED plan gives you access to the full UK database and all features. Choose from £6.99 per month, or £35.99 per year (less than £3 per month!). 
Try out the Carbs & Cals app on the UNLIMITED plan for FREE with our 14 day free trial. No commitment.
FOR TECHNICAL SUPPORT, QUESTIONS & SUGGESTIONS: 
Please email support@carbsandcals.helpscoutapp.com 
*Remember to consult with a doctor or other medical professional before making significant changes to your diet

bluejetty:00115402:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00115402:ios.description:
WEAPONIZED BALLS
For a combo idle and strategy game, look no further than Weapon Ball Battles! This fight simulator allows you to arm your battle balls with a variety of weapons, then set them loose upon your enemies to see who will prevail. Throughout the ball fight make strategic choices about which upgrades to choose, and enjoy crushing bosses and defeating waves of enemies. Off the battlefield you can pick up fun upgrades and other items that will help you win in boss fights and build an army of strong battle balls.
BOUNCING BATTLES
Each level you’ll start off with a choice of weapon balls – from there you’ll get chances to add more or upgrade the ones you already have. Let them loose in the arena where they’ll bounce around and watch as they do damage to the enemy balls. Periodically you’ll get the opportunity to choose from a three exciting boosters, so be strategic and soon you’ll be the boss of this fun auto battle fight simulator!
What makes this so much fun:
- Idle gaming: other than choosing your weapon balls and boosters this strategy game is fairly hands off, making it great for all ages and all situations. You’ll be able to dedicate 100% of your strategic thinking skills to making the right choices each ball battle, and then sit back to watch how it plays out.
- Bountiful battles: This is a weapon ball battle game after all, so expect more battles and boss fights than you can shake a spear at! As you progress things will get harder, so enjoy the easy ball fights now and learn all you can about how each weapon works.
- Strategic play: While this is an auto battle and idle game, the strategy element is oh so important if you want to win big. Choose which weapon balls to deploy and which ones to upgrade when is no easy feat, especially when you never know what boss might be lurking for you in the next level. Will you go for more damage? Or perhaps more speed? How about healing your weapon ball fighters? Upgrade wisely!
BATTLE BALLS AT THE READY
Next time you have a few minutes to spare and a hankering for some idle yet strategic fun, have a go at Weapon Ball Battles. Pick your fighter balls wisely in this simulator, then let them loose in the arena to bounce attack the enemy balls – along the way you’ll get to pick a few strategic upgrades and hope that you chose right as the levels progress and you face off against bigger bosses and crazier enemies. Fast-paced and with great graphics, you’re sure to love all of the upgrade options both on and off the battlefield, and this auto battler will have you hankering for more!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Plunge in to a bath with a friendly skeleton. We dar
bluejetty:00186394:ios.description:
It’s a regular house when the lights are on, but when you switch them off it becomes a Haunted house packed with new characters to play with, rooms to discover and adventures to explore. 
Plunge in to a bath with a friendly skeleton. We dare you to sleep in the masters bed room and discover the secret passage to the attic where our friendly witch is hiding.
EXCITING NEWS FLASH FOR OUR FANS
We have started connecting all our games! My Town : Haunted house is connected to My Town : Museum. This means you can move a character between both games. So if you want a knight to come and fight the witch, you can do that if you have both games.
WHY DO KIDS AND PARENTS LOVE MY TOWN GAMES?
Our games are the digital version of the classic dollhouse game. Your Imagination & Creativity are the only boundaries our games have. Stress free, No winning or losing, just endless fun and hours of game play. 
Our games can be played alone or with friends and parents together since multi touch is supported.
PLAY IMAGINE DISCOVER
My Town’s huge haunted house has plenty of rooms to play in and explore. With the flick of the switch all the rooms change turning the mansion in to a haunted mansion. Discover the creatures hiding under your bed, inside the wall and in the shower. Imagine an adventure to save the witches daughter from the haunted attic and more…
FEATURES
1. NEW - This game shares characters with My Town : Museum. This means both games are connected and you can play with any character. 
2. NEW - Save mode, Game saves even when shuts down so you can always continue your last adventure!
3. NEW - Multi touch function, Play together with friends and family on a single tablet
4. Each house comes with 6 rooms and lots of props, foods and costumes.
5. Play along with My Town family and 5 new characters!
6. No ads, improved UI, lifetime of free updates
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
This game has a haunted theme, nothing too scary but we recommend this game for 6 years old and above. Older kids can play alone while younger kids can play with parents. No ads or in app purchases, amazingly long playability for hours of fun.
WE MAKE GAMES THAT KIDS WANT TO PLAY
Keep sending us cool ideas and theme’s you want us to create next. My Town dollhouse theme was requested by you guys and it only took 5 month to create. So keep the ideas coming on our Facebook page, tweeter or web site. Make sure to review our games. we promise to read each and every posting, review or comment. 
Facebook : Https://www.Facebook.com
Twitter: Https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Website: Http://www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00078551:ios.description:
Collect epic loot, craft and merge items, and level up your character to beat the World Bosses in this Semi Idle Action RPG!
* Choose your class
Adventure forth as a mighty Warrior, agile Hunter or a powerful Mage. Assign Attributes to specialize your Character, and unlock unique Active and Passive Skills as you progress.
* Auto move and attack
Your character will target and attack monsters automatically, but you can move and use skills and potions in strategic moments.
* Deep crafting system
Merge stats from one item to another with Essences at the Blacksmith, disassemble items, and use relics to further empower and alter your equipment!
* Skills for your playstyle
Invest points into skill masteries to customize your skills and gameplay.
Do you prefer an active playstyle, or do you want to be more passive and boost your character's idle power?
The choice is yours!
* Compete in Seasons and Leaderboards
Create a new character in the Season game mode and progress to receive special rewards.
Compete against other players on the Leaderboard, there is no level cap!
* Idle rewards

With Xthings Home, you can easily manage all your smart devices from one place. Control ULTRALOQ smart locks, UTEC Matter-enabled lighting and power devices, Ulticam security cameras, and more. Lock or unlock doors, add users, view live camera feeds, use two-way intercom, adjust lighting, and automate your daily routines with ease.

Enjoy quick setup, stable connectivity, and real-time status updates.
Scene Automation
Create custom automations that work across your devices.
For example:
“When I arrive home → unlock the door + turn on porch lights.”
Build a smart home that adapts to your lifestyle.

bluejetty:00070064:ios.summary:

Plan decompression dives with Bühlmann ZH-L16 and gradient factors, import your dives from a Shearwater dive computer, blend nit
bluejetty:00070064:ios.description:
The complete dive planner, dive log and dive calculator app for recreational, technical and rebreather divers.
Plan decompression dives with Bühlmann ZH-L16 and gradient factors, import your dives from a Shearwater dive computer, blend nitrox and trimix, and get quick answers to the questions you ask before every dive. All in one app, for open circuit (OC) and CCR.
Whether you are in dive training, planning complex deco dives, or logging your underwater adventures, Deep Tools gives you reliable results you can trust.
DIVE CALCULATORS
- Maximum Operating Depth (MOD)
- Oxygen partial pressure (ppO₂)
- Equivalent Air Depth (EAD)
- Equivalent Narcotic Depth (END)
- Equivalent Air Density Depth (EADD)
- No Decompression Limit (NDL)
- Best nitrox mix for depth
- Best trimix mix for depth
- Gas consumption (SAC / RMV) and gas density
- Lift bag calculator
DECO PLANNER *
Plan complex dives with confidence on open circuit (OC) or rebreather (CCR):
- Bühlmann ZH-L16B and ZH-L16C with gradient factors (GF)
- Multi-level and repetitive dive planning
- Lost gas plans and CCR bailout planning, with custom bailout points
- Gas consumption, CNS and OTU for every dive
- Dive profile, run time table, tissue pressure graph and slate view
- Share dive plans as a file, text, slate or image
DIVE LOG *
- Import dives from Shearwater dive computers (Petrel, Perdix, NERD, Teric and more)
- Full dive profile with ppO₂, CNS, TTS, SAC and gas density
- Dive sites with name, coordinates, map and custom tags
- Automatically merge dives with short surface intervals
- Share dives with your buddies
- Local backup and easy transfer to a new device
GAS BLENDER *
Mix accurate nitrox and trimix:
- Partial pressure blending to the desired gas
- Blending with a top-off gas
- Continuous flow blending
- Gas cost estimate
MORE
- Metric and imperial units
- Altitude diving and water type (salt, fresh, EN13319)
- Custom tank / cylinder database
- Available in 11 languages
* The deco planner, dive log and gas blender are included in Deep Tools Premium. Try them free during the free trial.
Deep Tools is a planning aid. It does not replace proper dive training or certification.
Special thanks to V. Paul Gordon, Serge Nelissen and Michael Heus for extensive testing and valuable contributions.
Terms of Use: https://www.deepblue.si/privacy/terms-of-service.php
Privacy Policy: https://www.deepblue.si/privacy/

bluejetty:00097161:ios.description:
Link & Arrow is an engaging puzzle game that challenges you to connect numbers in sequence by drawing a continuous path through a grid.
Gameplay:
Connect numbered nodes in the correct order by drawing a line through the grid. Your path must be continuous, following cardinal directions (up, down, left, right) only. Once you've connected all numbers in sequence, they'll be eliminated and you'll advance to the next level.
Key Features:
24 Challenging Levels - Progressively difficult puzzles that test your strategic thinking
Smart Path Planning - Navigate through empty cells to reach target numbers
Backtracking System - Draw back through your path to undo mistakes and find the optimal route
Achievement System - Unlock rewards as you complete challenges
Star Ratings - Earn up to 3 stars based on your performance, aiming for perfect zero-error runs
Customizable Colors - Choose from multiple color schemes for your drawing paths
Score Tracking - Track your best scores and completion times for each level
Challenge Yourself:
Master the art of pathfinding as you navigate increasingly complex grids. Each level requires careful planning and precise execution to achieve the perfect score. Can you complete all 25 levels with three stars?
Download Link & Arrow today and test your puzzle-solving skills!

bluejetty:00065515:ios.summary: Looking for a fast meal, but one with all of the qualities of home-style comfort food? Download the Black Bear Diner app, order your favorites and take it to your cave! Our app makes it easy to order from your mobile device, explore our men
bluejetty:00065515:ios.description:
Looking for a fast meal, but one with all of the qualities of home-style comfort food? Download the Black Bear Diner app, order your favorites and take it to your cave! Our app makes it easy to order from your mobile device, explore our menu and nutritional information, find a location near you, access our clubs and gift card information, and post to your favorite social media platform. 
Download the Black Bear Diner app and find the comfort food classic that’s just right for you. With breakfast served all day, hearty burgers and sandwiches, and home-style dinners, our menu has something for everyone and our app is the simplest way to take our delicious home-style meals back to your cave.
Do you enjoy breakfast any time of day? Order our secret recipe sweet cream pancakes and waffles – so decadent you’ll think you’re eating cake! Or maybe you’d like to try the heartier side of breakfast with Bruce’s Meat Lover’s Omelette or a California Bacon Benedict. There’s a lot to decide with breakfast, and the choice is yours, sunup to sundown. 
If lunch is your game, dive into a Bob’s Big Bear Burger, named after our co-founder who claims any burger with his name must have you licking your elbows! We offer a variety of Specialty Burgers, all built on a golden brioche bun, and we feature Signature Sandwiches like The Gobbler, a festive California Thanksgiving between two slices of bread! If its salad you’d prefer, there’s a Super Salad just right for you. From a classic Caesar or Taco to the Fit & Focused Tuna Chef or Bacon Cheeseburger, there’s a salad for every palate. 
For dinner, we offer traditional comfort food classics, just like grandma used to make. Delicious home-style meals like Chicken Fried Steak, Slow-Cooked Pot Roast, and Housemade Meatloaf just to name a few. You may also enjoy something from our Steak and Ribs section, or a pasta selection such as Grilled Chicken & Pesto Pasta, or Linguica & Penne Pasta. 
Whatever you choose, you the Black Bear Diner app is the easiest way to find the location near you, and take it to your cave! Plus, save your past orders and favorites! 
It’s the fastest way to Feed Your Inner Bear, anywhere, anytime.
Download the Black Bear Diner app now.
Online Tracking Opt-Out Guide: https://order.blackbeardiner.com/online-tracking-opt-out-guide
