bluejetty:00061338:ios.description:
**Create and Send Professional Job Quotes On the Spot**
Turn quotes into invoices with a single tap. Close more business deals faster.
---
How It Works
1. Enter your information
2. Add customers manually or from Contacts
3. Add your products or services
Once that’s done, you can create and send professional quotes instantly.
---
Flexibility
* Manually edit titles (e.g., Quote → Quotation, Cita, Estimate)
* Manually edit subtitles (e.g., Billing address → Bill to, Signature → Approved by)
* Multi-currency support (e.g., \$, £, etc. — manually enter your currency code)
* Custom date formats (e.g., 04/18/2014, 18/04/2014, 18/Apr/2014)
* Works offline, without internet access
* Import contacts from your existing address book or manually create them
* Set payment terms based on each customer (7 days by default)
* Supports decimal hours or quantity
* Choose from 5 beautifully designed templates
* Easily delete items (e.g., Quotes, products, customers) by swiping left
* Edit existing documents anytime
* Add signatures and dates on the spot
* Fields like Icon, Signature, Note, and Comments won’t appear if left blank
* Preview quotes before sending them as PDFs
* Send as PDF or print wirelessly
* Export data to CSV spreadsheets
* Compatible with any language
* Add a custom background image
* Create up to 5 quotes for free
---
Professional Features
* Add your business registration name and number (e.g., ABN)
* Set up tax (GST, VAT, etc.) with options for single, compound, or no tax
* Apply discounts (either \$ amount or %)
* Set payment terms (Immediate, 7 days, 14 days, 21 days, up to 180 days)
* Add your company logo for a branded look
* Secure your app with a password screen lock
---
Mobility
* Send quotes directly from your iPhone or iPad
* Your personal quote system always in your pocket
---
Upgrade to Subscription Version
The subscription version offers cloud sync and backup, allowing you to securely save all your data and share it across multiple iOS devices.
Upgrading requires an auto-renewal subscription.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
The subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.
**Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:**
http://invoicemkr.com/privacy.html
http://invoicemkr.com/terms.html
Feel free to contact us for anything.
Simplify your life now.

bluejetty:00115454:ios.description:
HeartSnap – Heart Rate, Blood Pressure & Health Tracker
Your All-In-One Partner for Heart, Blood Sugar & Mental Wellness
Your health shouldn’t be a mystery. HeartSnap empowers you to measure your heart rate via your phone and seamlessly log blood pressure, blood sugar, HRV, and mental wellness. We transform your raw data into clear, actionable insights, helping you understand your body with absolute confidence.
Why Choose HeartSnap?
Instant Heart Rate Monitoring: Measure your pulse using your iPhone camera with PPG-based detection. Get immediate insights into heart rate, HRV, and stress patterns to better track your cardiovascular status anytime, anywhere. HeartSnap also uses AI to help you understand your heart score.
Comprehensive Blood Pressure Tracker: Record systolic and diastolic readings to monitor long-term trends. Keep your logs organized for personal reference or for easy sharing with your healthcare provider.
Blood Sugar Logging Made Simple: Easily log daily glucose levels and track long-term trends with intuitive charts. See how your patterns change over time and maintain consistent records to support healthier daily habits.
AI-Powered Heart Age Check: Discover your estimated heart age through a simple questionnaire and a quick heart-rate scan. HeartSnap uses AI to analyze your patterns and generate a Heart Age Score, helping you visualize your overall wellness.
Mental Wellness Assessments: Take self-assessment questionnaires regarding mood, stress, sleep, and anxiety. HeartSnap provides general wellness insights to help you better understand and manage your emotional well-being.
BMI & Weight Tracking: Automatically calculate your BMI and log weight changes over time. Track long-term trends through clear charts, helping you stay aware of body changes and maintain a healthier lifestyle.
Stress Level Check: Complete a simple questionnaire to gain an estimated view of your current stress. Receive general wellness suggestions to support relaxation, emotional balance, and healthier habits.
HRV (Heart Rate Variability) Insights: Track HRV trends to understand how your body responds to daily activity and rest. HeartSnap presents your data in easy-to-read charts for better wellness awareness.
Insightful Reports & Health Trends: View clear health trends at a glance. Track changes in vitals, BMI, and mood through intuitive charts—helping you spot risks early and gain meaningful health insights.
Download HeartSnap — your complete health monitoring companion.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Unlock full access with HeartSnap Premium.
Subscription Plans:
Weekly Plan: $9.99 / week
Annual Plan: $39.99 / year
Subscription: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
DISCLAIMER
HeartSnap is for wellness only and not a medical device. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Blood pressure and blood sugar must be entered manually. Heart rate and HRV are wellness estimates. This app is not a substitute for medical advice; consult a healthcare professional for any concerns.

Privacy Policy: https://ilovescanqr.com/heartsnap/privacy
Terms of Use: https://ilovescanqr.com/heartsnap/terms
Subscription Policy: https://ilovescanqr.com/heartsnap/subscription

bluejetty:00115326:ios.name: Pop Drummer -Real Drum Machine
bluejetty:00115326:ios.summary: Pop Drummer is your new virtual drummer for practicing, creating, and performing pop rhythms like never before. Designed for musicians, producers, and creators who want real acoustic drum sounds, loops, and total control, now with long-awai
bluejetty:00115326:ios.description:
Pop Drummer is your new virtual drummer for practicing, creating, and performing pop rhythms like never before. Designed for musicians, producers, and creators who want real acoustic drum sounds, loops, and total control, now with long-awaited AUv3 support.
Discover authentic acoustic drum kits and fully editable grooves that play with the nuance and feel of a real drummer. Whether you’re rehearsing, jamming at home, or performing live, Pop Drummer becomes your personal drummer, tight, dynamic, and always ready to jam.
Key Features:
Standalone & AUv3 Compatible – Use Pop Drummer inside your favorite DAW or as a standalone app.
Pop Drum Grooves – Hundreds of preloaded grooves organized by feel, making it easy to find and customize the perfect rhythm.
Three drummers in one: Gover (Smooth Pop Precision), Cindy (Creative Flow), and Beaton (Raw British Energy). Each drummer brings a unique feel to improvisations, jams, and fills, no matter which rhythm you choose. Enjoy more variety and flexibility in your grooves. Switch styles to match your music or spark new ideas.
Live Pads – Trigger fills, switch grooves, and jam in real time with on-screen pads or MIDI controls.
Customizable Midi Controls - Assign any function to your MIDI controller for a personalized workflow. Easily adapt Pop Drummer to your studio setup or live rig.
Jam – Add human feel and spontaneity to your grooves with dynamic variations and perfectly timed fills that match the groove’s feel.
Jam Effects – Reverb and delay that jam with you, adding color and movement as they evolve with your chosen intensity.
Drum Kit Customizable – A visual drum layout lets you select and mix acoustic sounds to create your perfect kit.
AUv3 Sound Module – Use Pop Drummer as a professional drum sound source inside any AUv3-compatible host. Trigger its acoustic kits from your own MIDI tracks or electronic drum pads for ultimate flexibility.
Send Reverb – Apply individual reverb to each drum element for precise space and depth control.
Song Mode – Easily arrange full song structures using custom parts, combining grooves, jam levels, and jam effects for dynamic, expressive compositions.
Humanize Velocity – Add natural dynamics and realistic human feel to every groove.
Rhythm Editor – Create and tweak your own beats quickly.
Export MIDI & Audio – Instantly export your grooves as full mix or multi-track audio, and get MIDI files to use your own sounds in any setup.
Native iOS Instrument – Fully optimized for iPhone and iPad.
Ableton Link – Sync effortlessly with other lumbeat drummers, apps and devices over Wi-Fi for tight, tempo-locked jamming and recording.
Try for Free
Pop Drummer is free to explore for 7 days with access to all features. Some actions are limited during the trial 
(exports, random grooves, sound changes and bars per session).
After the trial, keep playing with limited features.
Unlock the Full Version with a one-time purchase, no subscription. Studio Mix is sold separately.

bluejetty:00128811:ios.description:
It is time for shopping! Download My Town Stores and explore more than 6+ locations! A new mall is open? Let's see what cool thing we can find there! 
Dress up in the latest fashions in our clothing store, or pick up ingredients for tonight's dinner in the supermarket. My Town - Stores is a fully interactive game providing hours of education and entertainment. With no time limits or high scores to achieve, the only limit in My Town is your own imagination! Role play with your favorite characters, customize them and create your stories!
FEATURES:
- 6 areas to explore 
- Visit a huge SUPERMARKET with over 67 items to buy
- Visit a CANDY store where you can make popcorn or buy sweets 
- Enter the CLOTHING store and get 87+ of the most fashionable looks
- Find a FOOD truck if you are hungry
- Many new characters to add to the My Town collection
- Role play as you like with no limitation!
LET'S GO SHOPPING
Play with all characters in the game! Meet the My Town family and take them to the mall. Make sure your shopping bags are full of items that you need. Want to prepare some tasty dinner for your friends? Go to the supermarket and buy all the ingredients required. Download the My Town Store game and have fun for hours!
PERFECT GAME FOR KID'S IMAGINATION AND CREATIVITY
Our dollhouse games are made to improve kids' imagination by letting them explore and play the game without rules and as they like. They can create stories using all the characters, move objects, and role-play situations like in real life. No limitations and game rules! You only need your creativity to play our games. Fun is guaranteed!
Download our super popular dollhouse game – My Town Stores and check why we have the best games for kids and toddlers!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children worldwide. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com.
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00083522:ios.summary: Introducing Leksa, the ultimate reading aid for dyslexics. Say goodbye to the struggles of reading and understanding tiny text. Take a photo of any text and watch as it is converted into a clear and easy-to-read format with enlarged letters
bluejetty:00083522:ios.description:
Introducing Leksa, the ultimate reading aid for dyslexics. Say goodbye to the struggles of reading and understanding tiny text. Take a photo of any text and watch as it is converted into a clear and easy-to-read format with enlarged letters. Read on low difficulty.
Leksa's unique tracking feature allows you to pick up right where you left off, even after taking a break. And when your eyes get tired, let Leksa finish the reading for you. Leksa's text-to-speech feature highlights words as they are spoken, making it easy to follow along.

bluejetty:00068633:ios.description:
ACT® Exam Prep 2026 is a test prep app that will help you pass the American College Testing (ACT) on your first attempt with a high score, thus allowing you to succeed in your dreamed college!
ACT® Exam Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into ACT® test preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the test on your first attempt by practicing hundreds of test-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In ACT® Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official exam requirements. According to the test requirements, you must master all subjects in order to successfully pass the ACT.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Mathematics
- Science
- Reading
- English
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You'll need to practice all 4 subjects, which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 2000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the ACT® is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the test. You will find that each time you practice on the ACT® Exam Prep 2026 app, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the ACT, but on any other test!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://act.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://act.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please let us know via email at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.
DISCLAIMER:
ACT® is a registered trademark of ACT, Inc. This application is not authorized, sponsored/supported or endorsed by ACT, Inc.

bluejetty:00182861:ios.description:
Tile Harbor: Satisfying Match-3 Puzzle
Welcome to Tile Harbor, the ultimate match-3 puzzle game where pattern recognition meets strategic fun. Swap, match, and clear vibrant boards in this addictive brain teaser that is easy to pick up but hard to put down.
Match by Pattern, Not Just Color
Forget ordinary color matching. Here you will match charming tiles by their unique patterns. Connect three or more identical tiles to clear the board and experience the satisfying pop of every match. Plan your moves, spot patterns, and watch the board come alive.
Epic Combos and Chain Reactions
One match can trigger a spectacular chain reaction. Create clever combos, unleash powerful cascades, and rack up massive scores in a symphony of delightful effects. The more strategic your move, the bigger the payoff.
Key Features
Addictive Core Gameplay: Classic match-3 perfected with intuitive touch controls and clever puzzle design.
Hundreds of Unique Levels: Journey through a vast collection of handcrafted puzzles, each with fresh challenges and goals.
Powerful Boosts: Stuck on a tricky level. Use game-changing power-ups like the Pattern Blaster and Switcher to smash through obstacles.
Vibrant Visuals: Immerse yourself in a joyful, polished world full of lively animations and satisfying effects.
Relaxing Escape: Perfect for unwinding. Play for five minutes or an hour in this ASMR-like puzzle retreat.
Play Anywhere: No Wi-Fi needed. Enjoy offline play anytime, anywhere.
Your Personal Harbor of Calm
Tile Harbor is more than a game. It is a peaceful getaway. Challenge your mind, find your flow, and enjoy the simple pleasure of matching beautiful patterns.
Download Tile Harbor for free today and start your matching adventure.

bluejetty:00119870:ios.description:
The AMBOSS Qbank App for USMLE® Step, NBME® Shelf, NBOME® COMLEX-USA, ABIM, ABFM, ABP exams is the ultimate test preparation and study resource for medical students and residents. Dive into thousands of questions to enhance your knowledge and prepare for all of your exams.
The AMBOSS Qbank App will rigorously prepare you for the USMLE Step 1, Step 2 CK, Step 2 CS, Step 3, NBME Subject Board (Shelf) exams, and your clerkships, COMLEX Level 1, Level 2-CE, Level 3 and COMAT — Osteopathic principles and practice along with NEJM Knowledge+ questions for ABIM, ABFM, and ABP Board Review.
AMBOSS Qbank App works online and offline, so you can answer questions and reinforce your knowledge anytime, anywhere. It’s cross-linked with the AMBOSS Knowledge App so you can practice questions in the Qbank while simultaneously looking up relevant terms in the AMBOSS Knowledge Library. 
AMBOSS Knowledge and AMBOSS Qbank Apps combine to give you one powerful exam-preparation resource.
With AMBOSS Qbank App, you can:
Stay on track: Use Study Mode to guide your learning process. The Key Info and Attending Tip are tools that will help you with challenging questions and nudge you in the right direction when needed.
Bridge any knowledge gaps: After a Qbank session, you’ll get a personal analysis and study recommendations that will show you the areas you need to focus on the most.
Perform under pressure: Test yourself with Exam-Mode and be prepared for USMLE and Shelf exam conditions.
Get more than questions: Dive into interactive image overlays and flowcharts to improve your learning, study smarter, and score higher.
Additionally, the cross-linked AMBOSS Knowledge App will give you easy access to the right information.
Download the app today!
Terms and Conditions: https://www.amboss.com/us/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.amboss.com/us/privacy

bluejetty:00161840:ios.description:
DeskIn is a free remote desktop app delivering fast, secure, stable remote access for personal use. Control one or multiple remote devices from your iPad or iPhone with a high-performance connection. Whether you're working remotely, offering IT support, studying, designing, or helping family, DeskIn keeps you productive. A powerful alternative to Windows App, Splashtop, AnyDesk, Parsec, Moonlight, and Unified Remote.
Why DeskIn?
Feature-Rich Remote access, file transfer, screenshare, screen extension, real-time voice chat, mobile control, remote play, and remote support—built for both work and entertainment.
Excellent Performance 4K60FPS / 2K144FPS ultra-HD resolution and 40ms latency for a smooth experience in gaming and design.
Fast & Stable 12MB/s file transfer speed and a stable connection that holds up even in low-bandwidth environments.
Cross-Platform Seamless access across Windows, macOS, iOS, and more.
Secure & Flexible Bank-level E2E encryption, two-factor authentication, allow/block lists, and custom passwords for unattended access.
What You Can Do with DeskIn
 • Cross-Platform Remote Access Access and control Windows 10/11 and Mac computers, plus mobile clients, from your iPhone or iPad. A full-featured alternative to Microsoft Remote Desktop and RDP.
 • Secure Unattended Access Set passwords for unattended access and enable privacy mode to hide remote screens—ideal for always-on mobile work and PC remote sessions.
 • File Transfer & Sync Transfer files between phone and PC with no format or size limits. Send documents, images, or videos, and print remote files locally.
 • Quick Remote IT Support Use quicksupport and quickconnect for fast IT help. Run CMD or SSH commands remotely. Offer Apple or Airdroid-style remote support. Wake-on-LAN (WOL), start, shut down, or troubleshoot systems instantly.
 • Remote Work & Collaboration A perfect mobile work and remote access tool. Share clipboards, annotate, and communicate during sessions. Works seamlessly with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Access, and other enterprise tools.
 • Screen Mirroring & Extension Cast or extend your screen to PC, Mac, tablets, or even a remote TV. The simplest screenshare and screen extension solution—no shared network required.
 • Mobile Control & App Remote Control mobile devices from your computer via virtual phone or app remote, turning your PC into a touchpad or remote link.
 • Remote Gaming Play Steam or PC games on iPhone or iPad with customizable keyboard/gamepad. Low-latency remote play with 3D game view—a powerful Parsec and Moonlight alternative.
 • Remote Design & Creative Work Built for designers—true-color 4:4:4 display, digital pen support, and seamless drawing tablet input.
 • Virtual Screens & Multi-Session Create virtual screens for multitasking or separate workspaces, extending desktop sessions beyond hardware limits.
DeskIn is the best free remote desktop software for iPhone and iPad. Whether you need remote desktop control, mobile client access, remote support, or screen mirroring, DeskIn delivers it all in one app. Compatible with third-party tools like Microsoft Teams, Quick Remote, Touchpad, and Remote Link.
Quick Start Guide
 1 Install DeskIn on both devices.
 2 Sign in and enter the remote device's ID and password.
 3 You're connected—start your remote session.
DeskIn is free for personal and commercial use. We also offer an advanced Enterprise Edition—visit deskin.io for more.
Questions or suggestions? Contact support@deskin.io
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Looking for something to watch but don’t want to check each app individually?
Find Movies makes movie discovery simple. Browse top-rated films and instantly see where they’re available to stream, rent, or buy—across iTunes, Netflix, Disney, and Prime Video. No more jumping between apps or endless searching.

bluejetty:00098283:ios.name: Receipt Scanner - Receipto
bluejetty:00098283:ios.summary:
Scan paper receipts or forward email receipts, then let Receipto turn them into organized, tax-ready expense records.
Built for freelancers, contractors, and small business owners, Receipto captures receipt details with AI and keeps the re
bluejetty:00098283:ios.description:
Scan paper receipts or forward email receipts, then let Receipto turn them into organized, tax-ready expense records.
Built for freelancers, contractors, and small business owners, Receipto captures receipt details with AI and keeps the records behind your spending ready for bookkeeping, reimbursements, and tax time.
CAPTURE RECEIPTS YOUR WAY
- Scan paper receipts with your camera.
- Import receipt images and PDF files.
- Send supported images and files through the iOS Share Sheet.
- Upload multiple receipts for batch processing.
- Forward digital receipts to your personal Magic Email address.
REVIEW AI-EXTRACTED DETAILS
Receipto extracts the merchant, date, time, subtotal, tax, tip, discount, total, currency, payment method, receipt number, and line items when available. Review and edit the result before saving it.
ORGANIZE AND FIND ANY RECEIPT
- Use folders, categories, and tags.
- Search your receipt history.
- Review possible duplicates before keeping another copy.
- Track expenses in 162 currencies.
- Switch between personal and organization workspaces.
SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY WENT
View spending trends, weekly patterns, currency breakdowns, top categories, and frequent merchants from your analytics dashboard.
FORWARD RECEIPTS WITH MAGIC EMAIL
Send PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP attachments to your personal Receipto inbox. Multiple attachments are processed separately. Add instructions in the email body to assign folders, tags, or categories automatically.
EXPORT FOR BOOKKEEPING
Create PDF reports and Excel-compatible CSV spreadsheets. Choose a date range, select receipts, filter by folder, category, or tag, and include the columns you need.
PREPARE A TAX PACK
Choose a month, quarter, year, or custom period. Receipto checks for drafts, possible duplicates, and missing details, then creates one ZIP with a PDF report, CSV spreadsheet, and receipt files.
STAY ON TOP OF RECEIPTS
Schedule daily, weekly, monthly, or month-end reminders to scan receipts or export records. Reminders follow your local time. Sign in to back up and sync receipts across devices.
AI processing and sync use cloud services and require an internet connection. Some features require a Receipto Pro or Business subscription.
Receipto keeps the receipt trail behind your work expenses searchable, reviewable, and ready when you need it.
Terms of Use: https://receipto.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://receipto.app/privacy

bluejetty:00088835:ios.summary:
Trust & Safety in the palm of your hand.

bluejetty:00088835:ios.description:
Trust & Safety in the palm of your hand.
• Input & Inspect. It's really that simple.
Input a domain or IP address using the TLS Inspector app, or inspect any website from within your favourite browser using our Inspect Website extension.
• No Nonsense Results. "At a glance" has never been easier.
TLS Inspector will show you the entire issue chain for any website, and whether or not your device trusts that chain.
• Dive Deep. Details for days.
View important properties of any TLS certificate including fingerprints, dates, algorithms, and more.
• Stay Safe Online. No training required.
TLS Inspector makes it easy to detect and avoid man-in-the-middle attacks on unsafe networks by highlighting invalid and untrustworthy certificates.
• Right Place, Right Time. Inspect nearly anything from anywhere.
Easily access TLS Inspector from other apps, such as Safari, with the Show Certificates share sheet action.
TLS Inspector is free & libre open source software (FLOSS) with source code available on GitHub. TLS Inspector is made entirely without the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Large Language Models (LLMs).

bluejetty:00121692:ios.name: Mutility: MTG Life Counter
bluejetty:00121692:ios.summary: Battle-tested for over 12 years, Mutility is a refined Magic: The Gathering life counter for up to 4 players. Designed for use on the tabletop, it pairs easy-to-tap controls with big, easy-to-read life totals so you can focus on the game -
bluejetty:00121692:ios.description:
Battle-tested for over 12 years, Mutility is a refined Magic: The Gathering life counter for up to 4 players. Designed for use on the tabletop, it pairs easy-to-tap controls with big, easy-to-read life totals so you can focus on the game - not the screen. Enjoy its basic features for free, and a single in-app purchase unlocks all other features, forever.
The full feature list:
• Life totals: tap the left side to decrease, the right to increase, or tap and hold to run continuously
• Dice: beautifully animated rolls, with an option to skip ties so you don’t keep re-rolling
• Seat layouts: arrange players so everyone reads their own total right-side up
• Names and colors: name every player and give each one their own color
• History: an editable record of every life and counter change, and when it happened. Use it to settle disputes and fix mistakes
• Starting life: 20, 30, 40, or any total you set
• More counters: track poison, energy, wins, or Commander damage alongside life
• Game timer: one shortcut starts a fresh game and resets the clock together
• Advanced controls: set the tap-and-hold life increment, enable two-finger tap for lifelink and extort in two-player games, and more
• VoiceOver and Voice Control: spoken labels for every life total, counter, and history entry, plus voice actions to adjust life and counters without touching the screen
• Siri: roll the dice, start a new game, reset the counters, or show the history without touching the screen
Available in 26 languages, including Japanese, Korean, Thai, and both Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

bluejetty:00175517:ios.description:
One Potato. Six Weapons. Infinite Chaos.
A spaceship from Potato World has crashed on a hostile alien planet. The sole survivor is BROTATO, a lone potato forced to survive against endless alien hordes.
In this intense top-down arena shooter roguelite, you must fight wave after wave of enemies, scavenge materials, and build powerful combinations using dozens of traits, hundreds of items, and up to 6 weapons at once.
Every run is different. Every decision matters. Survive long enough until rescue arrives.
【FEATURES】
● 6-Weapon Combat System
Equip up to 6 weapons simultaneously, from SMGs and flamethrowers to sticks and improvised tools. Create unique builds and dominate chaotic battles.
● Diverse Characters
Dozens of playable characters with unique traits. Choose playstyles like One-Handed, Lucky, Crazy damage dealer, Mage, and more. Each run changes your strategy.
● Fast-Paced Roguelite Runs
Each wave lasts 20 to 90 seconds. Quick, intense survival sessions designed for replayability and experimentation.
● Deep Build System
Hundreds of weapons, items, and synergies. Combine effects to create broken builds and discover powerful strategies.
● Survival Gameplay
Auto-firing combat with optional manual aiming. Adapt, upgrade, and survive increasingly difficult alien waves.
【 IMPORTANT】
Cloud saves are available ONLY ONLINE. Offline play is supported, but progress will NOT be saved to the cloud.

bluejetty:00182494:ios.description:
ZOO 2: ANIMAL PARK – YOUR AMAZING ZOO AND ANIMAL GAME
In the captivating animal game Zoo 2: Animal Park, you slip into the role of a zoo director. Take care of ferocious tigers and wily wolves, play with cute foxes and pandas, or pet the elephants and giraffes. Dive into an exciting zoo game story with lots of quirky ideas and unexpected plot twists.
FANTASTIC ANIMAL GAME FEATURES
Discover an extraordinary combination of zoo simulation and tycoon game. Explore a colorful and captivating game world full of snuggly bunnies, playful horses and sweet chimpanzees. Breed all sorts of cute animal babies, scrub enclosures and expand your park. Zoo 2: Animal Park boars a wide range of animal game features and customization options. This one-of-a-kind zoo game has a lot to offer:
• Take care of cute domestic and wild animals: Mischievous goats, playful pandas, majestic lions and more want to play with you!
• Design your zoo: New tycoon features or items are unlocked with every level up. Get more flowers, bushes, and trees; build new types of enclosures, shops, restrooms, benches and more
• Dive into a lovingly-detailed world: Meticulous animal animations and impressive 3D graphics will keep you immersed in the action
• Breed adorable baby animals: Rare coat color variations will make your animal world even more colorful!
• Be part of a gripping story: Entertaining tasks and quests will guide you along in the flourishing zoo of your dreams and introduce a quirky cast of lovable characters
• Participate in exciting events: Regular updates and thrilling events with exclusive rewards provide long-lasting fun
• Expand your zoo: Earn achievements in this animal game as you make the zoo of your dreams a reality
A FUN WILD ANIMAL SIMULATION
Zoo 2: Animal Park whisks you away into a breathtaking zoo game setting. There’s always something new to discover! Prove your skill as a manager and turn the small family zoo into the greatest animal park paradise on the planet! Experience the animal game sensation. Download the app now!

bluejetty:00142156:ios.description:
Give your watch a look that feels like yours. Explore more than 220,000 watch faces for compatible Amazfit and Zepp watches, with new designs added daily.
Find a clean digital display, a classic analog dial, a minimal layout, or a colorful theme. Browse sporty designs, easy-to-read faces, and styles for every day.
FIND A FACE YOU LOVE
• Explore a large gallery of watch faces for supported watches and fitness bands.
• Search by name or tags and filter designs by language.
• See what’s popular in the monthly, yearly, and all-time Top 100.
• Try a random watch face when you want something new.
• Browse without an account. Sign in when you want to save favorites.
MAKE IT PERSONAL
Use the watch face editor to replace the background of a compatible design with a photo from your gallery. Choose a family picture, a favorite place, your pet, or an image you created to make your watch feel more personal.
INSTALL ON YOUR WATCH
Choose your watch model, open a compatible face, and follow the instructions in the app. Depending on the watch and design, installation may be available through Bluetooth or a QR code.
AmazFaces includes designs for supported Amazfit Balance, Bip, Cheetah, Falcon, GTR, GTS, T-Rex, Active, and Verge Lite models, as well as Zepp E Circle and select Xiaomi Mi Band, Xiaomi Smart Band, and Amazfit Band models.
Watch face availability, photo background editing, and installation methods vary by model and design. Not every face works with every watch.
MORE TO EXPLORE
Visit amazfitwatchfaces.com for installation guides, community discussions, and resources for watch face creators. Need help? Include your watch model and a screenshot when contacting support.
Find your next favorite watch face with AmazFaces.

bluejetty:00016423:ios.description:
Play the BEST FreeCell Solitaire game on your Apple device, made by MobilityWare -- the #1 Solitaire developer!
FreeCell has goal progressions and updated scoring, including your personal best score! Each day you will receive new goals to tackle. Complete daily goals to gain XP, and level up to exclusive titles!
FreeCell Solitaire is one of the most popular Solitaire card games. Solitaire games require skill, strategy and patience to win.
After dealing from a standard deck of 52 cards, use the four free cell spots as placeholders as you try to move all of the cards from the Tableau for a win. You must move cards from the Tableau to the Foundation cells by suit, in ascending order. Most FreeCell games can be solved, if you can find the right strategy.
You've played FreeCell solitaire on your computer, and now you can play FreeCell free, anywhere at any time of the day! You won’t want to play any other FreeCell solitaire game again!
FREECELL SOLITAIRE FEATURES:
- Goal Progression
- Updated Scoring (High Score and New Personal Best)
- Highlight Moveable Cards
- Step-by-step tutorial
- Random games
- 1 million well known games
- Portrait & Landscape orientation
- Game state saved when interrupted
- Unlimited undo
- Hints
- Auto complete to finish game
- Statistics
- Tap to move or drag and drop
FreeCell Solitaire has never been more fun! With two unique control schemes, randomized FreeCell card decks, and in-depth stat tracking, FreeCell Free is one of the fun addicting games you’ve been waiting for.

About FreeCell Solitaire Subscription
FreeCell Solitaire Subscription is an optional subscription that gives you access to seamless play without any ads, the ability to play future Daily Challenges and exclusive themes.
You can subscribe to FreeCell Solitaire for a term of one month, three months or for one year. New subscribers can choose a one-week trial subscription at no cost. The monthly term costs US$1.99. The three-month term costs US$4.99. The yearly term costs US$9.99. The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Renewal prices are US$1.99 per month, US$4.99 per every three months, or US$9.99 per year. The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged for a renewal in the last 24 hours of the current period. Purchasers can manage their subscription and turn off automatic renewal in their Account Settings.
Subscriptions may be stopped by turning off automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A subscription cannot be cancelled in the middle of its term.

Please see our Terms of Service at http://mobilityware.com/eula.php

bluejetty:00200170:ios.summary:
Your miniature painting desk, wherever you are.
Miniature Studio brings freehand miniature painting to iPhone and iPad. Try a new colour scheme, practise your highlights or enjoy a painting session when your hobby desk is out of reach.
PA
bluejetty:00200170:ios.description:
Your miniature painting desk, wherever you are.
Miniature Studio brings freehand miniature painting to iPhone and iPad. Try a new colour scheme, practise your highlights or enjoy a painting session when your hobby desk is out of reach.
PAINT DIRECTLY ON YOUR MODEL
Rotate, zoom and paint your miniature with touch or Apple Pencil on a compatible iPad. Build up basecoats and layers, deepen recesses with washes and contrast-style effects, and bring out raised details with adjustable drybrushing.
BRING YOUR OWN MINIATURES
Start with the included demo model, prepare an STL for painting or open a supported USDZ. STL preparation happens on your device, adding a paintable UV layout and primer.
FIND YOUR COLOURS
Browse paint-name and colour references from Citadel, The Army Painter and Vallejo. Search by name or product code, explore paint ranges and keep your favourites close.
MAKE YOUR OWN MIXES
Combine up to four supported paints in different ratios—even across brands. Name and save your mixtures, and keep the proportions in your painting recipe.
MAKE ROOM TO CREATE
Move the floating paint controls wherever they feel comfortable, or hide them for an uninterrupted view of your miniature. Paint with your finger on iPhone and iPad, or use Apple Pencil with finger gestures for navigation on a compatible iPad.
PAINT OFFLINE
Core preparation, painting and saving work without an internet connection. Download your source files before travelling, then pick up your painting on the train, on holiday or whenever you find a little time.
SAVE AND SHARE YOUR WORK
Return to saved projects across multiple sessions. Export painted models as USDZ or an OBJ package with materials and textures, export geometry as STL, or keep an editable project backup.
THINGS TO KNOW
• Digital colours, mixtures and brush effects are approximations, not guaranteed matches to physical paints.
• Very dense models may require a lighter working mesh. Fine details can change during preparation.
• OBJ colour exports include accompanying material and texture files. STL exports contain geometry only.
• Colour 3D printing requires compatible software and hardware. Check exported models in your slicer before printing.
• Only import, share or print models you have permission to use.
• Apple Pencil is optional and supported on compatible iPads.
Miniature Studio is an independent app by EllisGaming. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Games Workshop, The Army Painter or Vallejo. Third-party paint names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00030996:ios.summary:
Make your sessions feel real: launch Spirit Talker, start a Spirit Box session, ask questions, and track EMF + EVP as you explore—discovering it may feel more real than you expected.
Spirit Entities Talker is your all-in-one paranormal inv
bluejetty:00030996:ios.description:
Make your sessions feel real: launch Spirit Talker, start a Spirit Box session, ask questions, and track EMF + EVP as you explore—discovering it may feel more real than you expected.
Spirit Entities Talker is your all-in-one paranormal investigation toolkit—built to create intense, memorable sessions anywhere you go. If you’re curious about what might be around you, this app gives you the tools to explore the unknown and capture every moment.
Spirit Talker • Ghost Detector • Spirit Box • EVP Recorder • EMF • Haunted Map
Use Spirit Talker to communicate with spirits and explore paranormal activity at home, outdoors, or at locations with a haunted history. Start a session, ask questions, and watch as Spirit Entities Talker generates words and responses you can interpret in real time.
• Ghost Talker Sessions (Real-Time Word Responses)
Spirit Entities Talker displays relevant words and responses during your investigation. One of the core features generates words and speech influenced by your phone’s sensors and your environment—turning each session into an interactive experience that keeps you locked in.
• Ghost Detector + EMF (Energy-Style Scanning)
Scan for electromagnetic fluctuations (EMF) during your session and track changes as you move through different rooms or locations. In the premium version, a light indicator signals increased EMF activity—making spikes easier to catch instantly. Explore your surroundings to uncover cold spots and unusual shifts.
• EVP Recorder (Capture the Session)
Record audio with the built-in EVP recorder and replay it anytime. You can also store your interactions including date, time, and generated words, so you can review patterns and compare sessions later.
• Spirit Box (Go Deeper Into the Unknown)
The Spirit Box feature takes your sessions further by helping reveal moments you might otherwise miss. It blends noise patterns with interactive audio review to support ITC/EVP-style listening—creating a more immersive paranormal experience. Many users report it helps clarify unclear sessions and brings attention to moments of silence that suddenly feel… not so silent.
• Haunted Map (Find Locations to Explore)
Want to investigate beyond your home? Use the Haunted Map to discover eerie locations and plan your next session. Whether you’re traveling or exploring nearby, it’s the perfect way to turn curiosity into a real investigation.
• Optional AI Interpretation (Extra Insight)
Want a second perspective after your session? Spirit Talker can send your latest generated words to an AI for an objective interpretation of themes and coherence. It’s designed to help you reflect on what happened—fast.

bluejetty:00161237:ios.description:
Ready for a pawsome adventure? Find the Cat 2 is the much-awaited sequel to the fan-favorite hidden object puzzle game, Find the Cat! Dive into beautifully hand-drawn levels and embark on a journey to uncover cleverly hidden cats in breathtaking environments.
Features You'll Love:
Hand-Drawn Art: Every level is a masterpiece created by professional painters who adore cats, offering a relaxing and visually stunning experience.
Challenging & Fun Gameplay: Test your observation skills as you search for hidden cats in unique settings. From underwater worlds to surreal landscapes, festive holidays like Christmas, and beyond!
Colorful Rewards: Bring each scene to life! Completing a level turns it into a vibrant, fully colored masterpiece.
No Ads, Just Fun: Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no annoying ads.
Endless Variety: Explore a wide range of themes, with new surprises waiting in every corner.
Your Mission:
Become the ultimate cat collector! As a curious adventurer, your goal is to find every elusive feline in this relaxing yet exciting journey.
Perfect for All Puzzle Lovers
Whether you’re a cat lover, a puzzle enthusiast, or just looking for a soothing game to unwind, Find the Cat 2 is designed for everyone to enjoy.
Download now and join thousands of players in this cozy, cat-filled quest!

Pago is the app for simple and secure online payments, where you manage all your bills with just one account, in seconds.
Here are the 9 essential features that will simplify your life:
1. Manage and pay all your bills with just one account
2. You can see bills sorted by due date without searching through emails or elsewhere
3. Manage and pay bills for your primary residence, other homes, or for other people
4. After adding your provider, it will only takes a few seconds to pay the bills
5. Receive notifications for newly issued bills and before they are due
6. Organize and control your bills: decide when to pay, manually or automatically
7. Secure payments thanks to collaboration with the largest payment processors. Card payments, supported by 3D Secure technology, with a 6-character security code or via biometric confirmation, with fingerprint or face recognition
8. Dedicated support: For any need or doubt, contact us via chat in the app and we will be happy to assist you.
9. Ecological saving: Thanks to our digital receipt storage, you can actively contribute to environmental conservation by reducing paper consumption.

bluejetty:00092640:ios.description:
O Aplicativo Tanajuras é o aplicativo definitivo para treinos de musculação, desenvolvido pela Isa Abrahão para mulheres que desejam resultados reais com clareza, organização e eficiência. Se você já tentou treinar sem ver resultados ou se sente perdida sem um plano estruturado, aqui você terá tudo o que precisa para evoluir com confiança.
O que a Plataforma Tanajuras oferece:
Treinos Exclusivos da Isa
Treinos de musculação organizados e claros, os mesmos que a Isa utiliza em sua própria rotina para se manter forte e com o corpo definido. Os treinos são pensados para mulheres em todos os níveis, com fichas detalhadas e vídeos explicativos, garantindo que você saiba exatamente o que fazer em cada sessão.
Fichas de Treino Prontas
Fichas práticas e estruturadas para acompanhar seu progresso na academia. Tudo planejado para otimizar seu tempo e garantir os melhores resultados sem complicação.
Aulas de Mobilidade
Exercícios específicos para melhorar sua flexibilidade e preparar o corpo para treinos mais eficientes. A mobilidade é essencial para prevenir lesões e garantir que você treine com qualidade e segurança, evoluindo de forma constante.
Bônus Exclusivos da Plataforma
MindCare - Um Bônus Especial
Além dos treinos de musculação, a plataforma oferece como bônus o MindCare, com conteúdos exclusivos para ajudar você a lidar com temas importantes como autoestima, motivação e equilíbrio emocional. São aulas com psicóloga que vão complementar a sua jornada, ajudando você a se manter motivada e confiante.
FinanceiraMente - Organização Financeira
Outro bônus especial é o FinanceiraMente, com conteúdos criados por uma economista para ajudar você a organizar suas finanças de forma prática e eficiente. Cuidar do bolso é tão importante quanto ter disciplina nos treinos, e esse módulo vai ensinar como planejar seu futuro financeiro com segurança.
Benefícios do App:
 Treinos exclusivos de musculação com metodologia clara e estruturada.
 Fichas de treino práticas e detalhadas para você seguir sem erro.
 Vídeos demonstrativos para aprender a execução correta de cada exercício.
 Aulas de mobilidade para garantir mais segurança e evitar lesões.
 Atualizações mensais com novos treinos para manter sua evolução constante.
 MindCare e FinanceiraMente como bônus para apoiar sua jornada.
 App prático e intuitivo, com tudo acessível na palma da sua mão.
Com o Aplicativo Tanajuras, você terá acesso a treinos organizados, fichas detalhadas e todo o suporte necessário para evoluir com segurança e eficiência. Além disso, com os bônus exclusivos do MindCare e FinanceiraMente, você terá ainda mais ferramentas para se manter motivada, focada e organizada.
Se você está pronta para dar o próximo passo e conquistar os resultados que sempre desejou, baixe o app agora mesmo e comece sua transformação com a Isa Abrahão!
Vamos juntas alcançar os seus objetivos!

- Mission System
- Hourly Leaderboard and Game Center Support
- Single Player mode also available
- New Content Coming Soon!

bluejetty:00106374:android.summary: "Sounds of nature" helps people feel better, sleep better, live better. Start your sound meditation and relaxation right now! You could listen your own mp3 music with "Sound of Nature" simultaneously. Program could play nature sounds in bac
bluejetty:00106374:android.description:
"Sounds of nature" helps people feel better, sleep better, live better. Start your sound meditation and relaxation right now! You could listen your own mp3 music with "Sound of Nature" simultaneously. Program could play nature sounds in background. 
Sounds of nature have a wholesome effect on:
- Your Mood
Close your eyes for 5 minutes and dive in the atmosphere of the sea, forest or rain. It will undoubtedly put you in a good mood!
- Your sleep (lullaby music)
Listen to the sounds of bubbling brooks, waves or rain and you will sleep soundly all night long.
- New impressions
If you`ve never been in the forest at night when owls and wolves start to sing their night songs! Full relaxation sounds, music and ringtones!
Features:
* soothing music - sleep sounds and ringtones
* therapy music (music therapy, sound therapy, melody therapy)
* white noise for sleep
* bedtime music and songs
* fall asleep immediately
* nature white noise maker
* deep relaxation melody
* set as ringtone meditation music for relaxation
* set as alarm
* relax and sleep well
* tinnitus mask
* bedtime music, bedtime sounds and meditation
* sounds effects ringtones (noise maker app)
* like yoga music for relaxation and meditation
* beach sounds - the soothing sound of a tropical beach
* nature sounds to help you sleep
* animal sounds
Nature sounds can be separated in two groups: first one includes the sounds produced by animals, while the second consists of sounds produced by natural phenomena such as weather and meteorological occurrences.
During the history, sounds of nature, especially animal sounds, have been objects of imitation of tribal people (and even of devotion when they have been related to their belief systems).
Nature sounds (soothing music, bedtime sounds) could be used for:
+ Rest and relaxation. Our sound atmospheres will help you relax after a hard working day and forget about all unpleasant emotions. 
+ Pleasant recollections. In summer they will help you dive in the atmosphere of a cool rainy day or winter evening, and in winter you will recollect a sunny beach or the days spent in the countryside.

bluejetty:00114259:ios.description:
Goat Funded (GFT & GFF) is a performance analytics and reporting app designed to help users review historical activity data, monitor progress metrics, and gain insights into their performance.
The GFT Mobile App provides a centralized dashboard to view reports, track key metrics, and analyze results generated outside the app. Goat Funded is intended for read-only analytics and reporting purposes only and does not support trading, brokerage services, or financial transactions.
What You Can Do
• View historical performance reports
• Analyze progress metrics and trends
• Monitor evaluation status and milestones
• Access detailed analytics through a unified dashboard
• Receive notifications for important updates
Designed for Insights, Not Execution
Goat Funded (GFT) does not enable order placement, trade execution, or financial transactions. All activities reflected in the app originate from external platforms and are displayed for informational purposes only.
Important Information
• This app does not provide trading, investment, or brokerage services
• No financial transactions or payouts are processed within the app
• Past performance data is shown for informational and analytical use only
To learn more about our platform, programs, and policies, please visit our website.

bluejetty:00166628:android.description:
New MADFUT 25 is here! We are introducing a ton of new features, modes and updates that will make this season the best one ever:
• 2 brand new Limited Time Modes at launch: Fatal Sim and Draft Puzzles
• Fatal Sim: build your squad and sim matches where every card’s Fatal stat can decide the outcome of the game
• Draft Puzzles: build quick Drafts around a few locked cards and try to get 100 chemistry
• 3 new LTM cards that you can upgrade by playing LTM modes
• Revamped Fatal Draft mode with a new menu, 2 completely different ways to play matches and Fatal stats button in Draft picks
• Daily Draft Cup: a quicker version of Online Cups that’s released every day
• 3 Lightning Rounds per day
• Save your Squads and Drafts. You can even save a Draft and play a match with it later!
• Backup your progress to make sure you never lose your collection
• Different Fatal My Club rating requirements each week to add more variety to squad building and make cards of all ratings useful for Fatal
• Receive Draft Building Points from every draft to earn unlimited bonus rewards
• Easier way to open multiple packs in a row
• Daily Live SBCs
• New Special Badges
• “Sort” button in Draft to automatically arrange your bench by rating
• New Packs, Player Picks, Tokens, as well as SBCs and Objectives
We absolutely love this new generation of MADFUT and hope that you will too. As always, we are excited to bring a crazy amount of new content, features and modes this season!

The world is torn and a temporary armistice is giving all nations a chance to revise their strategy. Under the Iron Order, countless inventions and technological advancements lead to Mechs roaming the battlefields. Mechanical warfare is slowly taking over while hordes of soldiers become mere bystanders when massive Titans collect their bloody harvest.

- Experience a blend of historical units and fantastical creations inspired by dieselpunk, teslapunk, and steampunk ideals. Rally large amounts of troops, unleash powerful mechs and robots, including special "Titan" units with extraordinary power and versatility.
- Enjoy regular updates that expand the game's lore and introduce new gameplay elements, ensuring a captivating and diverse gaming experience.
Join us on this epic journey through battle-torn Europe, where technology propels the conflict and strategic thinking is the key to triumph. Let your mark be known in the Iron Order. Welcome, commander!

Measure your reading speed first, then follow a plan that adapts to you, starting at
bluejetty:00146421:ios.description:
Read faster and understand more of what you read. SpeedReadingo teaches speed reading with step-by-step lessons, short daily workouts and training games.
Measure your reading speed first, then follow a plan that adapts to you, starting at just 5 minutes a day. Rated 4.8 from 1,800+ ratings worldwide.
STEP-BY-STEP SPEED READING COURSE
5 units and 25 lessons, from Speed Reading Fundamentals to Real-World Usage. Learn to guide your eye movements, quiet your inner voice, re-read less and hold your focus, with short explanations and hands-on exercises. Comprehension questions show how much you really understood.
RSVP READER: UP TO 1,200 WORDS PER MINUTE
In the Word Speed Reader, words flash one at a time or in small groups in the center of the screen, so your eyes don't have to travel along the line. Set your pace anywhere from 80 to 1,200 words per minute.
With Quick Read, paste your own text and read it at the speed you choose.
6 TRAINING GAMES
• Speed training: Article Speed Reader, Word Speed Reader
• Eye muscle training: Schulte Table, Camera Mind
• Memory training: Image Memory, Word Memory
Test yourself every day with the Daily Challenge.
MEASURE YOUR SPEED, WATCH IT GROW
Find out how many words per minute you read and how much you understand. Compare your speed with the average reader and follow your progress after every workout.
A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Choose a daily goal of 5, 10, 15 or 20 minutes. Reminders and a daily streak help you turn practice into a habit, with new reading passages every day.
MASTERCLASSES
Ready for more? Continue with the Speed Reading, Memory Techniques and Exam Reading masterclasses.
WHO IT'S FOR
• Students preparing for exams like the SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT or LSAT
• Professionals who spend hours on reports, email and documents
• Readers who want to finish more books
Runs full screen on iPhone Duo, on both the cover and the inner display.

• Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal anytime in your App Store account settings.

• With just a few taps, you can create and share a beautifu
bluejetty:00023288:ios.description:
With a streamlined design and intuitive Multi-Touch gestures, iMovie lets you create Hollywood-style trailers and beautiful movies like never before.
Instantly create Magic Movies
• With just a few taps, you can create and share a beautiful, custom video 
• Select an album or group of videos or images and iMovie will create a video for you—no video editing required—with titles, transitions, and music
• Easily rearrange or delete clips in the simplified shot list
• Apply a different style to change up the look and feel of the whole video
Learn storytelling with Storyboards
• Choose from 20 Storyboards that help you get started with popular video types
• Record video or take photos right into each placeholder clip, or add media from your Photos library
• Add, reorder, and delete clips as needed to organize and customize your story
• Apply a dynamic visual style that includes title layouts, fonts, filters, color palettes, and music
Make Hollywood-style trailers
• Choose from 14 trailer templates with stunning graphics and original scores by some of the world’s top film composers
• Customize movie studio logos, cast names, and credits
• Select videos and photos for your trailer or record video right in iMovie
Create beautiful movies
• Choose from 8 unique themes with matching titles, transitions, and music
• Give your movie the perfect look with 13 Apple-designed video filters
• Choose from 11 animated title styles like Split, Reveal or Pop-up
• Adjust any title by changing its font, color, size, location, and more
• Add solid, gradient, and patterned backgrounds to your movie
• Import and edit video captured in Cinematic mode on iPhone 13 or later
• Add, adjust, and delete focus points and modify the depth of field effect in video recorded in Cinematic mode*
• Easily add picture in picture, green screen, and split screen effects
• Select from more than 130 soundtracks that automatically adjust to the length of your movie
• Add sound effects, songs from your music library, and your own narration
• Connect a keyboard and use simple shortcuts to edit movies quickly
• Connect a trackpad or mouse to iPad for fast and accurate moviemaking
iMovie everywhere
• Transfer projects between your iPhone and iPad using AirDrop or iCloud Drive
• Send projects to your Mac via AirDrop or iCloud Drive to finish editing with iMovie or Final Cut Pro
• Connect an external display to your iPhone or iPad and choose to mirror the iMovie interface or display your video fullscreen while you edit**
Share with friends and family
• Send videos with Mail and Messages
• Save to your Photos library in resolutions up to 4K at 60 frames per second***
• Export videos optimized for Instagram, YouTube, and other popular video destinations
* Requires iPhone XS or later, iPad mini (5th generation or later), iPad Air (3rd generation or later), iPad Pro 11-inch or iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation or later)
** External display support requires iPhone 7 or later, iPad (6th generation) or later, iPad Air 3 or later, iPad Pro 12.9-inch (2nd generation) or later
*** 4K at 60 frames per second support requires iPod touch (7th generation), iPhone SE (2nd generation), iPhone 7, iPad (6th generation) or later, iPad mini (5th generation), iPad Air 3 or later, iPad Pro 10.5-inch or later

bluejetty:00072445:ios.name: Legend of Keepers
bluejetty:00072445:ios.summary:
Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? 
Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold.
bluejetty:00072445:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? 
Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures! You have to experience every company’s struggles in this fantasy workspace simulation, from sick leaves to strikes, and manage your team to run the most impenetrable dungeon! 
In this "reverse-Darkest Dungeon", climb the corporate ladder and optimize your strategy to become the most fearsome (and, perhaps, respected) boss in dungeon history!
Main Features
- Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business
- Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies
- Manage your resource budget: On top of morale, gold, blood, and tears must be spent wisely in this economy. 
- Being bad never looked this good: see your enemies perish in drop-dead gorgeous animations. Watch out for stains! 
- Diversify your management styles: Play as 3 dungeon masters - each with their own abilities and recruits - through various campaigns
*NEW MASTERS, NEW ENVIRONMENTS, NEW MONSTERS!*
Unlock the three DLCS : Return Of The Goddess, Feed The Troll and Soul Smugglers. Buy them separately, or together with the DLC Bundle.
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- iCloud - Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFicontrollers
- No microtransactions!

bluejetty:00015055:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Portuguese.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Portuguese empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Portuguese required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Portuguese the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Portuguese so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in brazil.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Portuguese.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.

* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates

bluejetty:00161992:ios.description:
Köp och sälj smartare med Blocket!
Välkommen till Blocket – hela Sveriges marknadsplats för att köpa och sälja begagnat. Här finns tusentals annonser och ännu fler fynd. Oavsett om du är ute efter en ny fåtölj, första bilen eller bara vill bli av med flyttkartongerna i förrådet, hjälper Blocket dig att lösa det snabbt, tryggt och roligt.
Hitta lättare
Med smart sök, filter och kategorier hittar du rätt grej snabbare än någonsin. Zooma in på rätt modell, se vad som finns nära dig på kartan och filtrera på allt från skick till fraktmöjligheter. Hitta rätt pryl snabbt, precis där du är.
Sälj smidigare
På Blocket är det alltid gratis att sälja grejer. Med AI-assistenten fylls annonsen i åt dig, steg för steg, och du får tips och belöningar längs vägen. Med smart statistik har du dessutom full koll på hur det går, hela vägen till försäljning.
Dröm smartare
Följ dina favoritsäljare och få pushnotiser när de lägger upp nya annonser. Spara grejer i listor och skapa bevakningar – såklart skickas meddelande när priset sänks på just dina drömprylar. Och glöm inte bortskänkes-kategorin för att ge bort eller hitta, alldeles gratis.
Schyssta affärer
Handla tryggt direkt i appen med säkra betalningar och smidig frakt. Se betyg och verifiering i säljarens profil, så du alltid vet vem du har att göra med – precis som det ska vara.

bluejetty:00077793:ios.name: Heart of the House
bluejetty:00077793:ios.summary: Destroy the evil at the heart of a haunted manor! As an orphan, you discovered your ability to commune with the spirit world and ghosts. When your uncle Kent mysteriously disappears, you'll embark on a journey to find out what really happen
bluejetty:00077793:ios.description:
Destroy the evil at the heart of a haunted manor! As an orphan, you discovered your ability to commune with the spirit world and ghosts. When your uncle Kent mysteriously disappears, you'll embark on a journey to find out what really happened. With your trusty companion Devanand at your side, you make your way to Darnecroy Manor, where Kent was last seen. It is...The House.
"Heart of the House" is 360,000-word interactive Gothic novel by Nissa Campbell. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination. 
Within the manor, you'll encounter the master, Lord Bastian Reaves; his mysterious servants, Oriana and Loren; and the thousands of spirits teeming around and in this haunted mansion. But will you shatter the power that binds the ghosts to the House, or claim it for yourself? Can love bloom in a haunted house? Most importantly, how will you escape when the House comes for you?
• Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bi, ace, or poly
• Explore the halls of the House, even as they seem to shift before your eyes
• Encounter ghosts, spirits, and echoes, as you search for your lost Uncle Kent
• Fight against an ancient evil or embrace its demonic gifts
• Indulge in steamy, chaste, sweet, or provocative romances, or go it alone
• Exploit the secrets you find for self-serving ends or use them to help your friends
• Defeat your greatest fears in bone-chilling moments of terror...if you can
• Choose whom you can save, if anyone, from the horrors the House contains
For some, there may be no escape from The Heart of the House.

bluejetty:00118844:ios.name: Covve - Business Card Scanner
bluejetty:00118844:ios.summary:
Scan business cards, event badges and QR with Covve — the fastest and most accurate business card scanner on the market, trusted by over 2 million professionals worldwide. 
Designed to support your networking efforts with precision, Covve
bluejetty:00118844:ios.description:
Scan business cards, event badges and QR with Covve — the fastest and most accurate business card scanner on the market, trusted by over 2 million professionals worldwide. 
Designed to support your networking efforts with precision, Covve lets you instantly capture leads from business cards, QR codes and LinkedIn profiles, even in busy trade show environments. 
▶ Unrivaled Scanning Accuracy and Speed ◀
[Top-tier Accuracy and Rapid Processing]
• Achieve market-leading scanning accuracy in over 60 languages, and experience the fastest scan times, significantly outperforming competitors like CamCard, ABBYY, and BizConnect.
• Scan QR codes to digitize leads from online profiles, LinkedIn and more.
[Built for Real-World Events] 
• Capture leads by scanning cards, QR codes, and badges even without internet — ideal for trade shows, conferences, and venues with spotty connectivity. 
[Enhanced Lead Management]
• Add notes, groups, and locations to each scanned lead; easily organize and retrieve your business contacts by sorting them by date, name, or company.
• Distill all your notes into a concise usable summary.
[Digital Business Card]
• Create and share your digital business card, making it easy to exchange contact information in-person, via email, on video calls, and more.
• See which leads came from your shared digital business card and when you sent it.
▶ Easy Export and Software Integrations ◀
[Versatile Export Options]
• Save and export scanned contacts to your phone's address book, Excel, Outlook, or Google Contacts, with CSV formatting options to meet diverse professional needs.
• Integrate and send scanned leads directly to your Outlook contacts automatically. 
[Comprehensive Sharing Features]
• Share your scanned leads with colleagues or integrate them into your CRM systems like Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho and other leading CRMs or any platform via Zapier, enabling connections to applications such as SuiteDash, Odoo, Marketo, and Agile CRM.
▶ Robust Data Management ◀
[Intelligent Export and Tagging]
• Customize your export files and track your contacts with advanced control using tags leading to refined organization and targeted communication.
[Research with AI]
• Instantly get a background info report for anyone you meet and qualify them on the go.
[Secure Cloud Backup & Restore]
• Securely store your cards to the cloud with our backup feature and effortlessly restore them on any device.
[Privacy and Compliance at the Core]
• Experience secure data management - Covve is GDPR compliant and made in Europe to ensure top-tier privacy and protection.
[Multi-Language Recognition]
• Automatically recognize and accurately scan business cards in 60+ languages. Unlock automation and agility with every lead captured. 
▶ Engage and Collaborate with Ease ◀
[Team Collaboration]
• All scanned leads are automatically shared with your team, amplifying collaboration and data sharing.
[Integrate with your CRM]
• Integrate with leading CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics and 8,000 other tools to push captured leads into your workflows.
[Efficient Communication Tools]
• Share individual contacts as VCF files directly through email, SMS, WhatsApp, etc., leveraging standard file formats for electronic business cards.
[Location Integration]
• Tap to see your contact’s location on Google or Apple Maps, making it easier to plan in-person meetings.
▶ Trial and Subscription Options ◀
[Free Trial and Flexible Subscriptions]
• Start with a 14-day free trial with full access to all features then upgrade to an annual subscription for continued access. 
Covve is more than a fast-scanning tool; it's a powerful platform for professional contact management and network development. Download Covve now to start digitizing your business cards, QR codes and leads. 
For more details, visit our website at https://covve.com
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00187029:ios.summary: Zello is the #1 push-to-talk, walkie talkie app with over 150 million users in over 200 countries. Get things done efficiently by talking to any group or person at the push of a button. With Zello, businesses connect their workers, friends
bluejetty:00187029:ios.description:
Zello is the #1 push-to-talk, walkie talkie app with over 150 million users in over 200 countries. Get things done efficiently by talking to any group or person at the push of a button. With Zello, businesses connect their workers, friends and families talk more, and first responders save lives.
Use Zello to:
• Talk in real time over any carrier or Wi-Fi connection
• Organize communication in channels of up to 6,000 users
• Listen while using other apps or with your device locked
• Replay messages at any time
• Send photos, texts, locations, and alerts
• Pair accessories like earpieces, speaker mics, and PTT buttons
Designed to be fast, reliable, and secure, Zello turns your phone into a walkie talkie that works anywhere in the world with an internet connection. Whether you’re operating a business, taking a family vacation, or coordinating emergency response, Zello keeps you connected.
Having trouble? Please reach out to support@zello.com
-
Subscription Pricing and Terms: 
Zello offers a 14-day free trial and an auto-renewing in-app subscription at $79.99 per month for Zello Work, a premium version of Zello built specifically for work. The in-app subscription is available for purchase after starting a trial. The trial and in-app subscription are currently only available for United States users. 
The $79.99 per month payment for the subscription will be charged to the credit card connected to your account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. The subscription will automatically renew every month unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of your monthly subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of each subscription period. You can manage your subscription and cancel at any time by going to your account settings after the purchase. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed. 
Read more about our Term of Service and Privacy Policy here: 
Terms of Service: 
https://zello.com/legal/terms/ 
Privacy Policy: 
https://zello.com/legal/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00062374:ios.description:
We have reduced the price for this holiday seasons. So you can enjoy learning French for less!
Learn French is an easy to use mobile French phrasebook that will give visitors to France and those who are interested in learning French a good start in the language. Learn French is recorded using a native speaker and we have tried our best to be authentic in the pronunciation whilst ensuring it is easy to understand. Recommended app for tourists and business people visiting France. 
FEATURES: 
• Universal app works on iPhone, iPod Touch, & iPad 
• Carefully translated list of essential phrases 
• 200+ common words and phrases included for FREE
• Upgrade and unlock all 1,900+ phrases in 22 categories
• Audio recorded by native speakers
• Option to playback audio at slower speed
• No internet connection required
• Highlight important words with tips
• Store frequently used phrases in favourites
• Search by words inside the app
• No adverts or annoying popups 
HAPPY CUSTOMERS
"Simply put, this app is well organized, clear and concise. I really enjoy it." -Kelvin Green
"It's easy and works every time, the words are clear and the pronunciation is accurate. I love it!" - Yuyu1
"Very useful and includes a lot of necessary phrases for free :)" - FettiHeadGore
CATEGORIES 
FREE Categories: 
* Greetings 
* General conversation 
* Numbers 
* Time and date 
* Directions and places 
* Transportation 
* Emergency 
PRO Categories: 
* Accommodation 
* Eating out 
* Shopping 
* Colours 
* Towns and provinces 
* Countries 
* Tourist attractions 
* Family 
* Dating 
* Feeling sick 
* Body parts
* Occasion phrases
* Sports
* Action words 
* Tongue twisters 
• HOW TO RESTORE PURCHASES? 
Purchases are one-time and carry over between devices. To restore your purchases on a new device, tap on PRO badge on one of the locked categories, tap on the Restore Purchase button. Even if you forget to do this step and try to buy the app again, it will be restored for free. 
• WE READ EVERY E-MAIL. 
We're a small company, but we reply to every support request. Let us try to help at support@codegent.com and we will do our best to help in any way! 
THANKS FOR ALL THE SUPPORT IF YOU LIKE THE APP PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW :-)
