bluejetty:00182411:ios.summary: Team up with wolves from all over the world to fight with other wolf packs - to survive, explore, hunt, challenge, and revenge. As the Alpha of your packs, you will lead your wolves to defend your wolf den and rise to the top of the food ch
bluejetty:00182411:ios.description:
Team up with wolves from all over the world to fight with other wolf packs - to survive, explore, hunt, challenge, and revenge. As the Alpha of your packs, you will lead your wolves to defend your wolf den and rise to the top of the food chain in the wild!
**Features**
Assemble a Mighty Wolfpack
Gather a diverse pack of wolves, including the powerful Timber Wolf, majestic Gray Wolf, elegant Arctic Wolf, and mysterious Black Wolf.
Lead Your Wolfpack
Control your wolf pack and use real-time strategy to defend your den and attack your enemies. Navigate the wild map with its varied terrain to reach your target.
Join a Wolf Clan Alliance
Team up with like-minded players in an Alliance to expand your territory and conquer the world of wolves together. Participate in PVP battles against other packs to become the ruler of the wild.
Cross-server gameplay 
Where players from different servers can play together and compete with each other in the same virtual environment. This adds a new level of excitement and challenge to the game as Wolf kings can interact with a wider range of opponents, forming alliances and engaging in battles on a massive scale. With cross-server feature, The Alphas have the opportunity to truly test their skills and see how they stack up against players from all over the world.
Explore the Wilderness
Send out scouts, explore the wild world , discover border invasions, spot traces of prey, avoid hunters' tracking. So the Alpha and pack can survive the wilderness.
Build a Wolf Kingdom
Strategize to win battles and conquer the wild world, creating a wolf empire and becoming the Alpha of the pack.
Seamless World Map
All in-game actions occur on a single big map inhabited by players and NPCs, with no isolated bases or separate battle screens. The “infinite zoom” on mobile allows you to go through the world map and individual bases freely. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers, mountains, and strategic passes that must be captured to gain access to adjacent areas.
Attention: Wolf Game is a free-to-play strategy game themed on animals, while it offers in-app purchases for some in-game items and functions.
A network connection is required to play this game.

Youtube:https://www.youtube.com/@wolfgame__offical

bluejetty:00027323:ios.description:
The NBC New York app is your trusted source for local news, Tri-State weather forecasts, and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, traffic updates, and 24/7 news streaming tailored for New York City, Long Island, New Jersey, and Connecticut.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC 4 New York in one app. Follow stories across New York City and the Tri-State area, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, transit, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Customize alerts by location so you can get the news, weather and election updates that matter most to you.
Why use the NBC New York app?
If you live in New York City, New Jersey, Connecticut or the Tri-State area, NBC New York helps you stay informed about breaking news, severe weather, traffic, transit, public safety, politics and elections with trusted reporting and personalized alerts.
What can you do with the NBC New York app?
Follow New York local news and breaking alerts
* Get alerts for local, national and world news, politics, entertainment and developing stories
* Read articles and watch videos from NBC 4 New York journalists
* Check the Alerts Center for stories you may have missed
Follow New York and Tri-State elections
* Get coverage of New York City elections, New York state races, New Jersey and Connecticut contests
* Follow primaries, midterms, presidential elections and local government races
* Track candidates, ballot issues, voter information and election results
* Watch live election coverage from NBC 4 New York
Check Storm Team 4 weather
* View current conditions, forecasts and severe weather alerts
* Access hourly and 10-day forecasts
* Watch weather videos from Storm Team 4 meteorologists
Use the NBC New York weather widget
* Add the weather widget to your Home Screen
* Tap for full forecasts and live radar
Track weather with live radar
* Follow changing weather across New York City and the Tri-State area
* Access StormTracker 4 live radar and weather data
* Save locations and receive weather alerts
Stream NBC New York News 24/7
* Watch the NBC New York News 24/7 streaming channel
* Stream live NBC 4 New York newscasts
* Watch live coverage of urgent local events and elections
Read NBC New York I-Team investigations and Better Get Baquero
* Access investigative journalism from the NBC New York I-Team
* Get consumer reporting from Better Get Baquero
Who is the NBC New York app for?
The NBC New York app is for people across New York City, Long Island, New Jersey, Connecticut and the Tri-State area who want local news, weather, live radar, traffic, transit, public safety, politics, elections and breaking news updates.
When should you use the NBC New York app?
Use the app to get New York breaking news alerts, check Storm Team 4 forecasts and live radar, watch NBC 4 New York newscasts, stream NBC New York News 24/7, follow investigations and track New York City elections, primaries, midterms, presidential elections and results.
Can I get New York breaking news alerts?
Yes. Personalize alerts for New York breaking news, Tri-State headlines, weather, elections, politics, national and world news, and urgent local stories.
Can I follow New York election coverage?
Yes. Follow New York City elections, New York state races, New Jersey and Connecticut contests, primaries, midterms and presidential elections. Get updates on candidates, ballot issues, voter information and election results.
Does the NBC New York app include live radar and weather widgets?
Yes. Get StormTracker 4 live radar, weather widgets, real-time conditions, hourly and 10-day forecasts, weather alerts, saved locations and videos from Storm Team 4 meteorologists.
Can I watch NBC New York live in the app?
Yes. Stream NBC New York News 24/7, live NBC 4 New York newscasts, breaking news, weather, election coverage and urgent local event coverage.

Finding and removing duplicate photos and screenshots have never been easier. All you need to do is to review the already detected duplicates and decide which one to keep and which one to remove. 
PhotoCleaner is an advanced yet super easy-to-use duplicate cleaner app for iOS that automatically scans your entire phone storage and detects duplicate photos and screenshots. Once the scan is completed, you’ll see the list of Similar Photos and Duplicate Photos and the amount of space you can free up by removing the duplicates. You just need to swipe to delete duplicates. 
WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THIS FREE DUPLICATE CLEANER APP?
PhotoCleaner is an intelligent storage organizer that instantly scans your phone memory to detect similar and duplicate images. Using this free phone optimizer, you can remove duplicates in seconds. 
With PhotoCleaner, you can:
- Automatically scan your entire phone storage to detect and find images similar to each other.
- Utilize the advanced duplicate scanner feature to quickly see what unnecessary images are using the storage.
- Get suggestions for removing similar images to keep the best shot.
- Easily delete similar photos and only keep one.
- Free up storage by deleting similar and duplicate photos.
Overall, PhotoCleaner is a smart photo duplicate cleaner designed to optimize the performance of your iPhone or iPad and free up some storage. This free storage cleaner app delivers everything you should expect from such phone optimizer platforms and it even sets the bar higher by offering an intelligent duplicate detector engine with the highest possible accuracy. 
– WHY DON’T YOU GIVE THIS FREE PHONE CLEANER APP A TRY?
Whether you are looking for a simple phone cleaner to search for duplicate images or you are looking for an intelligent duplicate photo remover app to deep scan your phone storage to identify similar images, you’ve come to the right place.

The variety of available features, including the intelligent duplicate detector engine, deep scan feature, swipe to keep or remove a duplicate/similar image, and intuitive interface, are just a few reasons that make PhotoCleaner your #1 choice when it comes to finding the best duplicate photo remover app for iOS.

bluejetty:00186180:ios.name: Sphero Edu
bluejetty:00186180:ios.summary:
Sphero Edu is your hub to create, contribute, and learn with Sphero robots. Go beyond code by incorporating unique STEAM lessons to complete with your bot.
Designed for learner progression, Sphero Edu beginners can give robots commands by
bluejetty:00186180:ios.description:
Sphero Edu is your hub to create, contribute, and learn with Sphero robots. Go beyond code by incorporating unique STEAM lessons to complete with your bot.
Designed for learner progression, Sphero Edu beginners can give robots commands by drawing a path in the app for their robot to follow. Intermediate coders can use Scratch blocks to learn more advanced logic, while pros can use text programming and write their own JavaScript or Python code. 
Sphero Edu is built for makers, learners, educators, and parents. The interactive platform allows you to keep track of your class or group from one easy place. Anyone can save their progress, jump from device to device, and continue the discovery from anywhere. Preparing for the future has never been so fun.
SPHERO EDU FEATURES
PROGRAMS: Program your bots in 3 ways with Draw, Block, and Text modes. Start with the basics and grow. 
SENSOR DATA: See location, accelerometer, gyroscope, velocity, and distance sensor data through visual graphs.
LESSONS: Program a painting. Navigate a maze. Mimic the solar system. The only limit is your imagination.
TAKE A DRIVE: Need a brain break? Set LED colors on your robot and zoom around in Drive mode. 
ASSIGNMENTS: Are you a teacher? Monitor progress by creating lessons and assigning them to your students.
INTEGRATIONS: Simplify classroom use by signing in and syncing classrooms with Google and Clever accounts.
COMPATIBILITY
Supported Robots: Sphero BOLT+, Sphero BOLT, Sphero RVR/RVR+, Sphero SPRK+, Sphero SPRK Edition, Sphero 2.0, Sphero Mini, Ollie, BB-8, BB-9E, R2-D2, R2-Q5
Unsupported Robots: Sphero Original, Force Band, Lightning McQueen, Spider-Man, indi

bluejetty:00168235:ios.description:
Effortlessly connect your Clarius HD3 ultrasound scanner to your phone or tablet with the easy-to-use Clarius App!
The Clarius HD3 Point-and-Shoot Ultrasound® (Clarius HD3 Ultrasound System) delivers High-Definition Wireless Ultrasound for Specialized Patient Care. AI technology not only replaces complex knobs and buttons, but T-Mode™ teaches as you scan, displaying labeled anatomy. This empowers even novice users to interpret images and make decisions with confidence. The Clarius Ultrasound App, featuring a suite of AI tools, automatically delivers best-in-class image quality – making scanning fast, reliable, and easy.
Clarius wireless ultrasound scanners are specialized to provide the high-definition detail you need for your medical practice. Choose from a range of scanners designed for your specialty. Visit www.clarius.com today.
For healthcare professionals only. Requires a compatible Clarius Ultrasound Scanner. The availability of the Clarius App on the App Store does not infer that the physical Ultrasound Scanner has been cleared in specific jurisdictions. Clarius Mobile Health Corp. has the sole responsibility and liability for in-country clearances. The Clarius Ultrasound App has only been approved for use on humans in the following regions: Albania, Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Ecuador, Egypt, Ethiopia, European Union, Honduras, Indonesia, Iraq, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, Morocco, New Zealand, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Philippines, Serbia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Kingdom, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates, Uruguay, United States of America, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, Vietnam. The Clarius Ultrasound App can also be used in countries that do not require medical device market clearance.
T-Mode™ is intended solely for educational and training purposes. T-Mode™ is not intended for diagnostic or interventional use, nor for any clinical setting where acquired ultrasound images may inform or support medical decisions regarding patients.

bluejetty:00032058:ios.name: Superlist: To Do List & Notes
bluejetty:00032058:ios.summary:
From the team that created Wunderlist: Superlist is the to-do list, notes, and AI meeting app that keeps your work and life organized — and turns every meeting into action items automatically, so nothing slips through the cracks.
Capture A
bluejetty:00032058:ios.description:
From the team that created Wunderlist: Superlist is the to-do list, notes, and AI meeting app that keeps your work and life organized — and turns every meeting into action items automatically, so nothing slips through the cracks.
Capture AI meeting notes, create tasks by voice, collaborate in real-time, and manage it all in one beautiful place.
AI that turns meetings into action:
- Auto-generate structured meeting notes — summaries, action items, and due dates — the moment your call ends.
- Ask AI Chat follow-up questions about any meeting, or generate replies and next steps from your notes.
- Speak your thoughts with the Voice Assistant — Superlist turns them into tasks, reminders, and notes instantly.
- Convert Slack messages, emails, and Linear tickets into tasks with one tap.
The fastest way from idea to done:
- Create tasks in plain language — type "call Sarah tomorrow at 3pm" and Superlist handles the rest.
- Start projects instantly with AI-assisted list generation.
- Add due dates just by typing them — no menus.
- Capture notes, brainstorm, and turn thoughts into todos.
Everything in one place:
- Organized, customizable lists with infinite subtask nesting.
- Work projects, personal goals, and everything between — in one view.
- Reminders and notifications across all your devices.
- Repeatable tasks to build your routine.
Work better together:
- Real-time collaboration on shared lists and projects.
- Chat inside tasks to keep conversations on-point.
- Share lists, assign tasks, and manage work — without switching apps.
- Integrates with Slack, Linear, GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar, and more.
Built for real people:
- A beautiful interface that's a joy to use.
- Customize lists with cover images and emojis.
- Works on every device, online and offline.
Why people switch from other to-do apps:
Most productivity apps are either too basic or too complicated. The team behind Wunderlist built Superlist to give you the power of a task manager and project planner with the simplicity of a to-do list.
- No complicated setup
- Start free, upgrade when you need more
- Privacy-first and secure. Made in Germany.
Perfect for:
- Daily to-do lists and personal task management
- Team tasks and collaboration
- Meeting notes and AI note-taking
- Project planning and project management
- Shopping lists, family lists, and checklists
- Habit tracking, routines, and daily planning
- GTD (Getting Things Done) workflow
- Students, freelancers, and busy professionals
Get started today for free.
Superlist can be used for free, but you can upgrade and unlock more features with a subscription. A monthly or yearly purchase will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited if you purchase a subscription. See our Terms of Use (www.superlist.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (www.superlist.com/privacy-policy).

bluejetty:00165691:ios.name: Metal Detector & Iron Finder
bluejetty:00165691:ios.summary: Metal Detector by Yalintech turns your phone's magnetometer (the compass sensor) into a simple, honest detector for iron, steel and magnets. Move the phone slowly over a spot: the signal rises when it passes over a screw, a nail, a steel ke
bluejetty:00165691:ios.description:
Metal Detector by Yalintech turns your phone's magnetometer (the compass sensor) into a simple, honest detector for iron, steel and magnets. Move the phone slowly over a spot: the signal rises when it passes over a screw, a nail, a steel key ring or a magnet.
DETECT
• Tap Zero away from metal, then sweep slowly
• The signal reads Weak, Moderate, Strong or Max, and the strongest signal so far stays on screen
• A beep that gets faster as the signal grows, with vibration, or vibration only, or silent
• Sensitivity: Auto, Low, Medium or High
• "Found it?" when a signal holds for a moment
MEASURE
• The magnetic field in microtesla (µT), with X, Y and Z values and the field direction
• A live chart of the last few seconds
• Record a measurement and keep it in History
FIND
• Wall mode: finds the screws and nails in a wall, not the wood
• Is it magnetic?: checks whether an object reacts like iron, steel or a magnet
• Small-object sweep: high sensitivity for pins, needles and staples when the phone passes right over them
HISTORY AND SIGNAL ANALYSIS
• Every saved session with its peak, average and lowest reading
• Signal Analysis: stability, peak events and notes for a recording, shared as text
TOOLS
• Compass, flashlight and device info
WHAT A PHONE CAN'T DETECT
• Gold, silver, copper, brass or aluminium. These metals are not magnetic, so no phone sensor can find them
• Many coins (they are made of non-magnetic alloys)
• Anything buried in the ground
• Radiation, Wi-Fi or mobile signals, or hidden cameras
The range is short (a few centimetres for small objects) and every phone's sensor is different. The reading shows field strength only: it can't tell how far away or how deep an object is. No signal does not mean it is safe to drill: pipes and cables may not be magnetic.
REQUIREMENTS
Your phone needs a built-in magnetometer (the compass sensor). If it has none, the app tells you right away.
METAL DETECTOR PRO
• An alert above a level you choose
• Readings in µT, mG or G
• Min / max hold
• CSV export of recordings
• Wall mode: every peak of your sweep listed
• Unlimited Signal Analysis
• No ads
Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, each with a 3-day free trial, or as a one-time purchase. Without Pro, the app shows ads.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Metal Detector Pro is offered as an auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription, each with a 3-day free trial, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://yalintech.com/legal/sensor/privacy
Terms of Service: https://yalintech.com/legal/sensor/terms
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Questions or feedback: support@yalintech.com

bluejetty:00040423:ios.name: Bedtime stories-StellaSleep
bluejetty:00040423:ios.summary:
Introducing Stella Sleep: Your Interactive Bedtime Companion for Memorable Parent-Child Moments
Are you ready to transform bedtime into a truly enchanting experience where parents can actively participate in their child's nightly routine?
bluejetty:00040423:ios.description:
Introducing Stella Sleep: Your Interactive Bedtime Companion for Memorable Parent-Child Moments
Are you ready to transform bedtime into a truly enchanting experience where parents can actively participate in their child's nightly routine? Picture this: soothing bedtime stories narrated by a sleep expert, guiding your child into a world of tranquility and dreams, all while allowing parents to be a crucial part of the experience. Stella Sleep is here to make this magical bonding a reality!
Listed as best sleep app for kids in 2023 by Sleep foundation and recognized in August 2023 by EU Startups as one of top 10 startups in Europe focusing on children.
>> Unleash Bedtime Imagination - Together:
Imagine a world of carefully curated bedtime stories, created in collaboration with sleep experts, where parents can actively participate. But that's not all – we invite you to record your own personalized stories in your soothing voice, making bedtime a joint adventure. Even when you can't be there in person, your comforting voice will be right there, ensuring peaceful dreams and strengthening the parent-child connection.
>> AI-Powered Storytelling Magic - Co-Creation at its Best:
Discover an exclusive feature in our app that will amaze you! With just a few words, our AI can craft an original bedtime story tailored to your child's imagination, allowing parents to actively engage in story creation with their little ones. Read it aloud together or save it for later – the choice is yours. 
>> Sleep Science
Stella Sleep is not just about stories – it's a complete sleep haven for your child where parents are integral. Our captivating collection combines sleep science, meditation, white noise, and soothing melodies to effortlessly whisk your little one off to dreamland while parents participate in the calming atmosphere. Our Social-Emotional stories that encourage parent-child conversations, will fostering understanding and connection and develop the social skills of your child.
>> Exclusive Narrators, Unparalleled Experience - Together:
Imagine the joy on your child's face as they embark on bedtime adventures with beloved characters and the renowned narrator, John Cleese, while parents join in on the storytelling. Every month, fresh stories with familiar voices arrive, ensuring the excitement never fades for both kids and parents.
>> A Safe and Educational Space - Parental Engagement:
Rest easy, knowing that Stella Sleep is designed for kids aged 0-10 and is completely free of ads. Stella Sleep is endorsed by the Educational Appstore, guaranteeing quality and peace of mind for parents.
>> Choose Your Subscription, Unlock Sweet Dreams - Together:
Unlock the full potential of Stella Sleep with our annual, monthly or weekly subscriptions, and experience the joy of active participation in your child's bedtime ritual. Gain access to our entire library of stories, meditations, music, our AI feature, and make bedtime a cherished shared moment.
>> Hassle-Free Subscriptions - Control at Your Fingertips:
Managing your subscription is a breeze. Payments are handled through your iTunes Account. You're in control – cancel anytime with ease. If you're not satisfied, your cancellation takes effect at the end of the subscription period.
Don't just dream about better bedtime moments – make them a reality with Stella Sleep, where parents and children actively share in the magic. Visit our website at https://stellasleep.com or reach out to us at info@stellasleep.com to learn more.
User agreement: https://stellasleep.com/useragreement
Privacy Policy: https://stellasleep.com/privacy

How does Bracelet DIY work you ask?
It has a variety of style designs to choose from, the ability to pick the color of the threads, beads, and pearls you want to make your bracelet with, a wide selection of hooks, charms, and stickers to decorate your bracelets, and boasting your bracelet designs by sharing it with your friends. The entire gameplay is easy to learn and master in an ASMR game-like experience.
FEATURES
- Six styles of Bracelet designs 
- Six different DIY gameplays.
- Manage your very own Bracelet DIY shop and decorate the interiors of the shop.
- VIP customers with special rewards.
- Sharing designs with your friends and family, and on social media.
- Smooth haptic feedback
So, what are you waiting for? Let's get started and make some beautiful bracelets and start showing them off!

bluejetty:00021110:ios.description:
لعبة مين أكثر واحد ينطبق عليه الوصف
"عوايدك" هي لعبة جماعية مع الأصدقاء بدون نت أو أونلاين تساعدك تعرف نفسك وتكتشف ماذا يعتقده أصحابك عنك بطريقة ممتعة. إذا كنت تبحث عن العاب جماعية أو لعبة للجمعات، فهذه اللعبة مناسبة لك ولأصحابك أو حتى العائلة.
تعرف أكثر على نفسك وعلى أصحابك من خلال لعبة التصويت "عوايدك" التي تحتوي على أكثر من 250 صفة وعادة. في جلسة مع الأصدقاء أو العائلة؟ جرّب "عوايدك" من أفضل الألعاب العائلية والألعاب الجماعية مع الأصدقاء.
طريقة اللعب:
● اجمع الشلة أو الأهل
● اختر نوع الأسئلة المناسب (رسمية، شخصية، لمحبي الأنمي، للقيمرز، بدون زعل)
● جاوب بصراحة وصوّت بدون ما يعرف غيرك
● بعد التصويت تظهر النتيجة
● اللي يجمع أكبر عدد من النقاط هو الفائز وهو اللي يعرف "عوايدك"
باقات أسئلة متوفرة للشراء:
● باقة القيمرز (99 صفة) مثل: "دايماً عنده لاق"، "نوب ومع ذلك يفوز"
● باقة الأنمي (99 صفة) مثل: "يجري زي نارتو"، "ما يقاوم أغاني هجوم العمالقة"
● باقة بدون زعل (99 سؤال) مثل: "يتروش بعطر"، "منبع الطاقة السلبية في الكون"
● باقة اللقاءات (99 سؤال) مثل: "دايما عنده ازعاج"، "صوته يتأخر كأنه يكلمكم من القمر"
عدد اللاعبين:
2 - 8 لاعبين
يمكن زيادة العدد إلى 16 عبر شراء باقة إضافية
اكتشف مين أكثر واحد ينطبق عليه الوصف مع "عوايدك". العب الآن بدون نت أو أونلاين!

• Upload proof documents easily and securely
• Track your approval status and delivery updates
Manage Your Account
• Check your talk, text, and data balance
• Add more 5G data anytime
• Turn on international calling in seconds
• Update your account details or change your plan
Refer and Earn
• Share TAG Mobile with friends and family
• Earn rewards when they get approved for Lifeline service
Shop Phones & Accessories
• Browse affordable smartphones, tablets, and accessories
• Get exclusive app-only deals
Why TAG Mobile?
• Trusted by millions of customers across the U.S.
• Licensed Lifeline provider
• No monthly bills, no credit checks, no hassle
Download the TAG Mobile app now to get started in just minutes.
Simple, secure, and built to keep you connected.

bluejetty:00134593:ios.description:
Nature Relaxation™ On-Demand for iOS is a premium video app offering instant, unlimited access to HUNDREDS of stunning ambient nature films direct from the producer David Huting. From soaring over majestic mountaintops in Patagonia to swimming underwater with dolphins in Tahiti, the expansive Nature Relaxation™ film library is your ticket to experiencing the world's most famous and hidden natural wonders in 4K UHD* & HD 1080p.
REPLACE YOUR WORRIES WITH WONDERS™ 
More than merely entertainment, watching nature films has been clinically proven to boost mood, boost mental energy & focus, while simultaneously relieving stress. That's right - watching Nature Relaxation is a perfect way to relax & simultaneously lower anxiety & high blood pressure, and help treat insomnia, cure depression, drug addiction, & many other health problems - all without doctors or pills.** 
AWESOME FEATURES EXCLUSIVELY FOR iOS
On top of being able to make your own playlist and access to a full suite of apps, iOS users get these great features:
• DOWNLOAD UNLIMITED VIDEOS - Save to your iPhone/iPad in HD for Offline play to Watch when no Wi-Fi is available.
• BACKGROUND AUDIO SUPPORT - Listen to soothing nature sounds and/or calming music while doing other tasks to keep you relaxed.
FREE DOWNLOAD, FREE VIDEOS & 30-DAY FREE TRIAL
Before you decide, why not inspect the quality, style & functionality? Simply download the app and click on the 'Free Videos' collection to enjoy a small selection of films to sample (no free trial signup required). Like what you see? Subscribe and your first 30 days are 100% free to try out. 
PERFECT USES FOR NATURE RELAXATION: 
Enhance the ambiance of your home & work environments by displaying amazing nature scenes from the around the world - with just nature sounds or calming music. Try turning Nature Relaxation on while working, reading, meditating or sleeping to create a feeling of calm & focus...or watch with headphones for instant relief from acute cases of extreme anger, rage, gloom, fear, or anxiety. In a matter of minutes, you'll feel that negative energy dissipating thanks to the positive vibes Nature provides. 
CAREFULLY CREATED FOR USE WITHIN THE HEALTHCARE INDUSTRY
Nature Relaxation™ Films are carefully designed by producer David Huting to provide therapeutic relaxation in a wide array patient care settings, such as hospitals, high stress workplaces, nursing homes - even schools, prisons, casinos and more. Through the use of careful shot selection & ultra high quality cinema cameras, Nature Relaxation videos offer a multi-sensory immersion that is clinically proven to provide positive mental & physical health benefits related to lowered stress. Learn more at http://www.NatureRelaxation.com/about
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Nature Relaxation On-Demand on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Privacy Policy - https://naturerelaxation.vhx.tv/privacy
Terms of Service - https://naturerelaxation.vhx.tv/tos
*While most of the films were shot and uploaded in 4K UHD, the streaming quality is currently limited to 1080p HD. 
**These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA and in no way are intended to treat or cure any disease.

Nature Relaxation™ On-Demand for iOS is a premium video app offering instant, unlimited access to HUNDREDS of stunning ambient nature films direct from the  producer David Huting. From soaring over majestic mountaintops in Patagonia to swimming underwater with dolphins in Tahiti, the expansive Nature Relaxation™ film library is your ticket to experiencing the world's most famous and hidden natural wonders in 4K UHD* & HD 1080p.

REPLACE YOUR WORRIES WITH WONDERS™ 
More than merely entertainment, watching nature films has been clinically proven to boost mood, boost mental energy & focus, while simultaneously relieving stress. That's right - watching Nature Relaxation is a perfect way to relax & simultaneously lower anxiety & high blood pressure, and help treat insomnia, cure depression, drug addiction, & many other health problems - all without doctors or pills.** 

AWESOME FEATURES EXCLUSIVELY FOR iOS
On top of being able to make your own playlist and access to a full suite of apps, iOS users get these great features:

• DOWNLOAD UNLIMITED VIDEOS - Save to your iPhone/iPad in HD for Offline play to Watch when no Wi-Fi is available.

• BACKGROUND AUDIO SUPPORT - Listen to soothing nature sounds and/or calming music while doing other tasks to keep you relaxed.

FREE DOWNLOAD, FREE VIDEOS & 30-DAY FREE TRIAL
Before you decide, why not inspect the quality, style & functionality? Simply download the app and click on the 'Free Videos' collection to enjoy a small selection of films to sample (no free trial signup required). Like what you see? Subscribe and your first 30 days are 100% free to try out. 

PERFECT USES FOR NATURE RELAXATION: 
Enhance the ambiance of your home & work environments by displaying amazing nature scenes from the around the world - with just nature sounds or calming music. Try turning Nature Relaxation on while working, reading, meditating or sleeping to create a feeling of calm & focus...or watch with headphones for instant relief from acute cases of extreme anger, rage, gloom, fear, or anxiety.  In a matter of minutes, you'll feel that negative energy dissipating thanks to the positive vibes Nature provides.  

CAREFULLY CREATED FOR USE WITHIN THE HEALTHCARE INDUSTRY
Nature Relaxation™ Films are carefully designed by producer David Huting to provide therapeutic relaxation in a wide array patient care settings, such as hospitals, high stress workplaces, nursing homes - even schools, prisons, casinos and more. Through the use of careful shot selection & ultra high quality cinema cameras, Nature Relaxation videos offer a multi-sensory immersion that is clinically proven to provide positive mental & physical health benefits related to lowered stress.  Learn more at http://www.NatureRelaxation.com/about

To access all features and content you can subscribe to Nature Relaxation On-Demand on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.

* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

Privacy Policy - https://naturerelaxation.vhx.tv/privacy
Terms of Service - https://naturerelaxation.vhx.tv/tos

*While most of the films were shot and uploaded in 4K UHD, the streaming quality is currently limited to 1080p HD. 
**These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA and in no way are intended to treat or cure any disease.

bluejetty:00184693:ios.description:
Exclusive to iOS, comes the Multi-Award winning Swordy Quest game. Fully VoiceOver compatible, featured as Apple's "Game of the Day" and Winner of the Highly Acclaimed Golden Apple Accessibility Award (AppleVis).
Imagine waking up with no name, food or supplies. Where are you? Lake to the East, Mountains to the South. It doesn't matter now. YOU NEED TO SURVIVE. Set in a Fantasy and Living World, your goal is clear: Save humanity. Find water and food while fending off the habitants of the world. Gather, craft, hunt & cast magic for rewards and progression. Can you unlock the secrets of the Multi-Award Winning Swordy Quest?
REVIEWS
"Simply the best game I have ever played. Utterly absorbing, challenging and rewarding on every level. A very talented game developer. Worth every star."
5/5
"This game is fantastic, I especially love the attention paid to accessibility. I also love the attention to detail. And I love the gameplay overall."
5/5
"This is by far the best rpg in the App Store. The developer is wonderful to work with. Extremely active in the Swordy community. There hasn’t been 1 problem that he hasn’t been able to fix. Mad props to you good sir"
5/5
"Guys, you're doing an amazing job with accessibility. I'm totally blind an you giving me the joy to play. Your game is quite complex but you've managed to take it perfectly accessible! All devs should learn from you. Youre simply great!..."
5/5
"Freaking. Addicting. That is all. Been up half the night on this. Gotta go to bed! Awesome, simple, wish so many more games were like this!!!"
5/5
"I love this game super simple and fun. Totally accessible."
5/5
FEATURES
● Open World Environment - allowing you to explore grasslands, lakes, mountains & more
● Enemies around every corner!
● Weapon crafting - where finding the right materials is key to fending off enemies
● Survival aspects - requiring careful resource management
● Hidden items - finding them can mean the difference between life & death
● Eye-catching graphics - transport you to another world
● Intuitive navigation system
● Advanced Player customization
● Become a Wizard by unlocking
● & much, much more...
HINTS N TIPS
● Hints can be found at Shrines within the game

bluejetty:00166357:ios.summary:
Meet Photica — a powerful AI tool designed for realistic portrait animation, trending video effects, and instant AI transformations right on your smartphone.
What you can make?
| AI LIVE PHOTOS |
Breathe life into your favorite photograph
bluejetty:00166357:ios.description:
Meet Photica — a powerful AI tool designed for realistic portrait animation, trending video effects, and instant AI transformations right on your smartphone.
What you can make?
| AI LIVE PHOTOS |
Breathe life into your favorite photographs. Our AI analyzes your images to add realistic movements, facial expressions, and gestures. Watching a photo come alive with natural motion feels like pure magic.
| OLD RESTORE |
Give your treasured photos a second life. Upload any old or blurry photograph, and our AI will first enhance its quality to HD clarity, then add realistic motion. Restore the details and bring warmth and life back to your favorite memories.
| DANCE EFFECT |
Transform any photo into a trendy dance. Upload a portrait and choose one of the many dance effects. Turn into the King of Pop, or just do a funny dance. Animate yourself, your friends, your kids, and your pets.
| NOSTALGIA EFFECT |
Create heartfelt animated moments with cherished photos from your personal archive. This gentle AI effect adds warmth and motion to the images you hold dear.
| AI PHOTOSHOOTS |
Stop spending money on expensive studios. Simply upload a photo and get a professional-quality portrait. Perfect for LinkedIn, social media profiles, or personal archives.
| MUSCLES MORPH |
A fun and playful animation that turns anyone into a muscular athlete. Watch the transformation happen in seconds — great for lighthearted fun and creative social media content featuring yourself or people who've given you their photo to use.
| RETRO DOLL |
Ever wanted to be a collectible? Create your own digital doll in a classic toy box. A trendy, stylized look that's perfect for sharing with friends.
| AI GIANT MODE |
Feel the scale! Use this effect to turn yourself into a giant in the middle of an urban jungle. A high-impact visual that is sure to grab attention in any feed.
| AI POLAROID & RETRO |
Give your modern shots a classic soul. Instantly apply vintage aesthetics and instant-photo frames to create that nostalgic, timeless feel.
Why Photica?
Creative & Fun: Turn everyday photos into memorable animated moments.
Trend-Ready: New AI effects and styles added regularly.
Multi-Project Support: Manage and save multiple creations simultaneously.
Ease of Use: Follow simple in-app instructions for studio-quality results.
Subscription Information:
To access all features and unlock the full potential of AI content creation, an active Photica subscription is required.
Your Apple ID account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited once a subscription is activated.
Support & Legal:
Questions or suggestions? Contact us at: support@photica.zendesk.com
Privacy Policy: https://photica.ai/privacy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://photica.ai/terms.pdf

bluejetty:00167774:ios.description:
Can't find your remote again? Here is an easy way to find a replacement without leaving your home! 
Lost your TV remote control? Say goodbye to the hassle of searching for your remote. 
Try the easy TV Remote Control app! It support all the mainstream TV brands including Roku TV and Roku Sticks, LG, Vizio, Samsung, Fire TV and Firestick, Hisense, TCL and more. Just connect this Universal TV remote control app to your TV in the same Wi-Fi. And you can turn your TV on or off, change volume, find shows, and pick channels — just like a normal TV remote and more. Make your TV watching easy with this simple universal TV remote control app!
Main Features of Universal TV Remote Control:
Easy find: This TV remote control app finds all TVs on your Wi-Fi, making setup easy.
Fast TV remote control: Our simple TV remote gives you quick TV control. Voice and on/off are in this TV remote app.
Easy use for TV remote: Use the touch pad for easy TV control in simple universal TV remote control
Keyboard: Type and search for shows fast in Roku remote control app
Turn on/off your TV from your phone, enjoy easy TV use in TV remote control app
Use your voice to find shows in our Universal TV remote app and use voice search.
How to use TV Remote for Roku TV & Smart TV:
Download the Roku Remote Control app.
Pick a TV brand like Fire TV, Samsung, Roku, TCL, LG, Vizio, Hisense, etc. on the same Wi-Fi as the TV remote control.
Tap to connect your TV to this Roku remote control app.
Done! Your TV remote control app is ready. Control your TV easily with these steps using this Roku remote control app!
TV remote easy control - For all TV brands
 ▸ TV Remote control for Roku TV
 ▸ Vizio Smart TV Remote - Vizio TV Remote 
 ▸ Cast to TV, screen mirroring for TV
 ▸ Fire TV remote control & remote control for FireStick 
 ▸ TV Remote control for Vizio
 ▸ TV Remote control for LG and Samsung
 ▸ TV Remote control for TV including TCL, LG, Hisense
Universal TV remote stops typical remote problems like losing it or dead batteries, turning your phone into a simple, all-in-one universal TV remote control.
Troubleshooting:
- The Universal remote control app must be on the same Wi-Fi network as your smart TV.
- If you experience connection issues with TV device, try reinstalling the Universal remote app and restarting your TV to fix common problems.
Note on TV Remote: This TV remote control for all Smart TV app is NOT linked to any TV brand.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/tv-remote-ios-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00090407:ios.description:
«Рахш Такси» — это сервис, который позволяет быстро вызвать такси в Таджикистане
 без звонка диспетчеру. Мы выводим услуги по перевозке на новый уровень благодаря ультрасовременным мобильным технологиям с возможностью срочного заказа, а также предварительного заказа и круглосуточной службе поддержки. Заказать такси можно через мобильное приложение Rakhsh Taxi Dushanbe, на сайте или позвонив нам на короткий номер 33-33.
Компания Рахш Такси предоставляет комфортабельные микроавтобусы и внедорожники для встречи делегаций или для перевозки персонала Вашей компании.
К Вашим услугам лучшие автомобили VIP-класса, заказав которые, Вы сможете достойно встретить гостей или партнёров по бизнесу.
Выполняя заказ такси у нас, Вы можете быть уверены в том, что автомобиль прибудет в кратчайшие сроки, а за рулём будет сидеть опытный водитель, хорошо знающий город. Быстрая подача автомобиля и высокое качество работы, являются важнейшими задачами диспетчерской службы Рахш такси.
В службе такси «Рахш такси» имеются легковые автомобили любого класса и комплектации, поэтому мы можем предложить нашим клиентам широкий ассортимент транспортных услуг:
• Услуги VIP-такси (заказ водителя с автомобилем на целый день).
• Услуга Трезвый водитель.
• Курьерская доставка.
• Встречи и проводы в аэропорт.
• Предоставление автотранспорта для экскурсий.
• Грузоперевозки, автокраны, эвакуаторы, микроавтобусы, внедорожники.
• Заказ машин на праздники, свадьбы, мероприятия, встречи.
• Тур-поездки по Таджикистану.
Call-center 33-33
Контакт-центр:
e-mail contact@rakhshtaxi.tj
По вопросам сотрудничества:
e-mail director@rakhshtaxi.tj
Населенные пункты, где вы можете вызвать «Рахш Такси»: 
Душанбе, Бохтар, Худжанд, Регар(Турсунзаде), Хатлон, Ёвон, Вахдат, Панчакент, Истаравшан, Хисор, Конибодом, Исфара, Спитамен, Бадахшон, Рушон, Ч.Балхи, А.Джоми, Деваштич, Норак.

bluejetty:00128615:ios.description:
He’s a radish… and also a dad. His kids have gone missing from the vegetable patch, and he needs your help to find them!
Explore an exciting world, face off with fast-food themed foes, and reunite Dadish with his missing children in this challenging platforming adventure.
+ A challenging retro platformer from the creator of Super Fowlst!
+ Dialog that is funny, but not TOO funny
+ Controller support
+ 50 cool levels to beat
+ Lots of rude and sassy baby radishes to find
+ Fast-food dudes that will try to kill you
+ Five big tasty bosses
+ A screechy possum
+ The joys of fatherhood
+ A pretty good soundtrack I guess
+ I like the graphics I hope you do too
+ Collectable stars
+ Unlockable secrets

bluejetty:00065488:ios.description:
dr. CAFE® COFFEE has upgraded its mobile ordering application by applying the latest technology to add great features considering customer needs & convenience, it’s very user friendly, responsive, easy to navigate, and links to dr. CAFE online store in order for you to Pick up your order or get it home and enjoy the ultimate coffee experience.
What's new to the dr. CAFE® Mobile App?
Discover- Discover new products of dr. CAFE® 
Subscriptions- Subscriptions on Beans Collections on your choice of Frequency: Weekly, Fortnight, and Monthly can reschedule, pause and cancel according to your wish
Reward program- Earn points and redeem them for great rewards, enjoy exclusive benefits by collecting points through daily purchasing and redeeming them to explore varieties of food & Beverage coffee beans, and merchandise in a unique experience
New Launch / Top selling- Displays Top selling products of Products
Bulk order- This allows customers to purchase beans wholesale.
Catering- dr. CAFE® brings catering to their customer to provide the best quality services and memorable experiences.
dr. CAFE® takes care of your coffee stock.
We offer coffee delivery in an easy & convenient way by providing two shipping methods with flexible time slots:
dr. cafe express- We deliver within Riyadh - Delivery within 3h to 4h
Thru our partner, Globus Logistic – We deliver to Many Regions within the kingdom and outside
- Delivers according to your location.
This mobile ordering application is designed to bring dr. CAFE COFFEE menus are closer to your fingertips. So you can easily order, choose a store, and pick up time in a fast, easy awesome way to reach your favorite store and find your order ready for delivery or pick up or enjoy at the store. This application will provide a wide variety of dr. CAFE® products and privileges like dr. CAFE® Rewards, referral program, connecting to all social media accounts of dr. CAFE®, dr. CAFE® information, newsroom about dr. CAFE®. With these new updates in the application, locating dr. CAFE® stores will be very easy, with its GPS functionality it will give the exact location of the stores, it’s operational timing, and the type of store you preferred whether Hybrid, V12, Drive-Thru, Kiosk, or stores with sitting areas, patios, business meeting space, dr. CAFE® at shopping malls, banks, universities, hospitals, and airports.
dr. CAFE® online store has everything you need to enjoy the premium cafe experience in your own home.
Here you can purchase our specialty coffee beans, exquisite teas, coffee accessories, and coffee gifts that are sure to please any palate. Whether you're enjoying our specialty coffee in your home or giving a gift that is sure to please, our online store makes it easy to bring the ultimate cafe experience home.
HOW THE dr. CAFE MOBILE APP ORDER WORKS?
1. Click the “Pickup or Dine-In” option on the application’s main screen.
2. Once you click the system will give you the list of the nearest dr. CAFE® store to you. Choose the store
3. Discover the best seller or simply select the beverage and food items to order: Just like in the store, beverages are customizable, including
the option to modify the size, several espresso shots, several types of beans options, dairy selections, and more.
4. After choosing the desired Beverages and food, click “Add” a button to include it on your list of purchases then click “View Cart”. The application will give you a summary of your order, including the product’s price, you wanted to pick up your order and pay the way you like.
5. Click “Check out”. The system will give a summary of your order like the estimated pick up or dine-in or delivery date & time, your delivery address, slots, etc., and can be changed before confirming the order.
6. Chooses your payment mode & click “Confirm Order”. The system will give the confirmation email for your order.

bluejetty:00183064:ios.description:
Vieni a giocare a Burraco Italiano un classico gioco di carte Italiano! Nel gioco del Burraco Italiano, il tuo obiettivo è quello di costruire degli insiemi con l’unione di sequenze dello stesso seme o di carte che hanno lo stesso valore. Forma le famose canaste (insiemi di 7 o più carte) e otterrai un punteggio più alto!
Nel Burraco Italiano Jogatina, è possibile creare tavoli composti da 2 o 4 giocatori e vedere le canaste, giocando online contro persone in carne e ossa in modalità multiplayer o contro i nostri robot maestri di canasta. 
- Gioca partite con 2 o 4 giocatori.
- Allenati e fai pratica con i robot, anche senza essere connesso a Internet.
- Salva le partite contro i robot e riprendi dal punto in cui hai interrotto il gioco.
- Gioca online con persone reali.
- Parla con altri giocatori nella nostra chat.
- Personalizza il tavolo e le carte nel mazzo.
- Guarda le statistiche delle partite.
Se sei un appassionato di Burraco, o ti piace giocare a Bisca, Briscola, Scopa, Tresette e Scopone, questo gioco ti piacerà davvero!
Le carte sono già sul tavolo. Che cosa aspetti? Scarica subito Burraco Italiano Jogatina, forma alcune canaste e diventerai un vero campione del mazzo di carte!
E per te che sei fan del gioco, entra a far parte del Club VIP per entrare nella nostra classifica, oltre ad avere altri vantaggi esclusivi. Prova gratis per un mese o una settimana!
DIVENTA VIP
Puoi diventare un giocatore VIP abbonandoti con il tuo conto iTunes e ottenendo vantaggi esclusivi:
- Giocare senza pubblicità.
- Essere inserito in classifica!
- Avere la tua foto nell’avatar.
Sono disponibili tre modalità di abbonamento: il piano settimanale a 4,99 dollari americani, quello mensile a 7,99 dollari americani e quello annuale a 29,99 dollari americani.
Il prezzo dell’abbonamento sarà addebitato sul tuo conto iTunes appena confermerai l’acquisto. Al termine del periodo selezionato, l’abbonamento sarà rinnovato automaticamente per la durata originaria del piano precedentemente scelto (vedi sopra), con addebito del rinnovo 24 ore prima del medesimo. Puoi disattivare il rinnovo dalle opzioni del tuo conto iTunes fino a 24 ore prima della scadenza dell’abbonamento in essere. Per ulteriori informazioni, vedi i link di seguito:
Informativa sul trattamento dei dati personali:
http://www.jogatina.com/site/privacy/mobile/burraco
Condizioni e termini d’uso:
https://www.jogatina.com/mobile/terms.do

bluejetty:00032128:android.description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our FREE and easy-to-use app, featuring the soulful recitation of the Holy Quran by Yasser Al Dosari. This user-friendly app is designed for seamless navigation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the divine wisdom of the Quran at your convenience and without the need for an internet connection.
🌟 Key Features 🌟
✅ Offline Listening: Access the entire Quran offline. Enjoy Yasser Al Dosari recitations without needing an internet connection, ensuring your spiritual journey is uninterrupted.
✅ HD Quality Audio: Enjoy the highest quality MP3 audio that brings each verse of the Quran to life with clarity and precision, beautifully delivered by Sheikh Yasser Al Dosari.
✅ Listen and Read Simultaneously: Experience a multi-sensory engagement with the Quran. Listen to Yasser Al Dosari’s recitation while reading the Arabic text or translation, enhancing understanding and retention.
✅ Advanced Search Functionality: Quickly locate specific verses or surahs with a few taps, making your Quran study more focused and efficient.
✅ Shuffle Play: Mix up your daily Quran listening with our shuffle feature, which randomly plays different surahs by Yasser Al Dosari, offering a refreshing way to engage with the Quran.
✅ Background Play: Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption.
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights: Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.
Our app is designed to be straightforward and accessible for everyone, from beginners to those who regularly recite the Quran. Share the beauty of Yasser Al Dosari’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.
✅ Explore More on Our Developer Page: Delve deeper into the Quran with other renowned reciters like Maher Al Muaqly and Abdelbaset Abdessamad. But don’t miss Sheikh Yasser Al Dosari’s collection for a soulful listening experience. Expand your recitation library and enrich your spiritual practice with diverse and revered voices.
✅ Why Choose Yasser Al Dosari?
Yasser Al Dosari is celebrated worldwide for his deeply moving and soulful recitations of the Quran. His unique voice captures the essence of divine revelation, making each verse resonate deeply within your heart. By choosing our app, you gain access to his unparalleled recitations, ensuring a spiritually enriching experience.
Download now and immerse yourself in the soothing recitation of the Quran by Sheikh Yasser Al Dosari, available anytime, right at your fingertips!

bluejetty:00155307:android.description:
VGX Wallet is your gateway to the world of crypto and multi-chain ecosystems. Leveraging the technology of the former SafeMoon Wallet, we've redesigned and re-engineered the app from the ground up to provide a seamless and secure experience putting you in control of your crypto, NFTs, DeFi activity, and digital assets.
KEY FEATURES
- Simple and intuitive interface for buying, selling, and swapping crypto
- Multi-Chain Support: Access a diverse ecosystem of blockchains and a growing number of popular cryptocurrencies
- Collectibles Gallery: View your NFT Collectibles across multiple chains
- Portfolio Management: Track your investments and their performance
- Market Insights: Stay informed with real-time price alerts and charts
- dApp Security: Automatic disconnection from dApps after inactivity
- Custom Contact Management: Organize, backup and restore your crypto contacts
- Enhanced Security: Local password login, Biometric and Google authentication
ENHANCED SECURITY & CONVENIENCE
- Google Drive Wallet Backups: Securely back up your wallet to Google Drive on any device for easy recovery and peace of mind.
- Contact Backups: Effortlessly manage and back up your contact list.
- Web3Auth Integration: Import your wallets seamlessly using your existing Google or X (Twitter) accounts.
EXPANDED ASSET SUPPORT
VGX Wallet supports the top chains and digital assets, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), VGX (VGX), SafeMoon (SFM), BNB, Cardano (ADA), Ripple (XRP), Dogecoin (DOGE), Avalanche (AVAX), USDC, USDT, and dozens more.
Experience the future of digital asset management with the VGX Wallet!

apple-macos:6828320429.description:
Frameskip is a video tool that lets you step through videos frame by frame, mark timestamps, and see exactly how much time passes between them.
Features:
- Step forward and back one frame
- Change playback speed on the fly
- Mark timestamps with a tap, and jump between them
- Compare the difference between timestamps in the Timing Table, in milliseconds or frames
- Export your timestamps as a CSV file
- Save any frame as an image
- View video information, like frame rate, resolution, and codec
Frameskip has no ads, or In-App Purchases. We believe tools like this should be free for anyone to use, however they like.

apple-itunes:1126800020.description:
Work communication that won’t distract you all day.
Twist makes collaboration easy from anywhere. Unlike Slack and Teams, it uses threads to organize all your team’s conversations — asynchronously.
ORGANIZATION

CLARITY

FOCUS

ACCESS

COMMUNICATION

AUTOMATION
• Plus all the integrations your team relies on

The bottom line? Twist means productivity over presence. Sign up now.

A World Without Boundaries

apple-itunes:1108532275.name: Splice: Make music now
apple-itunes:1108532275.description:
Splice is a royalty-free sample library, trusted and used by your favorite music creators. With Splice Mobile, you now have the power to browse the entire Splice catalog, organize your favorite sounds, discover hidden gems, record your own audio, and start countless new ideas with Create mode—right from your phone. Splice Mobile keeps inspiration within reach wherever you are.
DISCOVER NEW SPLICE SOUNDS ON THE GO
Inspiration isn’t limited to the studio, and now, neither is your creativity. With our mobile app, you can browse the entire Splice catalog all from your phone. Dive deep into packs and genres and discover hidden gems. Search by keyword and filter by tags to find the perfect sound for your project. Quickly audition loops, tap the heart icon to save your favorite sounds, and organize them into Collections. 
VOICE TO VERSE—ANYWHERE 
The latest mobile feature, Splice Mic, redefines mobile music creation for songwriters who know inspiration doesn’t wait. More than just a recording app, it lets you hear every topline, verse, or riff in full musical context over Splice sounds—right from your phone. Instantly test ideas, explore genres, and unlock new creative possibilities.
Humming a melody? Strumming a riff? Working out lyrics? Splice Mic turns spontaneous moments into real musical opportunities. Every take is a step toward your next track. When you're ready, export to your DAW and turn those mobile ideas into full songs.
INSTANT INSPIRATION WITH CREATE MODE
Generating new musical ideas and starting beats on the go has never been easier. Simply tap on the Create icon, select your desired genre, and immediately drop into a Stack of loops from the Splice library. You may find the generated Stack fits what you’re looking for perfectly, but if not, that’s great too. Developing a musical idea is often about trying combinations of sounds and figuring out what feels good to you—Create Mode is a great companion for that process. 
Create Mode leaves creative control in your hands—shuffle to create a whole new Stack or add new layers of compatible sounds and your own recordings. If you want to replace a single loop with a new option of the same type of sound, swipe right. If you want to delete the layer altogether, swipe left. You can also solo a layer by holding down, or tap the layer to mute. Once you’ve chosen your Stack layers, you can fine-tune your loop with volume adjustments and BPM control. When your idea hits the spot, save it with a click. You can also click the Stack icon to hear any individual loop in the Splice library in musical context with Create mode. 
SAVE IT. SEND IT. SHARE IT.
Creating and saving your Stack is just the beginning. Not only is the Stack accessible from anywhere you can access your Splice account, but you can also share it directly with a unique link, AirDrop it to friends, or upload to Dropbox, Drive, or another cloud service right from your device for seamless collaboration. If you work in Ableton Live or Studio One, you can export your Stack as a DAW file and open it up with key and tempo information synced when you’re back in the studio. You can also save as a bounced stereo mix to hear the full idea rendered.
START WITH SPLICE
Subscribe to use Splice's expansive library of royalty-free samples, presets, MIDI, and creative tools in your music. Use Splice samples to create anything—they’re cleared for commercial use in new works. Cancel your subscription anytime and keep everything you've downloaded. 
Privacy Policy: https://splice.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://splice.com/terms

apple-macos:6770520787.name: Mukashi: Bilingual Kids Books
apple-macos:6770520787.description:
You don't have to speak the language to give it to them.
Mukashi is a bilingual storybook for children. Every line shows the words, how they sound, and what they mean — so a parent who doesn't speak Japanese, Spanish or Arabic can still sit down and read one tonight.
READ TOGETHER, IN TWO LANGUAGES
Each line carries three layers at once: the original text, an optional pronunciation guide, and a word-by-word meaning in your language, with the full sentence underneath. Nothing is hidden behind a quiz or a tap. The meaning is simply already there, so the story never stops.
THE PRONUNCIATION YOU DON'T HAVE
Tap any word to open its card — meaning, part of speech, and audio in a natural voice. You supply the reading-together; the app supplies the part you can't.
THE WORDS THAT STAY
Save any word to My Words, your child's own flashcard deck, and review at whatever pace suits. Because the words arrive inside a story they wanted to hear, they stick better than a list ever manages.
OR JUST READ THE STORY
Some nights nobody wants a lesson. Story Mode strips the glosses away and leaves a calm, single-language read, sentence by sentence.
FEATURES
• Trilayer reading — text, pronunciation and per-word meaning on every line
• Tap-to-translate — open any word for its meaning and hear it spoken
• Read-aloud — natural text-to-speech in every supported language
• My Words — save vocabulary and review it with built-in flashcards
• Grammar colours — every word tinted by its part of speech, no lesson required
• Story Mode — a clean single-language read when that is all you want
• Original storybook-style illustrations on every page
• Four cosy themes (Classic, Night, Cream, Forest) and adjustable text size
• Works fully offline — every story ships inside the app
• A PIN-protected parent area and an optional daily reading limit
THIRTEEN LANGUAGES, ANY PAIR
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Combine any two, in either direction — learn Spanish from English, English from Korean, or keep a grandparent's language alive at home.
FOLK TALES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
From Momotaro to the Tortoise and the Hare, Anansi the Spider to the Thirsty Crow, Little Red Riding Hood to the Blue Jackal — stories children have loved for generations, retold simply and beautifully illustrated. New tales are added over time, and Premium includes every one.
FOR ANYONE READING BETWEEN LANGUAGES
Whether you are raising a bilingual child, holding on to a heritage language, or picking one up yourself, Mukashi moves at your pace. There are no points to chase and nothing to fail — just a story, twice over.
QUIET BY DESIGN
No advertising. No data sold. Read anywhere, including on a plane with the wifi off.
Made for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.
SUBSCRIPTION, TERMS & PRIVACY
– Start with free stories. Mukashi Premium unlocks the whole library: monthly (auto-renewing) or once for life (Lifetime).
– Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
– Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
– Privacy Policy: https://hadicuet.github.io/mukashistories-legal/

apple-macos:1553120088.name: Class Planner (cloud)
apple-macos:1553120088.description:
Class Planner (cloud) is a new release of the Class Planner app. This version stores data in the cloud instead of on device, so the app data is accessible from multiple devices such as a phone, an iPad and a MacBook computer. Your data automatically syncs from all your devices.
Class Planner allows teachers to easily keep a record of their lesson plans which include the standards, lesson notes, homework and an online web resources.
Features
• Support a 1 week, 2 weeks or 6 day schedule.
• Easily import standards and link to a lesson
• View lessons for the day, the week, or by a class
• Easily move lessons forward or backwards
• Generate a PDF of the lesson for administrators or personal records
• Sync homework with Google Classroom announcements.
• Add a home screen widget to show today's class schedule
Try the app for free for 2 classes. Activate an autorenewable subscription to support up to 20 classes or up to 30 classes.
Autorenewable Subscription Details
To access additional features the user needs to subscribe to an auto renewable subscription. This means the subscription automatically renews 24 hours before the end of the subscription date. Auto renewable subscriptions can be managed from the user iTunes account, and a link is provided in the subscription screen while in the app. All future updates are included with the auto renewable monthly subscription fee. The subscription may be cancelled for any future months, and the user will still have access to the data, only the additional features will be disabled.
Feel free to email the developer at support@inpocketsolutions.com to give feedback. I love to make improvements based on user suggestions and anything to help teachers keep track of their lesson plans is appreciated. 
Privacy Policy: https://inpocketsolutions.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://inpocketsolutions.com/terms
